reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Perfect place all around! Leslie, Shak,  and Dee are amazing , always come here when I visit Las Vegas ❤️ Also a great place to just stop by and enjoy a couple drinks with a definite lower price than any drink on Freemont!

reviews.title: A Great, Relaxing Spot Near It All!
reviews.text: I would be grounded in LV due to an airline and global IT issue, I panicked; I would be in LV for another 3 days and not for pleasure. My wife helped me look for hotels in the area and there was very little availability. She told me about The Downtowner near Fremont St. I was excited about.We booked it and a few hours later I checked in. The process was VERY smooth and the room, location, amenities, and vibe were great. I thank the staff for being prepared for the millions of people grounded for days, as well as for having such a nice motel near a great location in downtown LV.Stay at the Downtowner for business, pleasure, and all other reasons while in LV.

reviews.title: Reasonable and close to the fun!!
reviews.text: The front staff were amazing. The rooms are very quiet even being close to Fremont Street and on a busy weekend the minigolf is fun and a snack and bar is reasonable. Had a great time. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Great little spot with really nice staff
reviews.text: Really nice atmosphere- the staff is amazing and the building is cute. Great location. In short walking distance to a lot of places. Price is great and reasonable. Will come back for sure.

reviews.title: Best Deal with Amazing Staff
reviews.text: Second time here in 4 months and it’s quickly become my go to. The pricing, helpful staff and being walking distance to Fremont are the selling points. Away from the big city traffic and still feels how old Vegas used to feel. Paul was amazing and took care of all of my inquiries. I’ll be back here again for sure!

reviews.title: Could be worse, but not by much
reviews.text: I'd give it 1.5 stars but not 2. Thankfully we were just there to sleep, and only for one night. It seemed clean enough, but the renovations they did to turn these old apartments into a hotel were clearly not professionally done. It felt like it was still a grungy old place, just with some colorful pain and astroturf nailed to the wall. We were in the Wylde building. I got the feeling that the rooms in that section may be worse than the rest of the hotel. The front desk staff was not friendly when we checked in. Check out was friendly. The worst part was that our room had a sewer smell. I think it was from the window AC unit. It was old and probably hadn't been serviced for ages. The "check filter" light was on, and the buttons were worn so much that you could barely read them. One was missing completely. There was a dead cockroach in the track of the bathroom window when we opened it to try to air out the sewer smell. The sheet on the bed didn't fully cover the mattress. The bottom 10 inches or so were just exposed mattress pad. On a positive note, I felt safe and didn't have to pay a bunch of resort or other extra fees. Parking is down the street, but not far.

reviews.title: Awesome Place To Stay!
reviews.text: Check-in was a breeze. Staff was very attentive and polite. Leslie was awesome as well as Paul. Room was very clean and ready for us when we arrived. Would highly recommend The Downtowner for anyone traveling to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: They didn't not hold my items in lost and found for as long as they claimed they would.
reviews.text: At the end of my stay I left my pair of Solovair boots in the room. They called my friend to let them know and said they would hold on to them for 30 days. Around day 20 I called to let them know I would be coming back up the following week to get them. I was informed that the lost and found had been cleared out and nothing was there. I was told to call back in a few hours when another employee who takes care of that came in.  When I called back later, I was told that person was not there at the moment, and they would be calling my back soon that day. I was never called back.  I called again later and was told the same thing by someone else. I am now out hundreds of dollars. They did not honor their holding period. I'm sure someone decided to take them for themselves. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Laid back and quiet
reviews.text: Stay at this little gem tucked in the East Fremont area of downtown Las Vegas! The location is perfect, and the vibe is laid-back. The rooms are modest and comfortable. The staff is super helpful and wonderful! We would stay at The Downtowner again!

reviews.title: Viva las vegas
reviews.text: Great location near all the happenings of the Fremont street area. Quiet enough to not be disturbed at night. We stayed in the main building and it was clean and comfortable. For it being a boutique hotel, I found the check-in process to be impersonal. I don’t mind a self check in (via kiosk) at large hotels to reduce wait times BUT I  felt invisible because the front desk also doubled as the bartender and there were people at the bar shooting the sh!t with her. So no warm welcome or even acknowledgment that we were there. But overall a nice place to stay.

reviews.title: I don’t receive my deposit
reviews.text: Good hotel, but I don’t receive my deposit from 13 septembre 2025.Is not a problem of my bank, since all the hotels we stayed in our trip to the USA have already returned the deposit, they also don't respond to the emails I sent.

reviews.title: 5 star baby!!
reviews.text: 5 star service and peaceful location!The staff is great! The bar is chill. And the rooms are nice! Can't wait to stay again!

reviews.title: Last minute find!!
reviews.text: This was a last minute decision. I had been reserved in a different hotel when there was an issue with my reservation which led me scrambling to find another place and fast! My mother in law and I flew in from Phoenix and found this place!  I liked that it was right off of the old strip on Fremont St! Upon our arrival we checked in.. D and Leslie are friendly, very communicative.. we enjoyed them!! Open bar for 24 hours was a plus.. complimentary coffee in the am! Rooms were clean decent size. Shower and vents could have been cleaned more efficiently and the walls over the beds could had been wiped down. The  only things I did not like was upon checking in your charged an additional fee for the remainder of the days you stay for amenities!!!? Now I did not use any of the amenities and they were mandatory? I think it should be your choice but hey it is what it is!! Lastly, the golf course area could have been tidy up as there were napkins and other things on the ground due to patrons not using an actual trash!!!? There is parking which was good! This may not be a spot for everyone but if you’re looking for a great location next to the highway and off of Fremont St and affordability then this may be the place for you!Finally… while leaving.. this morning… there was a huge roach in our room! I’m not exactly sure where it came from as we spent 3 days here and saw nothing. So that may be something the owner may want to look into!

reviews.title: SOLID QUAINT BUDGET- FRIENDLY QUIET DOWNTOWN DIGS!
reviews.text: This place is a wonderfully quaint budget-friendly spot for quiet sleep after hot days and rumbling nights in sin city! The staff is exactly a friendly as they need to be and the AC works great! The mini golf course is such a fun kitchy retro vibe for the courtyard. Some folks were complaining about lack of blankets, but the light comforter between two sets of sheets were plenty for me as a hot sleeper from southern Wisconsin visiting the desert. The furniture is a little worn, but everything seems clean and the utilities work fine. HIGHLY RECOMMEND for the budget traveler visiting downtown Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Made us feel at home and happy 😃
reviews.text: The staff is amazing all of them. They were very helpful and kind all smiles. The beds are comfortable and they really made us feel at home as I brought my family here for a vacation. It was our first time and we’ll be staying here again next trip thank you guys so much for being so fantastic. The complimentary coffee was also very good 😊

reviews.title: Great place to stay near Freemont
reviews.text: Great service and chill spot. Close to Freemont which made finding food and entertainment easy. Would definitely stay here again when visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: I'm telling you.... THIS PLACE!!!
reviews.text: I've gone to the Downtowner Boutique hotel a few times and I've never had a bad experience. The staff from management to bartenders, have to become the top crew in Vegas in my eyes.  I have almost 40 years experience too. Danny, the  young man who checked me in, had some stories and had me laughing so hard I was crying. His relief, Shaq, had me laughing as well especially because he has a deadpan face and he's snarky and it's funny. The room is absolutely lovely comfortable bed,  clean sheets, wonderful towels, and the best water pressure ever!! And in Las Vegas that's a hard thing to find it's good water pressure!!! I have to admit, living in Las Vegas for the last 36 years, I've become very picky. Staying at the downtowner boutique hotel is one of the best experiences I've ever had and I highly highly recommend it

reviews.text: My daughter and I our enjoying our stay, it's peaceful and clean and the hospitality is good in my opinion. The price and location are affordable. This place came across my Google search and I believe I made the right decision to be here so I can be able to get to my dad's funeral. The polite and costumer service here has been better than the high end ones on the strip. No rudeness no even when I called. My first time here and won't be the last. It's the little things that helps people at time like this. Everything is going well.

The area is a little deserted, but nothing that will hinder the walk.

reviews.text: Great location with friendly staff minutes from Fremont Street. Spacious clean rooms. Even though the bar was 24 hours there was no noise. Mini golf in the courtyard was an added bonus.Free parking across the road. Would not hesitate to stay here again

reviews.text: Highly recommend this place! Needed to stay for EDC week and found this place. My grandparents recommended it on their last trip. Staff was great 24/7 support was amazing. Parking is across the street and close to Fremont. Totally recommend this place!

reviews.title: Overall Happy I Booked Here
reviews.text: Booked a room here because it was more affordable than other places. EDC week and it was also only about a 20 min ride to the speedway. They allowed us to check in early for a very small fee! They have parking across the building for free( they provide a parking pass). They have a mini golf course in the lobby. Didn’t actually play but it’s a cute touch. Staff onsite 24/7 we’re very nice and respectful. I will definitely be booking here again in the future! Also it’s 2-3 blocks away from Freemont Experience! Downtown LV has a much better vibe than the strip (in my opinion). But please check it out for yourselves(:

The rooms are always clean and stocked up. All the guests are always nice. We love The Downtowner and will definitely return again!

reviews.title: Excellent in every aspect!
reviews.text: Thank you for everything! This was my first time in Las Vegas but my husband hadn’t been in 30 years.  The staff all made the experience a 10, for sure! Your kindness was truly amazing. Every staff member was very helpful and so happy to be there.We were a 8-10 minute walk from Fremont Street Experience, The Mob Museum, the Deuce Bus stop, the Container Mall and restaurants.Regardless of the time early morning after midnight, and during the day we felt safe enough to walk. We are both in graduate school and the staff accompanied us to complete our coursework.The rooms are clean and ac works well. The beds are comfortable but you will need blankets.The showers are great after a long day of walking and sightseeing seeing. We don’t play golf but the indoor mini golf course was very cool!Will recommend the Downtowner everyone!

reviews.title: nice atmosphere
reviews.text: great laidback atmosphere, clean room, amazing staff and great drinks. we wanted something lowkey and that’s exactly what we got. the pool was also nice and extremely chill. it’s definitely worth the price if you’re wanting something on a budget and you aren’t going to vegas just for the strip

reviews.title: Laid back atmosphere.
reviews.text: Nice little hidden gem. Within walking distance to Fremont but far enough away from the noise. We rented 2 rooms and both were clean and tidy.

reviews.title: A good place to stay and relax while visiting Vegas
reviews.text: The staff in the day time and even the staff at 2am were super friendly and helpful. They were very personable and  answered all our questions. They made sure our stay was comfortable. The rooms were nice. Definitely not super fancy, but cute and most importantly…clean!  The pool was very relaxing too.

reviews.title: Friendly, Helpful, Communicative, Clean! Will definitely stay with the Downtowner again!
reviews.text: We were in town for the WrestleMania festivities and wanted a place close to Fremont and the Downtowner was a fantastic stay! The staff were on it and super friendly and helpful. The room was spacious and comfy as well. Great stay, we’ll be back! We didn’t make it to playing mini golf this time but absolutely will next time.

reviews.title: What an amazing staff.
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this place! Affordable, clean, fabulous location. Most importantly, the best staff ever. Dee and Leslie pride themselves on providing the best experience. Lobby bar with snacks. Morning coffee.  Downtowner is my go to Vegas hotel.

reviews.title: Clean and reasonable
reviews.text: The price was right, it was close to Fremont area. Very quiet. The AC works too well I actually got cold. Only down side was no microwave or small refrigerator in the room for longer stays. But the rooms were clean. The staff was friendly and helpful. We brought bikes for an event and we had no issues keeping them in our rooms. They have a cute small golf course as well. We’ll definitely be back next year

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: Loved our stay here.  Awesome staff; Leslie, Asia & Paul are helpful, friendly & fun!!  Make sure you have a Gin cocktail made by Leslie 😂Super close to great food & easy to drive or Lyft/Uner from here all over Vegas.  One minor note, not the fault of The Downtowner, but there is a bit of street noise at night(bring earplugs) but thankfully it was usually very short lived. We will stay here again!!Thanks so much to the Downtowner owners & staff.Kris & Karen

reviews.title: Friendly and helpful
reviews.text: We got there pretty late from San Diego the guy at the bar was really nice and helpful got us directions to our room. The lady that checked me out was also very friendly and nice this morning for our early check out for us heading back home to Oklahoma

reviews.title: A hidden gem in downtown 💎💎💎
reviews.text: I love this little hidden treasure!!! Not sure why haven't seen it before but so glad I found it. I will be making this my regular stay. Great staff, quiet, perfect location to Fremont Street, comfortable room and soft beds. You won't find a better deal without those HUGE resort fees.💕💕💕

reviews.title: 10/10 everytime
reviews.text: We stay here every time we come to Vegas - a gem that’s a 10 minute walk from Fremont. the rooms are always clean and the staff are all welcoming. We’ve stayed in the wyld rooms and fairway and each are immaculate. There’s also a bar at the front desk

reviews.title: Pleasant and convenient
reviews.text: The room is comfortable, beds/pillows comfy, shower hot with good water pressure.  They offer coffee and tea in the lobby in the mornings. Just a few blocks to walk to Fremont. RTC bus easy to get around. I was there for a conference at Westgate and it was easy to get there each morning. Would be nice if they had little refrigerator and microwave,  but I knew they didn't when I registered.Little golf course area is pleasant to hang out in.

reviews.title: I'd stay here again if I ever go back to Vegas
reviews.text: Super cute, clean, & affordable place to stay in Vegas :) The parking is included (parking lot across the street) and it's walking distance to restaurants and the Fremont St Experience if that's your thing. It has a very comfy bar & the grab and go snacks are so reasonably priced (especially for a hotel). Paul is awesome!

reviews.title: Don't pass-up on this Gem!
reviews.text: I am a local. The Downtowner is my favorite! Nothing fancy..but doesn't need to be...warm atmosphere, free mini golf, always clean; it's convenient to surrounding happenings, and free parking! Great staff and value. Don't pass up on this gem, especially if you are visiting for the Fremont Street Experience.

reviews.title: Great stay at Downtowner
reviews.text: Great rooms. Super friendly staff. Beds are comfortable.  Parking is easy. Fremont street experience is 2 blocks away. Super easy walk. Great food nearby.  I highly recommend the Downtowner if you want to stay in Vegas. Uber rides to the strip are only $15-$25.

reviews.title: Clean hot showers
reviews.text: Nice clean hotel in downtown Vegas. Make sure you book the Wylde rooms as they are the newest renovated! Sunday through Wednesday nights have the best rates, of course. The City parking lot across the street comes with your $20 resort fee that everyone charges. I’ve stayed here 3 times and it’s been consistently clean and very affordable. 3/19/25

reviews.title: Downtowner is the place to stay in DTLV
reviews.text: Very friendly staff!!!! Great spot, around the corner from downtown. Easy parking. I like how everything locks at midnight but someone is always at the front desk to assist with any needs. Very clean property, room was clean organized and cozy.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!!!
reviews.text: I love everything about this hotel. The staff, location, hospitality. The beds are super comfortable. You can't beat the price! Lesley, shak, and the rest of the front desk/bartenders are amazing. They always know how to make you feel at home! Love this place!

reviews.title: Simple Motel, Nice and Good Location
reviews.text: Simple, clean motel, good location(,is two blocks from Fremont street)It has free parking at 50 mt and its own pool across the street. Super friendly staff, always willing to help, especially Dee that I provide hot water for the matte. They have coffee at the reception until 11 am. The bedroom is small, has desk, little table, TV.The bed is comfortable, the sheets clean, the bathroom simple with toiletries.  Shower spectacular There is an iron, ironing board and hairdryer. There is icebox and you can look for ice from the machine We liked the quiet, the attention and the location, would come back.If you are looking for a place to sleep, simple and away from noise , I recommend it.

reviews.title: Classic property -  not overwhelming like casino hotels
reviews.text: Close proximity to downtown's attractions (walking distance); if you want to go to the Strip, public transportation is right there. Professional staff. 24-hour bar in lobby, reasonably priced drinks. Great value for the money.

reviews.title: General stay/quick visit
reviews.text: T the pillows were definitely great!  The black woman on the evening of the eighth was superior and helping me with parking.  It really means a lot to have a quick check in and a friendly welcome. It makes us feel like we belong. I think that’s the most important thing.  I will visit again in the future!

reviews.title: 3 B! Good Nice and Cheap
reviews.text: I must say that the best thing about this place is the location, steps from the freemont street we had a great time, if we had known before we would have stayed more days here. Good price of the cheapest ones I found, perfect to spend the night. the only but it is the self checkin process as I lost time because the machine did not work well and it took me longer than elsewhere to finish this process.

reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: The location is superb if you want to explore and experience downtown Vegas and enjoy all that Fremont has to offer. Lots of things to do around the area, great eateries and plenty of things to keep you immersed in the area. The room was great! Clean and well kept! Definitely would stay again when in the area. Awesome staff.

reviews.title: Meets your needs for a quick stay
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Accommodates your request. Spacious room. Not a luxury hotel but meets your basic needs

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Very decent for a budget friendly price. Good location and good customer service. Walking distance to Fremont and establishments. Place is safe and they have good parking space across the hotel. Will be back for sure when we visit Vegas again.

reviews.title: The downtowner hidden gem
reviews.text: The downtowner is a cozy, clean, and affordable hotel with a friendly staff who are always positive and upbeat. I’ve stayed there multiple times and prefer a hotel off the beaten path. The rooms are tidy and enough to get a good nights rest. The lobby is also a bar and after you check in, there is a mini golf area through the doors to get to your room. The property is a walking distance to Fremont street and neighboring hotels and casinos and restaurants. Take my word that it’s conveniently located if you plan to stay in downtown Las Vegas for a weekend.

reviews.title: Cool hotel close to Fremont
reviews.text: This place just has a nice feel to it, we felt instantly at home.It is cool but not pretentious, good value and the staff are all genuinely lovely.The pool area was a nice bonus, the bar is great value and welcoming.Good dining options nearby, safe free parking, and chill vibe.Loved it.

reviews.title: Loved the stay
reviews.text: Nice stay . Front desk very helpful and friendly . Would definitely return ! The area is close to Fremont where there is so much to do and so much to see ! Walking distance the perfect spot to enjoy Vegas , clean rooms and a nice shower head that we loved !

reviews.title: The Perfect Spot
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE it here! It’s in the perfect location, the staff is friendly. (I actually look forward to seeing a couple staff members because they make you feel welcome and at home). Cute little bar area, mini golf, and a fire pit make it even cooler to stay here.

reviews.title: Great location. Walking distance from Fremont Street.
reviews.text: Location is conveniently located close to Fremont street and other attraction. Family loved the mini-golf.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: First time staying here booked cause everywhere else was either sold out or over priced due to events in town on the strip. Hotel is in a great location Fremont Street a couple blocks away. The room has a unique vibe and comfortable feeling. The staff is great they're very welcoming and kind.

reviews.title: Walking distance from Fremont
reviews.text: I love how close to Fremont it is. And the parking included is another feature I like. They have a cute little mini golf in the middle. The staff here is also super sweet. They also have a cocktail bar where you check-in, so you can easily get something before going out into the downtown area.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: It's very clean and the staff is great I'm here now and I love it no drama close to everything the price is great housekeepers are on time they keep up with they job and the staff makes the best coffee and I love being in a quiet room where it's no problems

reviews.title: Modern and quiet
reviews.text: The.room is not very spacious but it is clean, quiet and the beds are very comfortable. There is no breakfast but you are invited to a coffee that comes very well in the mornings

reviews.title: Christmas Vegas
reviews.text: Downtowner Boutique stay for us was amazing. From the great customer services, to being able to check in early was excellent. It’s literally from walking distance from Fremont Street which is super cool. Our room was on point on everything we needed, totally relaxed and got to sleep in. The best part is the parking as the bar in the reception are as well. Will definitely be returning for our next Vegas trip. Thank You!

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
reviews.text: The room was nice and service was great. My only draw back was the smell my room had that wasn't so clean. It had an odor like someone left spoiled food in the room.

reviews.title: Great price and close to all the cool things!
reviews.text: Our check-in was seamless and the staff at any hour was amazing. We hung out with Frankie cause we got in so late and he was great! The others were so helpful when we inquired about things. Accommodations were as pictured and we loved the atmosphere!

reviews.title: Staying Downtowner
reviews.text: The Downtowner is just beyond the end of the beaten path of Fremont Street in Las Vegas. Smaller, it is retro hotel 🏨 style while being affordable and comfortable. Rooms are sparse without a microwave or fridge or coffee maker but are well maintained and have a large shower.Staying in December didn't allow for comfortable playing of mini golf but location and price made up for the weather.

reviews.title: NFR EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Very nice property and amazingly clean rooms. Love the shower!!! Only thing I needed was a fan and I bought one at Walmart. Walking distance to downtown. $8.00 24 hour bus takes you everywhere. I would definitely recommend this property during your stay.

reviews.title: The Downtowner is Awesome!
reviews.text: The Downtowner is definitely a hidden gym! Very affordable and conveniently located, and the parking is free too! The staff is also amazing. I would definitely recommend and would stay again. This time while I was in town, I was able to spend more money on activities than on hotel/resort fees. And I still came back to a comfy room at the end of the night, both nights that I stayed.

reviews.title: Downtown Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: Staff were so friendly and location is absolutely great. Would definitely stay here again.Great food places to eat too nearby.Check out the Parlour , unbelievable breakfast. The hotel has comfy beds snd and a mini golf. There is a pool across the street for the hotel, we didn’t use as it was November. Great stay

reviews.title: Very friendly staff
reviews.text: This is a small motel  that is a short walk from Fremont experience! reviews.title: The Downtowner is anything but down.

reviews.title: Once a fun concept hotel; now a glorified, well worn hostel for the young or young at heart
reviews.text: Las Vegas is a lot more expensive than what I remember, but it's been a long time. I was searching for a reasonably priced, quick stopover before and after a weeklong camping trip at Red Rocks. Nothing, absolutely nothing was available for under $200/night. Even Days Inn and the like were almost $300/night. This was the closest place to my budget and looked interesting from the photos. Upon arrival, I found "reception" was a bar, bartender, and two kiosks. The arrival process was explained in a gruff way by the bartender. Definitely not intuitive or friendly. Parking was included but was in a public lot across the street. The hotel was attractive to me via their website because of price. An unexpected bonus was on the fringe of the hip Vegas alternative destination called The Fremont Experience. However, the neighborhood was sketchy with lots of low budget apartments, sidewalk sleepers, a major highway, and several vacant lots. The hotel was really a motel-like complex made up of several walled off (to the street) buildings. The walk to my room was through the open air, putt putt gathering space which probably looked hip at one time long ago. In my building, I walked up the stairs and down the hall- floors covered with un-vacuumed, fake grass (cute)- to my 10x10, queen bed cube with small but adequate bathroom/shower. Walls were bright hospital white with some trim in lime green. Sheets were clean as were the floors. Sadly, the window unit AC/fan was well past its useful life. It ran, cooled a bit, but the continuous fan settings were non-functional. All in all, the place was a glorified, over hyped "youth hostel" type accommodation. Probably good for the young or young at heart wanting to be near the alternative Fremont Street action.

reviews.title: Nice clean rooms and a cool vibe. Reasonable rates, as well.
reviews.text: The rooms are nice and clean and the staff are great. They've got a cool lobby with a bar and it's open 24 hours. They sell an assortment of drinks and snacks and the prices are crazy reasonable. Free coffee in the morning and a cool vibe throughout the day... what's not to like? I'll definitely stay at The Downtowner again. I definitely recommend this cool little hotel.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great experience and customer service with this hostel, very comfortable beds and clean rooms. All services excellent. Visited with friends and had a great place to rest here. Would definitely recommend to others and would visit again soon.

reviews.title: Close to Fremont street
reviews.text: The Downtowner Boutique is walking distance to Fremont Street just a block away. The resort fee is only $20 per day and includes free parking which is really good for Las Vegas. The only issue I had was they are temperature controlled and our room got pretty hot at night but I guess some people like it hot, I sleep better when it’s cold. The staff made up for it though they were all very pleasant and helpful! I will stay there again in my next visit!

reviews.title: Great place in the new east freemont district
reviews.text: The location was great .lots of new bars and restaurants it was close to the container and a short walk to all the cool places on freemont. The staff was very friendly and the lobby bar where you check in rocks It.

reviews.title: Bad experience horrible
reviews.text: Very bad experience as that was my chance to spend a single night but what a night it was.First staff wasn't friendly or helpful at all they treat you like you know what to do, system there for check in I don't get it first I have to go to the bar tender which he is the reception to check my ID then send me to a computer to do the check in by my self and back to him so he give me keys, I believe that processing is easy for them to do their jobs I don't get it why we do it in the end we ask them for keys, my advice never ever take a room on the main street believe me it hell, all night people fighting on the street  and all noise you can  hear it, after that your next room Neighbour start fights also you can hear them, one more bad thing room got air-conditioning but it filp to be heater when I ask hotel staff they said we canot do anything so imagine fight on street with heat air condition what's results going to be!!, reception staff always laughing with their friends when you ask them for anything they gives you feeling like you bothering us!If you have any other options take it but don't stay here.

reviews.title: Gem in the rough
reviews.text: Found a cute little retro deco hotel right at the end of Fremont. The staff was super friendly, and the check-in was easier than I’ve ever had before. We wanted a place that didn’t have the slot machines in this was it. Just a nice place to sleep, and felt very safe while I was there did not bother me to walk outside by myself without a compliment of somebody else.

reviews.title: Just Wundyful!
reviews.text: Stayed in the newly remodeled rooms, The Wylde.  It was very comfortable.   The bed was extremely comfy, the towels were fluffy and had the BEST water pressure!  Let me also say, Tamara and Leslie day shift ladies and Shaq the overnight gentleman, were Incredible!!!  Funny, personable and remembered my name.  I was very impressed overall and will definitely stay again.  Thank you so much!!!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This was our first time in Vegas and the staff made sure we felt right at home. They were so nice and so much fun to talk to!! We had an excellent time I can see us coming back and staying here again.

reviews.title: Such a great location!
reviews.text: I'm a mural photographer so this location was ideal, as there are murals everywhere! It's also less than 2 blocks from the Container Park, which is a great place to hang out. I highly recommend Bangkok Street Thai Kitchen, which is across from the Container Park.The staff was friendly and went out of their way to assist. This is important for me given that I'm hearing impaired. I received immediate text messages to answer all my questions.In the center of the complex, there is a fire pit, a seating area, and a mini-golf. It's also safe because it's completely enclosed with the only entrance being the bar/check-in area. I also love that the property is smoke-free! I will stay here again!

reviews.title: Good place to stay, decent price
reviews.text: When we arrived the area was buzzing with activities and loud music. We were afraid it would be too loud for our kids but the room was kept the noise away. The staff is friendly and the stay was enjoyable. Parking was a bit inconvenient on the weekend because it would fill up quickly but that’s a minor issue

reviews.title: Good location great staff
reviews.text: Great location, 24 hour bar and mini golf. Front desk was extremely helpful with everything and great drinks! Front area has nice little selection of drinks and snacks for decent prices. Coffee in morning with creamer was nice. Overall great stay for price.

reviews.title: Charming Downtown Gem
reviews.text: Renovated and modernized yet properly preserved to show off the original design. This art deco gem lends itself to the walkable arts district of downtown Las Vegas including Fremont street. I almost hate to leave a grey review because places like this are hard to find.

reviews.title: Love, love, love the Downtowner and its amazing staff!
reviews.text: I’m so happy I chose to stay at the Downtowner over the strip. I did based on reviews and pricing and I can see why the reviews were so high! This is the cleanest hotel I’ve ever stayed in and definitely the most comfortable bed. It’s retro and cute and in the Arts District right near the Fremont Street Experience. So far my favorite part has been the staff. Everyone has been friendly and helpful and very attentive. I arrived alone ahead of my friend and I felt safe and comfortable. The mini golf, fire pit, and murals are extras that make this stay so much fun for the price. Don’t pass up this renovated boutique motel if you’re considering staying here. It’s a gem ✨

reviews.title: Comfortable Stay for sure
reviews.text: Great room. Very comfortable. They had a really cool golf course in the court yard too. Reminds me of what old las Vegas was. There was coffee in the lobby in the morning. Andy deposit returned immediately. I recommend if some one is looking for an affordable stay with good accomodations.

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel!
reviews.text: The Downtowner Boutique Hotel offers convenience, clean rooms, great location, affordable rates, great amenities, courteous staff and cool mid-century decor in Las Vegas. Highly recommended for your next business trip, weekend getaway or any other reason you’d be traveling to Vegas Baby! A++

reviews.title: Valentine Day Room
reviews.text: So warm and comfortable, the staff are wonderful and really try to help you out if you’re in a rut such as the wrong name is in the booking. I love this hotel! Clean and perfect size for a couple. The camaraderie is also special here. I’m not a sports fan but there’s no where else I would rather watch the game!

reviews.title: Downtowner Boutique Hotel.
reviews.text: We had a great stay here! Staff was very friendly and attentive to guests. This hotel is in a great location with easy access to Fremont Street. Tons of restrooms and entertainment near by. We loved being able to play free mini golf at the hotel! Room was comfortable and well kept.

reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: The staff are wonderful! The mini golfing is a cute little course with about 6 holes. The golf putters and balls were provided for us. I had expected to pay for the putters so it was a nice surprise. The morning coffee/tea,  also on-the-house, came with a wide variety of creams and sugars. You get more than you'd expect for the price of the room.

reviews.title: Walk This Way!
reviews.text: The location of this property is just a half block from the back side of Fremont Street! I loved the idea and ability to stumble or walk back to my room and be in a secure spot.where I could regroup and begin again.😁 The hotels staff were very friendly, welcoming, and attentive. Really appreciated the value of their personal service.

reviews.title: Very Satisfied Repeat Customer/Guest
reviews.text: The room rates are great, the check-in/out process was quick and easy, the rooms were clean, the beds were comfortable, the staff was friendly and professional, the hotel accommodations were satisfactory, and the location was excellent!

reviews.title: Affordable and Comfy Weekend Stay
reviews.text: This is a good and affordable place to stay for a weekend. The Downtowner staff are friendly, communicative, and hospitable. A text message option is available to reach staff at any time, which was super helpful. I was able to check-in early at a low cost. I paid for the upgrade to The Wylde, which promised an upgraded bathroom. It appeared to be a basic bathroom (toilet, mirror and small sink, and shower with no bath). Everything in the room and bathroom was clean and in good working order though. The WiFi, TV, and air conditioner in the room also worked well. The Wylde does provide an additional security measure as a keycard is needed to enter that part of the hotel. As promised on its website, there is complimentary parking available across from the hotel. While the hotel is located in an older part of downtown Vegas, it is very close to Fremont Street and not far from the Strip. There appeared to be at least two security issues with police and/or security staff having to get involved. I never felt in immediate danger, but it was concerning to see. Hotel staff seemed to respond quickly and effectively in these situations.Overall, it was a really convenient and comfortable weekend stay. If you want to visit Vegas on a budget, I recommend staying here!

reviews.title: The Downtowner provides a very pleasant and relaxing stay in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: The staff was pleasant and so nice. Very welcoming and loved the coffee service every morning. My girlfriend wanted more sheets for the bed and doubled up on the towels and the staff at the front desk was very accommodating. I will stay here again next time I'm in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Cuter & cleaner than expected.
reviews.text: The room was clean. The bed was comfy towels fluffy nice pillows. Fun golfing. The building felt secure. You can hear street noise but that’s the same as other Fremont motels. Close to everything on Fremont. The room was hot but the windows open. They have free coffee in the morning. Staff was very nice.

reviews.title: amazing little hidden gem!!
reviews.text: such a cute place and the staff were all so welcoming and kind! we came to vegas for our honeymoon and our experience at the downtown couldn’t have been better. we can’t wait to come back again and stay!

reviews.title: Awesome for the price, good location, & amazing staff members!! 😊
reviews.text: Upon arrival, I was greeted kindly! I was an hour early, but they let me go ahead and park there. When I checked in, the room was way bigger than I thought! Super tidy and pretty cool, too. I decided to ask if I could have a room with a window unit AC (personal preference), and they were so accommodating, no problem!! Staff is 10/10 awesome here

reviews.title: Loved our stay!
reviews.text: The service is great, and the room was extremely cozy and nice! It was extremely clean, the bed was super comfortable. Great pillows. Liked the grassy wall and retro vibe. The common area with the mini golf course and fire place is very cool! We loved our stay!

reviews.title: Love the vibe
reviews.text: Cute 50's style rooms.  Great price and right off Fremont. Free parking and mini golf. I only stayed one night,  but the location was great for walking to Fremont and to tons of great restaurants and bars and people watching.

reviews.title: Close to Freemont st and free parking. Lovely staff.
reviews.text: Not a bad stay for our two night stay in Las Vegas. It is downtown Las Vegas so you are away form the strip which wasn't a bad thing for us. It is two blocks from the Freemont Experience which was pretty cool. Lots of restaurants, casinos and a grocery shop as well. Hotel itself was okay, there was no fridge which I thought was strange. They do have an ice machine so that was fine for drinks. Difficult to keep some food cold though if you had food. Breakfast was a pretty basic affair and was just coffee. Staff were very very nice though and really made our stay. They also provide free car parking which was very handy fo us.

reviews.title: Clean safe no frills hotel at a reasonable price.
reviews.text: Clean safe no frills hotel at a reasonable price.  Dee and the rest of the staff are courteous and helpful, and the price is one of the lowest in the area.  Even with such a reasonable price, the hotel is well secured and safe.

reviews.title: Cute aesthetic! Book now!
reviews.text: Loved this hotel very clean and quiet. Check in was a breeze. I enjoyed the golfing in the middle of the hotel! The room was nice and cozy, the bed was very comfortable. Very close to the Fremont street experience. Overall a great experience.😚 🤌🏽

reviews.title: Location to Fremont Experience
reviews.text: Close to Experience. Friendly staff.  Location with safety paramount.  This was a 2 night interim from Nugget to Holiday Inn Resort.  A corner away from Container   Park & El Cortez. We’d stay again.  Any small bar with rye whiskey?  I’ll take.

reviews.title: Best place to stay around Fremont
reviews.text: Been here about 4 times every time I come to visit Las Vegas .Friendly service .Definitely recommend this for anyone coming out to visit . The rooms are clean and they vintage.The mini golfing is pretty dope also.

reviews.title: Cool place off of the strip
reviews.text: Having never been to Vegas before, I was unsure what to expect.  We stayed on the strip a few nights, but then wanted to stay near Downtown Vegas our last night and the prices for The Downtowner couldn't be beat!They were very accommodating when we arrived early and let us check I'm anyway! The process of check in on their self serve computer was a bit tedious, but they were right there to help when we got stuck. The room was clean and perfectly fine for a good night's rest. It was too cold to enjoy the outdoor golf area but it looked like it would be pretty cool! There was nothing flashy or fancy, which was fine by us, but I was just grateful for a reasonably priced, clean, safe place to stay. The staff was super sweet and not only let us have a late checkout,  but even held our bags all day so we could explore Downtown a bit more!Overall,  I would absolutely stay there again when returning to Vegas if I want to hang Downtown!

reviews.title: Relieved ….going to be ok
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and helpfull ! Rooms are very reasonable !! Parking was easy .close to Fremont street experiance  ..if your on a budget perfect place to stay 8)  I felt safe and it was reasonably quiet !!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Great hotel and within walking distance of Fremont and it has a 24/7 bar doesn't get much better than that!  Rooms were clean and comfortable, staff were very friendly. A wonderful cup of coffee in the morning.

reviews.title: Attentive Staff
reviews.text: Had a small hiccup with the room but staff was attentive and offered another room. All of the staff was very nice. Overall room was clean. Fire pit and min golf provided a very comfort vibe to the downtowner. Recommend and will stay again. Plus fee parking included on stay.  Walking distance from the fremont street experience

reviews.title: Two days in Vegas.
reviews.text: Frankie and Dee are the absolute best host you could ask for. The suggestions they gave us were perfect for the area. They are the most friendly host I’ve ever met, right from the start they were giving my friends and I the best dinner recommendations and also coffee/breakfast I strongly recommend them for you’re stay.

reviews.title: Very affordable base to explore Downtown La Vegas!
reviews.text: VERY affordable and clean option to explore Downtown Las Vegas and the off-beat cultural offerings nearby.  Walking distance to Fremont Street, The Neon Museum, Container Park Plaza, Ferguson's, to a ton of restaurants, casinos and nightlife.  It's a very basic room, but you're not in Vegas to hangout at your hotel/motel.  The staff was wonderful.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Room with 2 large beds, the 4 members of the family slept very comfortably, 2 adults, 1 teenager and 1 child, near Freemont Street, very quiet place, we came during the week.

reviews.title: Great Night in Vegas
reviews.text: Super cool find downtown.  Staff is awesome, especially Frankie, mini golf is superb and challenging, and can't beat the clean room and $4 PBR on draft.   Will be back to this spot as often as I can!!

reviews.title: I discovered an Impressive Hidden Gem in Vegas
reviews.text: The Downtowner is hidden gem. A friend invited me for a staycation, I’ve never heard of the place and honestly walked up thinking okkkkk. All that question and worry went away as soon as I walked thru the doors. The front desk is also a 24/7 full service bar. Super kool decor and although I wasn’t looking for a drink at the moment it was nice to feel a vibe when walking in not just a boring desk. Frankie checked us in and the process was simple and his customer service is superior. I was also really impressed with the room. It’s very spacious and simple. The feng shui is super felt and the bed is super comfy as well as the pillows! The water is hot and the rain head spacious shower is nice. I would also like to compliment the cleaning staff, the room is definitely clean and up to par, which is hard to find in Vegas!!! They also offer free good coffee with multiple selection of creamer. So if your anything like me you’ll appreciate getting a good fresh hot cup of joe in the morning without leaving the hotel. The front desk staff was very accommodating. Dee and Shak are very friendly and helpful. I also was able to purchase hygiene supplies I forgot and most hotels don’t offer that or charge an arm and a leg in the vending machine. Oh wait how could I forget one of the Coolest parts of this place? There’s a putt putt mini golf course. Yes! Seriously!!! This place just reminds me of old style Vegas. I recommend staying here. Thanks staff! It makes a Big difference when you offer cleanliness, superior guest service, quite environment and a hotel with a lot of swag! 👍🏽🙌🏽🏩☕️🧹🫧☀️😊🛌💤🎊

reviews.title: Definitely staying here again
reviews.text: The staff and hotel was amazing.  They made me feel so welcomed. I am definitely going to stay here again when I come back to vegas. My room was clean to my liking with a nice size bed. Very strong water pressure. Also plenty of food in the immediate area to choose from

reviews.title: Excellent and quiet
reviews.text: I come here every month and it's always nice and peaceful... They have a golf coarse and the beds are very comfortable...  There is a store close by for needs and the Freemont Experience is close by...

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Great staff and very friendly! Great place! Definitely recommend it to anyone! If you’re looking for something that is a unique place to stay this is it! Free parking and a pool. Don’t forget putt putt golf!

reviews.title: Great place to stay near Fremont Street!
reviews.text: Great place to stay, super close to Fremont street.  Parking is nearby across the street and price point is good. Leslie who works here is fantastic and had great ideas of things to check out and can make great drinks ❤️

reviews.title: Great Vegas experience
reviews.text: Great spot, good vibes, and it has a miniature golf course. Top shelf ham sandwiches too. Neat little bar in the lobby. Good view of the mountains off in the distance. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Fremont is the place to be!
reviews.text: Easy check-in and Dee was fabulous! Clean, cozy, comfortable room and the air was super cold! Fun music playing and free coffee until 11:00am. Didn't check out the pool or fitness center, but the walk to the fun stuff in Fremont was quick. Would stay again!

reviews.title: Awsome times
reviews.text: Had a great time staying here great parking close to Fremont street and binions casino very well postponed area too they have an awesome put put if u stay here there's a pool across the street by the parking lot

reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: This is an absolutely incredible place to stay! Especially if you’re on a budget. A big shout out to all the staff members who made our trip so special! Dee, Leslie, Shaq, Demetia, Tamra, Stan, Brian, Armando and  Nadine. Apologies if I am forgetting anyone! The rooms were clean… The bar that was open 24 hours a day. The pool was clean, and fun! A quiet Place, but filled with so much personality! Very close to everything! Fremont Street is only two or three blocks away. We also met a lot of new people that were also traveling. The Eureka restaurant close by was also incredible. Also very friendly staff. Great prices and excellent food. We would definitely visit the Downtowner boutique hotel again!

reviews.title: Cutest affordable hotel on Fremont street!
reviews.text: I booked this last minute as I had an 11 hour layover in vegas! I checked in just for the day. I’m a women and I was by myself, and the staff treated me amazing and made me feel beyond safe! They were so kind and made sure I was taken care of! The rooms were very clean and had cute decor inside! They played music, have mini golf, a 24/7 bar, and a cute pool! I can’t thank the staff enough for all they did for me and I would totally stay here again and recommend this place to others!

reviews.title: Good service and excellent location.
reviews.text: I’m still having the best experience in Las Vegas with my friends, the location and the service is outstanding. The bar is open 24 hours and the bartender Asia is awesome. We had fun playing mini golf this morning and the swimming pool is amazing.

reviews.title: Bar open 24/7
reviews.text: We really have fun playing golfito while we're waiting for the others to be ready. One thing we missed in the room was a little cooler but they have a solution for that: They have open bar 24 hours!!!

reviews.title: Week stay
reviews.text: Pretty good overall, rooms were clean and spacious, amenities are cool to kill time between plans, only couple bloks away from freedom center,  the staff is super nice and helpful. Will be back and recommend it

reviews.title: Best bang for your buck on Fremont
reviews.text: The best place to stay in Vegas on a budget!! Check in was a breeze and Dee at the front desk was so friendly . Supreme location along the legendary Fremont. We will definitely be staying here from here on out when visiting Vegas.

reviews.title: The Downtowner Deets....
reviews.text: Check in process could be less back and fourth. Super cute environment, close to Fremont st. and many other locations within walking distance. The 24hr bar and snack on site was a plus. Super convenient parking, and it's complimentary!

reviews.title: Clean and quiet, wonderful management
reviews.text: At The Downtowner I found a clean and quiet room at a great price, which I needed on short notice. This is a quieter section of LV, away from the strip. The manager or desk person was very helpful and very kind.

reviews.title: Cute and clean room in dynamite location
reviews.text: I was in town for a long weekend at an event downtown and wanted to stay close by.  The Downtowner was a better deal than the casino hotels by far. My room was very clean and spacious, the staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and the location is ideal.  They also have a full bar in the lobby if you want to pregame!You are a couple blocks from everything the Fremont area has to offer.  I would definitely stay again next time I am in town.

reviews.title: Great considering the price
reviews.text: The Downtowner hotel is a great place to stay if your priority is the most affordable room. The room itself was very nice. Included an iron an, ironing board, and hair dryer, which I was surprised by. When I arrived the room smelled freshly cleaned. The service was fine, especially considering that one person runs the check in area and the bar at the same time. Be advised, it is a two-story building and there is no elevator. You would probably need to request a downstairs room if you have mobility issues. I would rate the hotel value as high, especially considering how inexpensive the rooms are.

reviews.title: I was energized to be a part of the Fremont experience and could always return to sleep and focus at the Downtowner.
reviews.text: I was energized to be a part of the Fremont experience and could always return to sleep and focus at the Downtowner.

reviews.title: An oasis of relaxation in Vegas
reviews.text: This place checks all the boxes for me, quiet, comfortable, and cool (both decor and temperature). This is a great place to stay close to the action of downtown, but you don’t have the noise and crowds as soon as you open the door to your room. Stayed here throughout the week during a business conference, and it was a great respite from tiring days of business. Not to mention you can have a beer and play putt putt.

reviews.title: Friendly, helpful and inviting staff !
reviews.text: Location was near the Fremont experience. Which is something to see, I’m guessing less than 5 blocks. Very retro setting ! Has a cute put put course in the court yard.Now if you want to be near the strip it’s closer to 5 miles away.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: I have stayed in this Hotel a coue time and everytime I stay it is so quiet and clean and the front desk people are very kind and treat you so nice and friendly I would recommend you stay here and very affordable

reviews.title: Clean and tidy & Friendly staff.
reviews.text: Staff were excellent, had several storms that blacked out the area but staff were great in helping us deal with it, hotel is in great location and is clean and tidy. Comfy bed, great place to stay near Fremont street.

reviews.title: I love to stay here when I visit downtown Vegas!
reviews.text: I love the staff here! They’re so funny and welcoming you instantly feel comfortable! Thank you guys. My second stay there and it’s not my last! :) it’s very close to coffee, restaurants and bars you can walk to all the areas from this location! I recommend the restaurant (EATS) down the street excellent food and wonderful staff! .. Just love downtown Vegas!!

reviews.title: Great location, great price, nice people
reviews.text: Had to find a not too expensive place in Vegas due to a death in the family, and the Downtowner fit the bill.Nice clean rooms a few blocks from the Fremont Street area, which was a bonus. No fridge or microwave so may not be the best option for families with children, but plenty of dining options nearby and the 24 hour bar in the lobby came in handy. Very nice and helpful people. Would definitely stay again

reviews.title: Great location and staff!
reviews.text: Such a cute Lil property and I loved the putt putt course and the staff was amazing! Dee is a rock star!!!! There is great inexpensive food near by and a Lil mini mart with everything you may need. 12/10 would visit again!

reviews.title: Great.  Comfortable.
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with great location in downtown Las Vegas close to everything needed.  The front desk staff was more then helpful with any question I had.  I will definitely recommend to any visiting and stay again!

reviews.title: Staff amazing room very clean
reviews.text: Everything and everyone was perfect. Thank you. Staff and bar was very nice. Room was clean, only thing wish there was a full mirror. Putting greens where fun and the flamingos super cute. Thank you for making our trip more fun.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I went for my daughter's baby shower and this was me and my husband first time here we loved it the customer service is 💯 we really enjoyed are self I recommend this place you would really like the stay and people

reviews.title: Adversary
reviews.text: I choose the Downtowner as my apartment was undergoing upgrades to the second story floors. I checked in and immediately felt as if I was on trial. The woman at the desk was unprofessional, crass and had the body language to match. She didn't address me as a customer. I was an adversary. The room was decent and night and day difference from my previous experience years ago. The downside was the reception on the TV. It was akin to watching through a screen door.

reviews.title: Affordable and clean for the price.
reviews.text: This is close to the downtown scene at an affordable rate. Quiet and usually available during the week. (In the summer time it's best to book ahead with them directly) I found that there web prices don't have any hidden fees. Nice pool area, never crowded.

reviews.title: First time staying in a hotel
reviews.text: First time hubby and I stayed in a hotel and we were a little sketchy about the area but the hotel overall is great! The room is super cool, feels so good to walk into a nice cold room. The ladies in the main entrance are super nice and welcoming. Best stay overall :)

reviews.title: Downtowner is Most definitely worth the value
reviews.text: The Hotel is located in a great location close to all the Fremont Fun! The rooms were perfect for a Solo or Couples.Nice and clean. Loved the pool and mini golf course too for added fun! All the Staff members were so friendly and welcoming!

reviews.title: I love it, excellent quiet place and very comfortable
reviews.text: I love it, excellent quiet place and very comfortable On my next visit I will have them as the number 1 option of my favorites Without a doubt, the Las Vegas experience is incredible but super tired and having a very good place to rest is the best

reviews.title: downtown heat
reviews.text: If you’re on a budget and need something downtown that has a chill vibe and friendly atmosphere then this is the place to cool off and relax. Nice but small pool, clean premises and very friendly staff. Parking is a breeze and you’re gonna be away from all the hustle and bustle of Fremont Street but not too far. It’s just a short walk to all the excitement.

reviews.title: Awesome boutique hotel near Fremont
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this boutique hotel, fun stuff to do , great location and super nice staff! Vlad checked me in and he was especially friendly.  He really represents the Downtown er really well!  The bed was really comfortable. The mid century vibe is the best.

reviews.title: BEDBUGS
reviews.text: BEDBUGS! BEDBUGS!! BEDBUGS!!!We spent 3 nights at the Downtowner. Friday night to Monday am.Sunday night I noticed a couple of red bite marks, nothing concerning. Monday afternoon I noticed over 10 clusters of 3 red inflamed bites. Typical signs of bedbugs. The minor sightings of dead and alive cockraoches were of little concern until the confirmation of bedbugs. I have contacted the hotel to discuss the situation but have gotten no response. If you stay here BE AWARE!! I really wanted to like the place. We enjoyed their bar, golf was hilarious, and staff was great.

reviews.title: Good motel
reviews.text: Great service. Dee made the visit impeccable. Recommend for a nichie off the strip experience. Very dive. Very fun. The price is great and it’s right next to Fremont and Pizza Rock. Will visit again.

reviews.title: Great atmosphere!!
reviews.text: The Staff are Honest and Helpful and Direct. Rooms are awesome. The parking is secure. They have a fitness room. Private pool, private Bar and putting green. Will definitely be back next time I'm on a project downtown.  El Raulito.

reviews.title: Car breaks down. 1.5months here  I'm surviving  Los Vegas.
reviews.text: CLEAN   PLEASANT  FRIENDLY. HELPFUL. IVE BEEN IN 4 HOTELS AND THIS BY FAR HAS BEEN GREAT. CLOSE TO THE FREEMONT LIGHT SHOW PLUS MANY OTHER THINGSAND BEST PRICING.  THOUGH WATCH FRI / SAT NIGHTS. MORE EXPENSIVE

reviews.title: This is a Dump
reviews.text: Don’t stay at this Dump. There are no phones available in rooms. I was charged $65.90 extra for nothing and charged another $113.00 again for nothing. No free bike rental, everything is a lie. Don’t waste your time and money with this dump. You have been warned. Stay away..

reviews.title: Great location boutique hotel.
reviews.text: This was the perfect location for me. It’s a block and a half away from the Punk Rock Bowling Festival just a few more to Fremont. I was a little concerned it would be crazy with the festival going on but it’s been relatively quite. If I open my window I can perfectly hear the after festival club show next door but with the window closed and AC on it barely noticeable.

reviews.title: Awesome place!
reviews.text: The staff is awesome, very friendly, this has become my go to hotel when I visit Las Vegas. It's also, walking distance from Fremont.  Rooms are always clean! Rooms are spacious and love the color scheme and decor.

reviews.title: highly recommend
reviews.text: newly renovated good price nice staff. The price was also very fair. They even offer self check in. The best part was that the front desk was also a bar. They had the ac on full blast it was a very chill environment.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: You know what, I am pleasantly surprised by this downtown budget-friendly hotel on Fremont. Staff is professional and courteous and goes out of their way to ensure my stay is a good experience. I love the responsiveness of the text system that allows me to ask questions or get assistance from my own phone without having to call or go to the front desk in person. Parking is convenient and the room and common areas are super clean! Hallway door are locked and cannot be accessed from the street, adding a measure of safety to my stay. I’ll be back and certainly host friends and family here as needed. Thank you, Downtowner!

reviews.title: Very good for the money!
reviews.text: The staff is friendly the rooms are comfortable are clean. The hotel has been remodeled so it's not a brand new hotel but you could say that this hotel is worth the money and the location is perfect. I definitely will come back.

reviews.title: Overall positive
reviews.text: Had an issue with AC, they moved us into another room that worked immediately. My only complaints would be no Microwave/fridge in the room and they refused to take my Chime card even though I paid for the room with it. It was resolved however, so I’ll leave that one alone. Otherwise conveniently located, friendly staff, no amenities fee. Happy customer.

reviews.title: Vegas Getaway
reviews.text: We were looking for something affordable since we were in town for a music festival. This place had a friendly staff and cold ac with nice shower. Your within walking distance of Fremont s, enjoy the music and drinks and walk back.

reviews.title: Celebrating my birthday/anniversary
reviews.text: This is a very cool place to stay. We really enjoyed the vintage look the hotel has. Fremont strip was just a stroll down the block. They had a great selection of music that would play throughout the property. The fireplace complimented the cool nights just PERFECTLY. We will book again.

reviews.title: Lies.  Charged more than advertised
reviews.text: This place does not honor any online deals. They will show it on the bill, like in the picture I have provided, as a credit, and then later they will charge you that anyways.  Do not stay here. They will just rip you off.   That $56 credit was charged to my card after booking in almost a day later.

reviews.title: Skincrawling
reviews.text: Oy! Where to start. We were totally fooled by the website and the surprisingly decent Google reviews. The bar/lobby seemed cool and presentable, like other boutique properties, but once we made it to the room the fun stopped there. A thick smell of stale cigarette smoke; gouged, burnt, and damaged furniture; and stained floors and walls awaited. We might have just sucked it up and stayed (embracing the flop house experience), but the walls were paper-thin and it sounded like every drunk passing by on the sidewalk was in bed with us. We'd checked in after 1am, but hightailed it to a chain hotel across town and immediately took a shower.

reviews.title: Senior trip vacation
reviews.text: The hotel was nicely located close to Fremont street and a short distance to many national and state parks. It has a cute mini golf and sitting area, nice pool and affordable for the price. We would love having a mini fridge and microwave in the rooms.

reviews.title: Great for the price and location!
reviews.text: This place is a great place if you love downtown!! The staff was great the courtyard is beautiful and if you're a non smoker this is the best place downtown! I will be recommending this place to friends and family for sure!

reviews.title: Golf and stuff
reviews.text: Found this place for a last minute trip to Las Vegas and the price was hard to pass up. The motel was nice and enjoyed the miniature golf putting green opposite of lobby. Would stay here again to utilize that amenity one time. Did not enjoy the undisclosed security deposit on a paid in full reservation, but rolled with it for the sake of my trip. Overall, I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I stayed 3 nights and I give them a 5 star ⭐ rating and good customer service and great rooms and very easy to get to and very clean rooms. Plus the bar also have cheap liquor prices. Very nice amenities and good workers.

reviews.title: Retro throwback heaven
reviews.text: Clean quaint great friendly service and amazing walk ability to great local attractions. Lobby is a bar great place to meet and mingle. Makes the city feel a little less lonely. Dee makes the best Bloody Mary in Vegas. Bar open 24 hrs.

reviews.title: Hidden gem located in downtown Las Vegas.
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised at what you get for such a reasonable price. Room was clean, and cozy with comfortable bedding, nice thick towels and complementary toiletries. The location is centrally located in the center of old downtown Las Vegas night life district for those who want a nostalgic Vegas experience without strip prices. Will definitely recommend and will be staying again!!!

reviews.title: Best kept secret in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The place, hosts and bar were exceptional!  Beds comfortable!Employee extremely helpful. The atrium area was perfect for our family to gather and visit.  Even though it was a little chilly we warmed up by their outdoor fire.

reviews.title: Not Very Clean
reviews.text: In short, the reviews and photos I saw online before booking The Downtowner did not accurately represent what we experienced during our stay. While the customer service was excellent, the room was not up to par. When we walked in the room after checking in, the first thing we noticed was that the floor was not clean, which is kind of a big deal when you're living somewhere for a few days — I did not feel comfortable walking barefoot in the room. The surfaces of the nightstand and the table underneath the TV also did not look like they were recently cleaned. On the other hand, the bathroom sink, toilet, and shower looked fairly clean, minus some wear and tear on the shower tile. There was also a fairly loud clicking noise that would start and stop at random times, which made it hard to fall asleep at times. We're not quite sure exactly where the noise was coming from, but it seemed like it was coming from somewhere above/around the sink area. Overall, I would probably not book a room at The Downtowner again on the sole basis that it was not clean.

reviews.title: Repeat customer
reviews.text: Second time staying at the donwntowner and it was amazing. I’ll always recommend other people to stay here. It is a very convenient location by downtown near everything. Staff is always friendly and accommodating

reviews.title: NASCAR Weekend
reviews.text: The staff is awesome! It's a great place to stay after fun on Freemont Street. Dee & Leslie are fantastic. Great customer service!  They accommidated all our needs. The bar is open 24/7. 5 minute walk to Freemont Street.

reviews.title: Concert
reviews.text: The staff was Very friendly and helpful easy check in and out , bar opens 24 hours,lots of things closer that we don't need to use our car,night life was amazing experience...family friendly as well ..

reviews.title: Good value position
reviews.text: Located a short walk to the Freemont Experience, bars, restaurants and old school casinos. The area has a local feel to it. The property is vintage with attention to the details that make a stay - great bed and linen, clean bathroom with plenty of hot water. Most of all the welcoming team.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Staff was nice & very helpful, room was clean, and other than hearing Fremont Experience faintly at night it has been nice and quiet. Good option if u want to stay somewhere off the strip or outside of the FS craziness.

reviews.title: Clean and friendly
reviews.text: The hotel staff are very friendly and made booking easy. The rooms are clean and spacious as well. There is also a lot to do in the area. We will be back again next time we come down to Las Vegas, NV.

reviews.title: Downtowner - hopeless
reviews.text: An opportunity for ordinary folks to see drug dealers and prostitutes up close.The room was tiny and terrible. About 3 feet from the end of the bed to the wall.No elevator. So dragging heavy suitcases up the stairs was not nice.

reviews.title: Resort charge not refunded...
reviews.text: I booked into the Downtowner boutique hotel between 20th-22nd Sept. 2022 and you gaily informed me that I'd have to pay a refundable resort charge of $45.20 in addition to the original booking fee of $79.11.I made no use of the facilities except to sleep, checked I'd be refunded the $45.20 on departure and was verbally assured this would take place within three to five working days.Guess what? Nothing happened. I notified my bank upon returning, Mastercard refunded me and you darling people didn't dispute it.However, you should have refunded me themselves and you did not. So having tied up the matter with my bank, I would just like to say that I think this resort charge is a complete con, no more than legalised larceny and probably works on the basis that most people are too disorganised to bother about a mere forty bucks.Well, I'm not most people, I didn't like it, it put a bit of a downer on my whole weekend and I just wish such establishments would not do things like this. I also wish I could send the boys round to have a word with the manager...There's an old saying in business, "you'd better be nice to people on the way up, because you're going to meet them all again on the way down," and it has some relevance in this case. I'm an author and I used to blog for the HUFFINGTON POST. If that had still been the case, I could have cheerfully done over the Downtowner on one of the most influential websites in the world (darn, I miss the good old days...), possibly affecting their repeat custom but also leaving a strong and sour taste in my mouth regarding Vegas.Is that the kind of way you'd like Las Vegas to be seen by the world?Well, I don't know. Maybe it is, but in this case it hasn't worked. I'm as vengeful as Bernadette in THE BIG BANG THEORY and I'll probably tell this story quite a few times over the next few years.You never know which innocuous customer might just turn out to be someone unexpected. So just do us all a favour and refund us all nicely when necessary.Not much to ask, is it?

reviews.title: Good budget choice with lots of personality
reviews.text: Very cute hotel with comfortable beds and great ambiance. Check-in was easy and the room was clean. The heating/ventilation was hard to control, so we had to sleep with the window open so as not to overheat and because even though the hotel is non-smoking the room smelled - maybe smoke? Maybe just it hadn't been aired enough? This meant listening to children run, yell and scream in the inner courtyard, though they stopped at about 10:30pm (I think a staff member came to quiet them - thank you staff member). The bathroom was spacious and water pressure was great. Appreciated the nice toiletries and the coffee served at reception in the morning, along with the central fireplace in the courtyard. We weren't given any information about the exercise room or pool at check-in but they do exist. The staff was efficient but I wouldn't call them friendly. They'd just made it through New Year's Eve though, so I guess we can cut them a break on that. The location is excellent for checking out the Freemont Street Experience, with lots of great cafes and restaurants nearby. It is a mixed neighborhood so also expect homeless people who will want to interact with you.

reviews.title: A restful stay at a nostalgic, friendly hotel!
reviews.text: Friendly front desk staff and very helpful!!! Dee at front desk has been extraordinary! So very helpful and nice! Nadine, a housekeeper, was also very sweet!!  They have delicious free fresh coffee every morning from 6-11 AM. If you want to have an alcoholic drink, there's a bar at the front desk. A comfortable sofa awaits your company any time, as well! There's also a beautiful gas fireplace in their large courtyard along with a mini-golf course!!!!! Lots of chairs to sit in! I sat out one evening and did my nails by the fire and I quite enjoyed it!!! The rooms have wonderful cable channels and a great flat screen tv! Very nostalgic nightstands await use by your cellphones, books and drinks! I love the little shampoo, conditioner and body gels that are provided in the rooms! A hair dryer is also provided for you, if needed, along an ironing board with iron. Iced water is also provided at front desk also, if you'd like that! Very clean rooms and hotel!!!!! Very close to Fremont Street! Very safe parking in their lot across the street!  I hope you enjoy your stay as much as my husband and I have!

reviews.title: AVOID THIS HOTEL
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY AT THIS PROPERTY! AVOID AT ALL COSTS!I recently encountered a horrendous experience of racial and disability related discrimination during my partial stay.  Due to a known documented disability, I was callously harassed by one of their supervisors in front of my 5 year old and 7 year old children. When asked to escalate this issue to the General Manager, Tamara Washington for reasonable intervention - I was very professional, and patient with their staff, however even with proper documentation and validation, Tamara sided with her employee and had my children and I removed from the the property in the middle of the night. I have never experienced this level of unprofessionalism, and carelessness, in a situation that was so unjust.It’s unfortunate that cruel and unprofessional individuals are allowed to run a property of this nature, especially ones with no integrity nor professional decorum.Save yourself the headache, and stay somewhere else. And if you think of staying at the Downtowner, remember the Mother, and 2 young babies General Manager, Tamara and Assistant Manager John removed from their property for discriminatory reasons.

reviews.title: Super cute unique motel
reviews.text: Close to everything in downtown Vegas, across from Container Park and right off Fremont. Clean, nice bar, easy check-in and has an awesome, funky vibe! Will definitely stay again. For sure not a cookie cutter place and is great for pictures.

reviews.title: So cute, young, and modern!!
reviews.text: Such a cute hotel!! Walking distance to Fremont street and plenty to eat around.. such modern cute simple rooms and love that they included shampoo/conditioner toiletries! Very easily accessible hotel thru a small lively lobby with great hosts and music. Cute golf course too!

reviews.title: LESLEY’S F******* AWESOME
reviews.text: I’ve never had a more fun game of mini golf in my life!!! LESLEY IS AMAZING!!! love her to death! Super fun place to stay and very clean! The mini bar was an awesome place to vibe out and hang!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Lesley is awesome! She’ll take good care of you! This place is special. Smooth process for checking in and car parking is available. Rooms are nice and the prices are pretty reasonable! Check this place out!

reviews.title: The Downtowner
reviews.text: Very pleasant staff. The rooms were really Clean and  the price is very affordable ,close to Fremont and a great place to stay in downtown Vegas. They made my experience wonderful and I recommend staying at the Downtowner on your next Vegas trip

reviews.title: Great!! Definitely recommend !
reviews.text: Leslie was awesome ! And the young lady who helped us after midnight last night was so nice and so helpful! Great funny inviting staf!! Rooms were good beds were super comfortable and the night was really quiet and comfortable.

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: This was a horrible experience the pictures are 3 years old the rooms look nothing like what they show the day shift clerk had a very short and nasty attitude there people that hang out in front of the MOTEL all night the room is very very small and stuff no closets no dressers they are not upfront about there payments and fees

reviews.title: Mid-week Getaway
reviews.text: Downtowner Boutique Hotel turned out to be the perfect choice for a mid-week getaway!  I wanted a non-casino hotel... and got an amazing hotel without a casino!  Inexpensive,charming, campy, dive-y, retro, clean, fun, quiet, unpretentious are just a few words... and there's more!  Off the beaten path and still located within 3-4 blocks or a quick ride to The Strip, and close to the airport - even guest parking.Absolutely (!) the perfect choice!The room was very clean, especially the bathroom and the fun on-site cocktail lounge made this review easily earn a 5-star plus rating; the staff were friendly and helpful - particularly the bar-tending "receptionist" who graciously added our Chick-fil-a order to her own when she called for her dinner break!  Random act of kindness indeed!
