And we sat at the bar to enjoy it without missing a beat of our own relaxation...Even got a great recommendation for breakfast at "Eat" the next morning - just a little more than a block away and another star for this review.Thank you

reviews.title: Friendly and cute
reviews.text: My husband and I booked this room over Halloween. We stayed two nights The bed was so comfortable . They had a 24 hour bar as well as a little market that you could buy sandwiches, soda and other snacks. The sandwiches were very good. My husband was diagnosed with cancer and we had a very emotional trip. The people that run this hotel are steller people. They were kind and compassionate. There are alot of restaurants and venues with in walking distance and we will be back.

reviews.title: Uncomfortable stay :(
reviews.text: We were disappointed with our stay. The staff was very kind and the rooms were clean. However, unfortunately the photos of this motel and the reviews are deceiving. The photos of the rooms show that they open up to a courtyard. Our room opened up to a sidewalk and then directly onto a busy street. We were so uncomfortable that anyone would walk in at any minute. It was also VERY noisy. I had to sleep with airpods playing all night. We could also clearly hear conversations between people even from across the street! Also, many ambulances passed by throughout the night.  The rooms were also not well insulated. You could see light coming through the rim of the doorway. And no heater. So if you're traveling in the fall or winter nights can be quite chilly. We asked if we could change our room but they couldn't accommodate us because they were full. If you want a restful and comfortable stay we wouldn't recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Very cute 24 hour front desk and bar, very helpful and friendly staff. Checked in quickly, clean room, comfortable beds. Great location, walking distance to Fremont street, bars and restaurants. Great mini golf course and outdoor lounge.

reviews.title: Fun little boutique
reviews.text: Great service staff, lots of fun. Play the putt putt! Leslie, Alexis, Dee are all wonderful and dona great job. They got this beautiful courtyard with a fire pit, flamingos, putt-putt- and super comfortable chairs to lounge in.They also handle security very well I felt very safe.

reviews.title: Nice Motel
reviews.text: It was my first time staying here. My adult son and I enjoyed our stay very much. We wanted to be downtown after staying on the strip for a few days. This place was an easy one block walk to East Fremont and another block to Fremont Exp. Dee helped us store a bag and a backpack while we went for lunch before check-in time. Everything went smooth and we had a great stay. We will return next year. Great place to stay.

reviews.title: Hidden gem!!
reviews.text: This is a great little spot! For the price I cannot complain! AC works amazing (seen lots of reviews against that) Front desk & custom service is awesome seriously, hard to find nowadays, those ladies are so helpful & kind! Only complain maybe no fridge but that’s about it. Thank you for having us!

reviews.title: Great rates close to everything you need in Vegas!
reviews.text: Great little spot right near Fremont Street. Decent rates and friendly staff! The bar is also the check in counter! We had a great time and will definitely be back! We came for a wedding but fell in love with the north end of Vegas and the Downtowner which was a wonderful escape from the chaos going on down the street!

reviews.title: Everything we needed
reviews.text: We had everything we needed, great price, clean, efficient and friendly check in/out. Helpful suggestions for ordering late night delivery food. Thick towels and every product you’d want - shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, lotion, soap. Thank you!

reviews.title: The best deal in North America
reviews.text: Literally the only hotel that I'll gladly stay at in the entire country. I normally hate hotels because they're way too expensive for what you get, and I'll do everything to avoid them. The Downtowner is different. It has everything I would want in a hotel: comfortable beds, very clean, quiet at night, and an amazing location that's close to everything but just enough to the side that you don't get a lot of partiers coming through. The place also has a great character, and the people working there are on top of it with the kind of professional courtesy that one would expect at a high end resort. But it's the price that seals it for me. Don't be turned off by it--it really is the best deal in the country which is why it's the only hotel I'll gladly stay at.

reviews.title: Good vibes
reviews.text: We had a blast at The DowntownerWould n will be back. Right where everything we love is around. Fremont around the corner plus. Has bar n a Mimi putting green inside complex. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. Thank you

reviews.title: Hidden gem in downtown
reviews.text: We visited the Downtowner for a weekend concert. We were skeptical because of prior reviews but we decided to try it ourselves and boy were they wrong! The front desk staff is friendly. The lobby is clean and inviting. We booked the Fairway Queen and it was just what we needed, very roomy, bed was comfortable, water pressure in the shower was perfect, the A/C worked wonderful. It was vintage boutique 👌🏼 If you’re on a budget , definitely stay here, don’t be skeptical, we would definitely stay here again. The ice mashing worked and had ice the entire weekend! Other big hotels lack that.

reviews.title: Nice taste of downtown Vegas
reviews.text: Clean room, and chill staff. Right by Fremont street and reasonably priced and free parking. It’s a secure boutique hotel and everyone was respectful. The rooms are modern with a well sized TV. Plenty of restaurants and things to do around.

reviews.title: Party on Fremont Street
reviews.text: Excellent motel right on Fremont Street,not gonna lie,when I first pulled up,I thought,"I really screwed up,I'm worried".... But I'm super happy! I will stay here again! Very clean,quiet,and literally on Fremont Street, the golf course in the middle is super neat! Definitely a great place to stay, should you wanna party on Fremont Street

reviews.title: Weekend downtown
reviews.text: Quick stay downtown, love the food options down here. 24 hour clean bar. Clean rooms, friendly/well versed staff, and a perfect location for dining out.  When I plan on coming back definitely will be number one on my option list.

reviews.title: Excellent value and service.
reviews.text: Clean room. Great price. Wonderful staff. Highly recommended. The bar is reasonably priced with great drinks and prices. The location is near everything Downtown and Fremont has to offer. The parking is free and easily accessible. You can also mini golf away for free. Cool spot.

reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: Good customer service, We had no issues during our stay! will definitely book here again! Great prices. Close to bars,food and attractions. No more than 10min walking distance very convenient. Not that far from strip.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Hotel Down Town Fremont
reviews.text: The staff were very helpful and nice. The room was clean and it was quiet all night long. I must say it's better than most places I've ever stayed downtown. Worth every single penny. If you want to experience downtown Fremont this is the place to stay the night at. It's within 100 yards of the Fremont Street experience.

reviews.title: My go to place downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: I have a youtube channel (LoneWulfRick) and currently do Las Vegas videos When I am downtown the hotel serves as my base. It fits my budget, rooms are clean, extremely friendly staff, and perfect location.

reviews.title: Husband birthday
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay. The room was perfect for us. Close enough to Fremont street to walk over and enjoy it but not so close that we weren’t able to get rest. Quiet, clean, and my husband liked the complimentary coffee. I would definitely suggest if you’re on a budget but still want a clean and comfortable stay.

reviews.title: The downtowner
reviews.text: The room's here are excellent good customer service is right in the middle of downtown so you have plenty of places to go have fun and Gamble the golf course is cute and their pool has good privacy in the parking it's not far from you it's literally across the street

reviews.title: Best in Downtown Vegas
reviews.text: Guys , it was great stating here . very friend staff. very fast self check in free parking for guest , very near to freemont experience , Love being hereStayed in Room 129 from 08/07/2022 and will always stay in Downtowner during my visit to vegas Rajesh W

reviews.title: Affordable and caring
reviews.text: A really good, affordable place to stay. We had a mistake in our booking and Will was very helpful in helping us fix it. Employees were very attentive and were amazing with any questions we had. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Chillin!
reviews.text: This hotel is one of my favorites to book by freemont. So many things to do around here and one of the cleanest, nicest and friendliest around.. by far one of the hotels you HAVE to stay at if visiting with a couple or just trying to wnjoy yourself ..

reviews.title: Nice and clean and a outstanding staff
reviews.text: Got to the room nice and clean our ac went out and it was blowing hot air and the staff was nice enough to get us some fan and took great care of my family at the same time we had our two year old son on this Emergency trip to Las Vegas

reviews.title: Great help
reviews.text: Warm welcome and solid place. Leslie was awesome and chatted with us for a while. Quaint and sufficient for a night where you will not be in your room. Close to Fremont which is nice and you get a free brew if you play the plinko board

reviews.title: Clean, friendly, convenient!
reviews.text: The Downtowner is a cute motel close to Fremont street! Leslie at the front desk is amazing and very friendly! The rooms are clean and nice! Getting around to different areas is very easy! The pool area is nice and the mini golf was a blast! We will stay here again!

reviews.title: Chic
reviews.text: Cute wonderfully priced clean easily accessible and caring staff. Mini golf with fire pit is fun with pool across the street. And a convenient store less then a block away helps for longer trips.   Updated very clean fitness room

reviews.title: Family vaca
reviews.text: From the moment that we walked into the place the vibe was super awesome. The bar is so cute ☺️ The rooms are very chic the pool is open till 10:00 p.m. Everybody is so nice and helpful, the Putt-Putt golf is an extra bonus!! And it helps that it's located right near a lot of cool little spots! Absolutely loved our stay here and we will be coming back!!!! Great for families 🙂

reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: Clean, centrally located in downtown. Nothing fancy but if you spend more time out than in, it’s a great deal! No fridge or microwave but plenty places to eat nearby. And they have a pool and parking and mini golf

reviews.title: Nice place for a short stay
reviews.text: Overall a great experience. The light skinned black lady really came through on helping me get a room for an affordable price. I missed my bus and was forced to stay another night- which wasn’t in my budget. I was going to go elsewhere & as I was leaving she ran outside to get me and helped me. She was so kind - along with the rest of the staff.I would say, the rooms have a weird smell to them though and I could hear my neighbors - but other than that everything I needed I had.Much loveThank youuu

reviews.title: Cute and clean!
reviews.text: Cute hotel right off Fremont.  Great common area with fun murals and mini golf!  Also had infused water for guests to enjoy (best water in downtown!!).  Our room was clean and comfortable.  Will definitely come back here!

reviews.title: Very Clean, nice fitness room Comfortable  overall
reviews.text: Conveniently located, really great fitness room with all the essential with great air circulation. Clean rooms, I’m usually sensitive to smells ( perfume, strong detergent) and didn’t have any problems here. Although I haven’t tried the mini pot, it looks really lovely. Great staff at check-in. Overall pleasant experience, would strongly recommend. Great price value!

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Great hotel with modern decor and a mini golf course. Situated close to freemont Street which is ideal. The room was large and had air conditioning. Staff were friendly and check in was quick. Overall great value for money and I would happily stay again!

reviews.title: Could be worse
reviews.text: Too overpriced to not provide refrigerators/ microwaves. The check in lobby air was nice and cold but the rooms are also very hot without updated AC units. Back of hotel smells like pee and the smell lingers into room due to no seal around door. I was told you can’t bring snacks or food into rooms also. The first night when I turned on the shower, the bathroom smelled like cat pee. It was like housekeeping did not clean the bathroom. Please book anywhere else because I’m pretty sure their AC system would work. Only good thing about this place was the pool. Not enough parking in the lot and homeless people are all around the front of hotel. I only seen security one day here. The second night a couple were fighting and an employee stood and watched instead of helping.

reviews.title: Awesome place and staff
reviews.text: This Cute little Motel just a block from fremont is a must stay!! Rooms are clean,comfortable, and quite place to stay. Some of the best staff very nice and friendly.Well definitely  stay here again..

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I am visitor. I am Asian. I stay here for two nights. I feel comfortable staying here. Room is good. Bed is good. There is a big television in the room. There is mini golf for entertainment and relaxing

Clean place and a perfect vibe for when you are with your friends! It has a bar for when you want to drink in peace and the bartender will serve you a good conversation. Can not find a better place with such a good price.

reviews.title: Cute hotel, excellent staff
reviews.text: Love this hotel, it is the only place I stay. I book on their website directly because they will rate match. Staff is excellent. I recommend staying in the Wylde building in warm/hot months if you are heat sensitive. Wylde has individual AC in each room and the Fairway has a common AC you can’t control outside of the fan speed. Both buildings have cute rooms. There is no fluff and fanfare, but the beds are comfy. Bring earplugs, it is off of Freemont street afterall. Yes, this place is old, but I love it.

reviews.title: The Downtowner
reviews.text: Excellent place to stay. It is clean and I love the fact that you need a key card to get into the building and the actual room, it gives you that extra level of security. Staff is wonderful and I would definitely recommend staying at this hotel.

reviews.title: Cute Stay
reviews.text: This place was super cute! Management was super nice and the woman at the bar and front desk were very accommodating. I had a couple of friends visiting for a birthday and the hotel rooms were clean and quiet. Mini golf and a pool were easily accessible amenities that make the stay cute for couple or families.

reviews.title: Inexpensive yet safe, clean, simple, riffraff deterred
reviews.text: Hey, it’s downtown… you’ll get riffraff… this place was simple & clean, but didn’t break the bank. Loved the concept, Will was a great bartender… during the day, I was approached by aforementioned riffraff & they were quickly deterred by one of the 3 ladies (Dee, Leslie & Alexis ?!) working. I never felt I safe here. Thanks guys!!

reviews.title: Worst of the worst service
reviews.text: No fridge, no announcement about early check-in in advance, making me pay extra fee. No useful help from clerk. No friendly behavior. No laundry. Swear on God. Never come back once and for all. Never and never.

reviews.title: Budget friendly and close to strip
reviews.text: Cheap and cheerful...it's exactly what a budget backpacker requires. One of the building has green AstroTurf for the corridors and as a feature wall in the room which is hillerious. Close to the strip and convenience stops etc - easy win for people on a budget

reviews.title: Cheapest & Modern
reviews.text: Better than both Motel 6s and Howard Johnson on Tropicana Ave (which in the past had been my choices as cheapest motels.).  The Downtowner has newly refurbished rooms with 70+ TV channels, a/c, free uncovered parking and high water pressure in the shower.  Close to the action of downtown Las Vegas.My problem was I couldn’t connect to the Wi-Fi on both my MacBook and iPhone 12.

reviews.title: Retro wonder
reviews.text: This place, except for the location to buses, was awesome!Reasonably priced even mini golf! Nice pool across the street and a fitness center in the building! Nice area to have a meal in the mini golf area and misters came on every afternoon to keep you cool.

reviews.title: Not worth the resort fee
reviews.text: The pictures of this place were deceiving. It was more run down than what we were led to believe. The lobby was depressing. There was vomit in the parking lot. The room was tiny but clean. The area didn’t feel safe to us. Being charged a resort fee for this property is out of line since it is a motel with a pool. We were expected to pay extra if we wanted to play the 6 hole mini golf.

reviews.title: Stay here for Fremont Street
reviews.text: Do not surprise if you come in and face the bar instead of reception desk. The kiosk check-in is beside the bar and after that you will get the room key from the bartender. Free parking in public parking across the street. You can stop your car in front of the hotel/bar just to drop your bag.Nice and cozy room but with very small queen bed for 2 (Asian) people. Walkable to Fremont Street, that's the reason to stay here.

reviews.title: Smooth stay
reviews.text: Great stay, pleasant staff. Rooms were clean. I will stay here again sometime. Great location. Convenient parking. This is a non-smoking property. Price was reasonable. Tiny golf course is pretty cool too!!

reviews.title: LOTN
reviews.text: Leslie. I mean say less!!!! Best service ever.  Funny, sweet, and bar tending skillz (helloooooooo)????  Made check in seamlesss and made me feel at home at the bar. 10 outa 10.  What can I say book this place.

reviews.title: Leslie Rocks
reviews.text: Leslie saved the day. We had some bad info and when we checked in she helped up get everything sorted out. She helped us solve the problem and get our stay off to a great start. Not to mention she served us great drinks and was very hospitable! Thanks Leslie!

reviews.title: Memorial Day weekend trip
reviews.text: I have absolutely nothing bad to say about the hotel. I loved my stay and would come back! The walls are a little thin so you can hear people talking BUT the front desk is good at handling it when / if it is an issue! Totally recommend especially if you appreciate a retro look!

reviews.title: Guest
reviews.text: Very friendly and welcoming staff! Antonio helped us from the moment we checked as I was having difficulty on the kiosk. We had issues with our AC unit but he made it a priority to get it taken care of right away. Very affordable and accommodating!

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The only reason this motel gets 5-star reviews is that they offer a free drink to customers that write a 5-star review. My partner and I ordered separate rooms. Before I even walked into my room there was a trash bag right outside of my door, and when I walked in the furniture was ripped. I decided to just bunk with my partner, but her room smelled like death! Within the first 20 minutes of our stay, we called Expedia to explain the situation. The employee, Jacob, was on the phone with them while we were on hold sitting in the lounge. He walked to the back and had a conversation with them. Long story short we were told by Jacob, "If Expedia emails us we'll give you a refund for the first night.” Expedia emailed the general manager, Johnathan Bishop, and he denied our first-day refund. I spoke to him myself and I asked, “Should anyone have to stay in a room with trash outside the door, furniture ripped, and a horrible smell?” He said “no.” Johnathan Bishop has the authority to give us our fair refund but he said he can’t because “This is a business.” FYI the pool is across the street from the building and nobody goes there. I have traveled for the last 15 years, I’m an educator, and I RARELY write reviews. Please save your money because we lost $315. If two rooms were horrible than the rest are like that. If you look at all the bad reviews Johnathan Bishop apologizes but does nothing about it. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: I loved the price, but rooms need microwave and small refrigerator. The service was very good, and the rooms were clean.The location was good, close to the strips , Freemont and restaurants.i would book again.

reviews.title: Easy. Convenient and very accommodating.
reviews.text: The staff is very detailed and clear on instructions. They are always available and ready to help when needed. The check in was easy and smooth. The check out was even easier. Overall the vibe of the place was cool and the location is hard to beat.

reviews.title: Cute little place
reviews.text: The room was clean & cute. It's close to Fremont street. The only negatives were the air conditioner didn't work very well, & there was a constant drumming bass throughout the night. The mini golf looks fun.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: It was a nice hotel room.They offered a pool, mini golf, a bonfire and drinks and the staff was friendly. However, they don’t have microwaves or fridges in the room but other than that everything else was fine.

reviews.title: We love it the rooms clean it’s by everything we will b back We love the hotel is beautiful the room is clean it’s by ev
reviews.text: We love it the rooms clean it’s by everything we will b back We love the hotel is beautiful the room is clean it’s by ev

reviews.title: Cute stay
reviews.text: Very cute little hotel, definitely great for my budget. Alexis and Jacob were amazing at helping us out, super friendly and helpful. Definitely would come here again! Also there’s a cute mini put by the bar!

reviews.title: Awesome customer service!
reviews.text: Dee at the front desk is awesome! We showed up in the morning and she had housekeeping clean a room for us to settle into even though our check in time wasn’t until the afternoon, and they held our luggage for us while we waited! Room was basic but clean and had all the essentials Also has a pretty sweet mini golf course.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: Great place to stay! Close to everything on Fremont street. Easy parking. Real close to my favorite place to throw axes and drink beer. It’s honestly a hidden gem. Would definitely stay here again. Don’t let your eyes fool you!!! Trust me. Cool little spot.

reviews.title: Great affordable play to stay near Fremont!
reviews.text: We visit Vegas frequently but only flew in and we were staying one night to go to other travel destinations. Really glad we tried this place. Lowest price in the area compared with Fremont. All the staff here have great attitudes and were wonderful from the bar/ front desk to housekeeping. It’s nice they have their own bar also on premises. Was clean and all you really need. Was quieter than I expected.

reviews.title: Best budget oasis in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: This 50’s style budget minded hotel is your oasis away from the crazy that is vegas yet just close enough to get crazy and enjoyLV!  The place is clean, friendly and modern!  My fav is having Dee at reception wish me a good morning!

reviews.title: Take a comforter, if staying in the wintertime!
reviews.text: This motel is inexpensive and clean, and just a 5-minute walk from the Fremont Street Experience.  BUT, the rooms do NOT have heat and the beds have only a very light, skimpy blanket.  Since this is Las Vegas, most of the year that is not a problem.  But during the winter months it can get quite cold in the desert, and the beds should have more substantial blankets on them so that people do not have to sleep cold.  This is really inexcusable, and quite cheap of the owner, in my view.

reviews.title: weekend stay
reviews.text: this was a very enjoyable stay. the rooms are cute and comfortable. it is a nice place to come back to after a long night. the bed is soft and the bathroom is clean. the general set up of the room is very appealing.

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: The services are amazing and the employees are very kind and genuine. They went above and beyond to make sure that our family was comfortable and had everything that we needed. We would absolutely recommend anyone looking for a great place to stay.. The downtowner is the place to go!

reviews.title: No ruffles kinda place
reviews.text: An amazing, clean, no ruffles or extra charges place to stay! Quiet rooms, quiet neighborhood and will definitely be back again! Staff was welcoming and very accommodating! 24 hr bar, free parking, and no resort fees made this stay totally worth it!

reviews.title: FROM A VEGAS REGULAR: DO NOT STAY HERE!!
reviews.text: Again: DO NOT STAY HERE if you are used to a clean and comfortable hotel this isn't for you OR me. I have ZERO clue why people have rated this place anywhere above a "1". It is a MOTEL in every sense of the word. The main lobby/bar/hangout area is the only upgraded portion of the place. It is not what's advertised in the photos. It's older, old smelling rooms, NO AIR CONDITIONER, only a sliding window, which is scary being on the 1st floor. They just painted over whatever was here, you can see bumps in the walls, popcorn ceiling, rips on the one chair in the room. Don't get me started on the bathroom: YUK! I almost wanted to bird bath it cuz I didn't want to step in it. I used my slippers every step I took, the bathroom counter is just ewww. We paid $288 for 2 nights here and it was thee worst experience I've ever had and absolutely not worth the money. It's around the corner from Fremont St., there's some kind of nightclub adjacent so you can hear the music and bass thumping but they ask YOU to be quiet after 10pm go figure!  Terrible, will NEVER stay here again!

reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.text: Great hotel on a budget - can't beat the value. Our room was clean, comfortable, and felt safe. All of the staff we interacted with were friendly and helpful. Better than expected, for such a low price.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Loved my stay here! The room was clean and checking in was painless. I loved the 24 hour bar in the lobby and Anthony was a friendly and personable host. Next time I'm in Vegas, I'm staying here! Would highly recommend 👍

reviews.title: Good for the money
reviews.text: Good location, great price. The walls are thin and water pressure was weak, but for the money it was an excellent place to spend multiple days on business. I just needed a place to sleep, this fit the bill.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel and location!
reviews.text: We booked this hotel because of the  location! We wanted to stay close to the Fremont Street area. The hotel was very easy to check in. Great and helpful staff, super friendly! Very happy with our clean rooms! Definitely recommend staying here!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the hotel. Rooms and property clean and staff was friendly. Close to downtown Las Vegas Freemont fun. Would definitely stay here again. Great price! We love Las Vegas and will be back to the hotel again.

reviews.title: Cute and Accommodating
reviews.text: The rooms and overall vibe of the hotel are amazing. Great location not far from Fremont St and complimentary parking. The rooms were clean although the building we were staying in did not have room controlled heat/AC. We will definitely be staying again.

reviews.title: Matched the price!
reviews.text: The room matched the price we payed. Had very friendly staff. Really appreciated the texting with the staff. Room was clean and well designed! Close and free parking! Great 24 hour bar and mini golf!!!

reviews.title: Definitely not as advertised
reviews.text: Ok where do I begin! The pictures of the hotel were nothing like the rooms we got for starters but on top of that shower flooded onto the floor, gap under air conditioner, light in room didn’t work no Mirror in room only in bathroom. The staff was very friendly. I would never stay there again though. They asked me if I wanted a 10 dollar upgrade and it makes me wonder what my original room looked like because the ones I stayed in were awful! I think they must have good reviews because you can play a game and get something free if you give a good review. Oooh and you could hear everything happening in the room above you.

reviews.title: Jay Harris
reviews.text: Love the decor and very quite private has security and great customer service very friendly and kind… we will definitely be back and I highly recommend it to anyone looking in the downtown area… very close to all casinos

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: The downtowner is a good place to stay. Staff is good.  especially jacob he's entertaining and very helpful.  It's open 24/7 even the bar. It's in a great location and feels safe to be here late at night.

reviews.title: Needed a place that was close to Fremont.
reviews.text: Cute place. Old school vibe with a little update. We liked it. For the price and location. Would definitely come back. Staff was super friendly too. I only wish I brought my putter and a few balls for the put put

reviews.title: Family scape
reviews.text: Friendly people running the place. Rooms are comfy and cozy. Very clean and organized. Love the vintage decor. Close to Fremont experience. Great place all around. Will be back for Shure, there's so much to see here.

reviews.title: A bargain for Las Vegas,  plus NO RESORT FEE.
reviews.text: I found the staff, the cleanliness and the room.in general to be just excellent.  The rooms are a little quirky (no dressers) but the response to questions and concern with my comfort put it at the top.

reviews.title: Adorable lil hotel
reviews.text: Adorable little hotel. Clean and well maintained. I stayed here for a week. Tge location is amazing parking is easy and staff is excellent. The bar at the front was really cool with lots of extras for your stay. Didn't play mini golf but was a cool little place to chill. I always felt safe in the hotel.

reviews.title: Really great spot
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve stayed at this motel. The staff is always really cool, you can text reception whenever you need, and the motel itself is just really neat. They really did a great job with this property. The place has all around great vibes and I’ll definitely be staying again when I’m passing through.

reviews.title: Thank you!!!
reviews.text: This place has really nice staff!!! Super helpful.  They were very attentive..and they just made my stay very easy!!! The rooms were very clean and very cute!!! I definitely recommend this place and I will totally stay here again when I'm in town thank you downtowner boutique hotel <3

reviews.title: Modern and friendly
reviews.text: Amazing hotel. The room is so modern and stylish. 24 hour bar at entrance which was nice. Didn’t have any issues with staff they message you throughout your time there if you need anything.  The only thing I would suggest is the air conditioning in room only had an option for fan and it would get a little warm at times. We opened the door since it was really good weather outside. I loved the setting in room where has greenish room perfect to take pictures. Overall great experience definitely would come again.

reviews.title: Cute, Modern, Unique and close to entertainment
reviews.text: I booked this hotel on a last minute whim on Christmas Day. The price was amazing compared to everything else in a 25 mile range on a holiday. I didn't have a large budget to work with and was grateful for this deal. Upon arrival I was greeted by Tamika who was friendly and full of courtesy the moment I walked in the door. She guided me to the check-in kiosk and was available for assistance when I needed it. She gave me the keys to my room and vehicle permits with easy details on where the parking was. My room was very clean and cute. The decorations are modern and well done. I felt the room was  missing somethings or just missed a few things a room should have. The desk area was in the vanity space but had no outlets to plug in a laptop. There were no outlets immediately next to the bed/nightstands. There was a lot of empty space in the room. The central heat/air conditioning was a bit of a bother since it was very hot in our room without it on. We actually opened our door in the evening and sat in common area letting it cool off. A fan in the room would be nice. The rest of everything as far as the room and common area was nice. Had it not been so cold or such a quick stay, we would have played mini golf and utilized the bar in the lobby. There was some late night chatter and noise in the common area which is expected in the city. At 7 am the water wasn't hot and I reached out to the hotel via text, this was such a nice and convenient way to communicate. Dee notified me this was the first they were notified of this situation and they would have maintenance address it. I stopped into the lobby around 9:30 for coffee and an update. The woman working the lobby at the time let me know they could accommodate a late check out without extra costs due to the hot water still being out. She was kind even though I'm sure she had a rough day. I stopped by again after 11 am for more coffee, the hot water was still out. I was able to take a shower just after noon when the hot water was back. Check out was easy and they gave me a credit due to the inconvenience. They're kindness made the issue easier to handle and deal with. I was very grateful for them. I'll definitely be going back when I need something in the area and a big part of that is because of how the staff handled not only themselves but guests during a stressful issue.

reviews.title: Quiet, clean, and family friendly
reviews.text: As always, very friendly and helpful staff. Easy to contact with text, didn't have to leave the room. Small enough place that the staff knew who we were. Very family oriented. Open indoor area with a fireplace for winter stay. There was a small problem with hot water but only for a short time of the 5 days we stayed.

reviews.title: Great location, best price and awesome amenities.
reviews.text: Our kids had a lot fun fornthe location and amenities. Everything you need for the price especially if you aren't staying in the motel the whole time. Love the staff. Love the location. Not the quietest, but worth the money

reviews.title: Awesome Place to Stay
reviews.text: Great place awesome staff and incredible ambience. A true delight and we highly recommend this hotel with a great location to the downtown experience and the strip. My fiance and I loved this trip and wi return to this hotel always.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Nice clean room. Beds are comfortable. Rooms smelled nice. Shower was nice clean and pretty big. Nice friendly staff, definitely went above expectations upon arrival. Definitely would recommend staying here! Also great price! 10/10

reviews.title: Very cute and inexpensive
reviews.text: The price was exceptional and the style of the room was really cool. Perfect spot to hang out after a night out on fremont. Really enjoyed my stay, beautiful area and beautiful people. Will checked us in.

reviews.title: Rooms Were Good But Service Was Not
reviews.text: The rooms were okay but from the time I checked in, the hotel personnel were humorless and without charm over three serious issues. First, the heat was not really on until the next day. They said the boiler takes its time to move from air conditioning to heat. The next day, the hot water was off. It took until the following day a little afternoon before it was fixed. They just said it was being fixed. Third, the fitness room was supposed to be next door. One employee even told me. When I discovered that it was being used as storage, they told me it was three blocks away. It took all the charm out of the rooms.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: Check in was easy and the employees were great. Such a cute property! The bar was great (and 24 hours) and the location is perfect. Can’t wait to play putt putt half too. Parking was close and free. Security on property was such an added bonus.

reviews.title: Best service ever!!!
reviews.text: ABSOLUTELY THE CLEANEST ROOM WE HAVE EVER HAD IN VEGAS!!! Incredibly polite and punctual staff, they all deserve a chance to treat you to the best stay in Vegas, so give the people of the Downtowner the opportunity to make your memories enjoyable. Special Shout out to Sky and Tamika you are exception employees and incredible human beings we appreciate you and your efforts along with all the staff that helped us and treated us like champions.... We will no longer struggle with where to stay in Vegas Downtowner; it is from here on out...... PEOPLE STAY AT THIS PLACE YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!!!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We booked here because all other hotels were out of double queen rooms. I was reluctant at first not knowing the area. But after checking in with the super friendly staff, I was feeling a lot better about it.Great clean low key hotel with amazing staff.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly, accommodating, and made our stay exceptional. They made sure we got rooms near each other. The miniature golf course was awesome to play on. What we traded for getting a casino/hotel was MUCH more than worth it

reviews.title: First time
reviews.text: We're here for my sisters wedding and staying here was a great experience. Great feel to the whole environment. Staff was great and welcoming. Will must certainty chose here again when we come to visit again

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: My second time staying here. Great staff! Clean rooms. I find this location very convenient. Close to Container Park. Easy walk to Fremont Street. Bar on lobby. Pool and golf on premisis. Peaceful stay with easy access to partying on Fremont Street.

reviews.title: Excellent Value
reviews.text: Fantastic location, walking distance to the Fremont Street experience. The room was clean with a retro vibe and it had everything I needed. They also have a bar, indoor golf and pool. You self check-in at the bar and receive your key cards from the friendly staff. The best part- the price! I will go there again.

reviews.title: I'll be back.
reviews.text: What am I supposed to do with a 200 character minimum? That's practically an essay. Anyway, seriously good service. Great location. Pretty sure Dee texted me just for fun. Chilly in the room but an extra blanket took care of that. Bed comfy 😆 if I come back to Vegas for my anniversary, I'll stay again. 😆

reviews.title: Great lobby vibes
reviews.text: I brought my girls with me and we enjoyed a couple drinks in the lobby bar. The bar on a Monday night was surprisingly pretty lit, we had a blast meeting other ppl staying here. And we slept like babies in the spacious double queen room after a short walk from Fremont St. Pretty safe at 3am btw.

reviews.title: The hotel is clean and the staff is super friendly
reviews.text: I had went to book.com and was scammed paid 3 times as much for a condominium that didn’t  exist. Book .com got me a room at last minute at Downtowners hotel The staff was very friendly and the rooms are clean We we’re so great full just to have a place to sleep

reviews.title: We always have an amazing time when we stay at this hotel
reviews.text: I think we've stayed over 10 times at this hotel and we never leave disappointed there's a cute little hotel with golf and a little bar for you to hang out late night. They also have a very minute he's if you mean like drinks and snacks that are available 24 hours. I definitely recommend 🙂

reviews.title: Read fine print
reviews.text: This is a loser. Dirty. Ragged. Worn out. Lots of ways that they take advantage of the guests and trying to sneak money 💰! Rooms adequate but basic and missing simple amenities like a 🪑 chair… go elsewhere for same price!!

reviews.title: Great, inexpensive, and amazing staff
reviews.text: We really appreciated Dee! She was an amazing host! Thank you! The rooms are small and older, but it’s a nicely remodeled boutique, so totally expected! The mini golf was fun (and even a tad challenging, tbh; at least for me! Lol)

reviews.title: Absolutely lovely Hotel
reviews.text: Staff is over the top, rooms are clean and comfortable.  When possible book direct for more savings. 10+ on our stay. Within waking distance of Fremont St and the Art district. Only request I would have is for a microwave in the lobby area..Enjoy your visit!

reviews.title: Rip-off boutique
reviews.text: They do not tell you about a resort fee...motel-type pool across the street, miniature golf is an enclosed smoking area that was probably where the pool was when it was a motel. No clean towels offered or choice to have housekeeping service. Boutique is a misnomer. Don't bother staying here

reviews.title: The boom boom Room
reviews.text: The Overall experience was fantastic and I shall let my friends and family now how great it was. I will be visiting again real soon the service was also great Sky n Lesley were were also terrific . And nice

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: This was a trip for my birthday/vacation. It went wonderful. The location is right in the midst of Fremont and was close to everything we needed. Very little driving was needed. It was a delightful experience. We will stay here again. Thank you.

reviews.title: Great place great bargain
reviews.text: Was able to leave luggage for a bit but did get checked in early. Room was clean and comfortable.   Will definitely stay here again..even though there was no coffee in the room they did offer free coffee in the check in area..

reviews.title: Great art deco style Hotel
reviews.text: I have been staying in this hotel for over 50 years. Is getting expensive clean and quiet. The only complaint is a lot of homeless people congregate across the street at and outside Church. It is a great value for the money.

reviews.title: Good value for downtown Vegas
reviews.text: I have been coming to Vegas for 15+ years and always stayed on the strip but decided to give downtown area a try given the ridiculous price of hotels on the strip nowadays.Downtowner Bontique hotel is a short 3.5 blocks walk from Fremont experience.  Hotel doesn't look like much on the outside but the rooms are really nice, feels newly renovated.  Beds are comfortable and I really like they have fancy towels like a luxury hotel would have.  Strong wifi so perfect for workcation.  Staff are super friendly and constantly in touch with you via sms since prior to check in.

reviews.title: Simply WonderFULL
reviews.text: Great experience, wonderful staff. Very comfortable and cozy cute and clean spot. I am very grateful to have had my mini vacation here, loved every minute. Nice location for exploring downtown Las Vegas. Perfect for my travel need. I am not a fan of Vegas however, I'm actually looking forward to revisit again and staying here again. Nice places to eat nearby and novelty shops and show which made it fun too. I move the fun artwork on the building also. Did I mention the staff are very kind and accomendating?Wanted to stay longer., I will return.

reviews.title: Clean and Easy
reviews.text: Check in/out super easy. Beds were comfy, but they do slide around a little bit (platform bed) and AC was loud, that’s the only reason I didn’t give all 5 stars, otherwise we enjoyed our stay. If you want a nice secure place to lay your head at night to recharge for a good price, this is perfect.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for a few days. The place is very clean and organized. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. Room was clean and the beds are comfortable. I would definitely stay here again. 🤩 A Big Thank you to the staff 🤩

reviews.title: Last minute trip to Vegas!
reviews.text: The room was spacious for 3 people. Checkin was nice and easy. The staff was very accommodating. There was a golf course outside of my room it was bomb,close to Freemont St. better than the strip. 💖this place so cute. Thank you to all the staff you made our trip! Sky, Will,Leslie Anthony Giron you guys rock!

reviews.title: By far the best customer service.
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay here. The staff were very kind and helpful during the check in process. Leslie, Anthony, and KD were very kind to us when we needed help with things in our room or at the bar. The room was completely spotless when we came in and we absolutely loved the decor in the room. I have absolutely no complaints about this place it was one of the nicest places I’ve stayed. I would recommend to anyone that comes to Vegas to come stay here!!

reviews.title: Surprisingly impressed overall
reviews.text: Aside from not having a coffee maker or fridge in the room, i can’t complain. It was a nice, quiet and comfortable stay. Staff was friendly. At first glance when i arrived, i said to myself “wtf?” But honestly, I would totally stay here again. They are still remodeling and upgrading rooms, so maybe next time… coffee maker 😁

reviews.title: Great deal; good location
reviews.text: Newly remodeled and clean place with really comfortable beds and big screen TV'S.  NO resort fees which is an added bonus.  Good service, but some sketchy characters in the downtown LV area so security seems well handled.  Enjoyed my stay.

reviews.title: Low key little gem
reviews.text: Super cute motel with amazing staff and a cool Mini golf course. Very clean with a nice little bar downstairs. Super inexpensive And everything you need. Thank you so much to Anthony!! You were absolutely the best!! Thank you for an amazing time!!

reviews.title: Best Little Spot Downtown
reviews.text: Great friendly staff, always welcoming, Melissa, Jacob, Anthony  & rest of the crew are awesome. Place is truely home away from home. I definitely recomend staying here on your Vegas trip. Great for kids and adults, i love the mini golf course.

reviews.title: Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: Thank you for hospitality Everything was prefect staff was friendly and kind housekeeping was on point thank you for taking good of my family when we were on vacation. Thank you for your hospitality until next time.

reviews.title: So bad we left and got another place
reviews.text: After reding the reviews here on TA, I was excited to stay at this hotel. It's close to the Fremont area and was said to be recently rennovated. However, the reality for us was very different.We were surprised by how the area directly around the hotel was run down and there were many people on the streets who looked homeless, so first, we didn't feel safe. Then, the check in was very uncomfortable. When I walked in the lobby door, 4 members of the cleaning staff were carrying on a loud converstion with the desk person who ignored me for a couple of minutes. When I finally got a word in, the desk person just pointed to the side of the lobby area and said I need to go there to check in. You have to check youself in using a tablet which how many other people have touched? Yuck! Then you have to go back to the desk person to get your key. The lack of concern for me as their guest was upsetting.Then I was given a parking pass to put on our car and told the lot was XXXXXXX, what did she say? Still can't hear her well over the continuing loud conversation by off duty staff. Turns out the lot is across the street and half a block away. The lot looks completely unsecured. We were nervous about leaving some of our things in the car to even go to the room. Out in front of the hotel were 3 men drinking and having a raucous conversation. They did not appear to be guests, were they casing the cars in the lot?There is no elevator and only one entrance. We carried some of our things to the room. When we opened the room, there was an unpleasant smell that greeted us. The room was basic but that wasn't the problem. The smell and the stains on the bed covers were disgusting. The cover had large yellowish stains in multiple places.  That was it for us. We'd already paid for this room but we decided to move on down the road. I could never have slept here.Another oddity was how many text messages I got from the hotel. One to confirm is fine, but I received 8 messages. One of them said to text back if I wanted parking directions and I did. No one ever responded. Sending these messages with no human involvment left me feeling uncared about.

reviews.title: Good location and great price
reviews.text: Originally picked this hotel due to the recent reviews being mostly positive. We were not disappointed. We spent a lot of time at the little cocktail bar in the lobby after coming in from our daily and nightly activities.We wanted something close to Fremont so we didn't have to drive everywhere but also far away enough from it when we just wanted to relax. The room was basic which is what we wanted to pay for. Nothing fancy but it was clean which is all we cared about. Only one entrance into the hotel and 24 hour security was nice. Every other place in the area we wanted to stay was close to double the price.

reviews.title: Perfect for solo travels
reviews.text: I will definitely be returning. It was comfortable, affordable, quiet, great location( fremont st), great customer service ( thanks Ms. Dee) golfing, pool, safe and covid safety measure are implemented.  Perfect for solo & family traveling. 🥰

reviews.title: Credit Manager
reviews.text: My go to spot whenever I come to Las Vegas.  Me and my husband love the rooms, nice quiet place, friendly staff and they have miniature golf course.  Even my room service was great.  Can’t wait to return again in November for my birthday.

reviews.title: Downtowner Hotel FTW
reviews.text: Great location. Wonderful staff!Comfortable Beds!I will return!I came Annette my son and his wife and kids at the Downtowner. Pool opens at six and it’s wonderful!The kids had fun with mini golf, and the adults are close enough to have their fun too!5/7 with rice!

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text: This is my second day staying here and so far it's the best hotel I've stayed at. They have a small putting course. I kinda wish the pool was a bit bigger though. The room I stayed in was really nice.

reviews.title: Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: Stay here is awesome. Melissa was marvelous at check in. Awesome to have a 24/7 bar at front desk. Room is marvelous! Soo close to old Vegas. Great to relax- hipster vibe yet Fremont experience like Times Square. Excellent experience and quite affordable. Flat screen tv! I recommend it when you don’t want to stay in the new strip.A+++

reviews.title: It was fun loved it
reviews.text: I'm going to customer service very respectful and professional stuff and they'll make sure you're time and your stay is comfortable  I love the golf course though I didn't try it this time pool is fun everyone is so nice  Looking to try the fitness room next

reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: I love staying here the staff is so nice and the area is perfectly close to EVERYTHING! The rooms are cozy and affordable if your on a budget bug wanna have a good time! They even have Put Put golf!!!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Was only here on a nights layover but could have easily stayed several days. In stark contrast to the major hotels and casinos this place gives you the 50s motel experience but all carefully renovated  to 2021 standards. Not 5-star luxury of course but more budget friendly than anything else you’ll find in Vegas aside from a free room - hence a five star review! Great location to walk to Fremont, friendly staff, comfy beds and most importantly clean.

reviews.title: Lesley is Awesome !
reviews.text: After horrible experience at Circus Circus, Lesley was extremely help with last minute check in, and excellent customer service. She made our stay very comfortable, and after a brief conversation I knew I was we were welcome.

reviews.title: Great Staff!
reviews.text: Awesome renovations, cool bar, and great location. I am very happy with my stay and the price is deal! Also mini golf and a pool on site. I definitely one the better stays in the area. I am going to be returning really soon. Also, cool staff!

reviews.title: One of the best deals in Vegas! Worth the stay!
reviews.text: I love the Downtowner Boutique Hotel! I always stay there when I’m in Vegas! It’s one of the cheapest deals in town for one. And the beds are amazing with super soft sheets! You feel like you’re sleeping on a cloud (no kidding!)! Super quite in most rooms too! They also have a really nice pool and a new work-out room. And one of my favorite amenities is the mini-golf course in the middle of the complex! How fun! Worth the stay!

reviews.title: Downtowner boutique hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel near Freemont Street experience. Very friendly staff, clean rooms, affordable prices. They offer an on site mini golf course, a gym, and a pool all within the hotel grounds. Also they have a small bar that offers an outdoor fire pit that is lit every night. I would highly recommend this hotel located just a few blocks away from the Las Vegas excitement.

reviews.title: Staff was amazing and that’s what counts!
reviews.text: Dee was a great host! Everyone on staff was very pleasant and attentive to my needs. Convenient location downtown as it is near everything in walking distance! You will not be disappointed at all! I will definitely be staying there again in the near future.

reviews.title: wonderful
reviews.text: great mature atmosphere with proper staff and security. perfectly priced bar and snack shop that's 24hr service. freshly remodeled rooms mini golf and pool. can't really ask for much more for Freemont street

reviews.title: Good vibes!
reviews.text: The atmosphere here at Downtowner is chill and laid back! All of the staff here was awesome and very nice to us!! We’ll be back for sure next time if we ever want to stay in the Fremont area. Thanks for the pleasant time!!!!

reviews.title: Great value, good location
reviews.text: Stayed 3 nights here this summer. The weather was super hot, and I had an upstairs room, so the AC struggled to keep up but did a descent job considering the circumstances. The room was very clean, which I appreciated and I love the mid century modern vibe of the decor. The bed was a little too soft for my liking but not a huge deal. The staff were all kind and helpful.It's also walking distance from Fremont Street and Container Park. If you're driving, there is a parking lot across the street and they will give you a parking pass to use it. Didn't have a problem getting a parking space there. WiFi was great as well. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: 6 Nights @ The Downtowner Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: Located on 8th Street just off Fremont, this hotel has that “best kept LV secret” vibe. Staff is friendly, and helpful Rooms are compact, and clean. Location is ideal. Walk to Fremont Experience. I stayed a week. I am quite happy with the service, and overall value. 👍

reviews.title: Checking in..
reviews.text: Great help to figure out for first time traveling! Dee was very helpful in making sure we understood how the expenses and fees played out while making sure we had a clean ready room and held our bags safely!! Great explanation around and to our rooms, the friendly service pulled us in more!

reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Very cute room! There’s mini golf course, a fitness center and pool. They have cool game you can play when when you book one night with them. I loved the shower pressure. The room didn’t come with a fridge but there’s plenty of snacks in the lobby. Despite it being 4th of July weekend I still received amazing service. I traveled alone and was little nervous but the staff is very attentive to everyone coming in out of the motel and made sure I was okay.   I will definitely be back in the future.

reviews.title: Guest
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience staying here. Very affordable. Room was nice bright and clean. Check in was a breeze and staff were more than friendly and helpful during the few days of stay here. Definitely will be returning again and recommending them to family and friends. Thank you Downtowner ❤❤❤

reviews.title: Great little place
reviews.text: Quaint and unique property with amazing staff! Thank you Jacob for going the extra mile! Will definitely be staying at the Downtowner any time I am in Las Vegas and recommending it to my friends and family. Cannot beat the value anywhere!!!!!!

reviews.title: My favorite place to stay
reviews.text: The Downtowner is THE best. We stay here every time we’re in Vegas. The Customer service is on point! The rooms are comfortable and you can’t beat the price. Free mini golf and the property is non smoking. We love it’s location as it’s just the right distance away from the hustle and bustle of Fremont.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: I loved the reception and Anthony who help us with the check-in. The room is clean, the pool warm. Just amazing.The parking lot is free, close to the hotel and close to the casinos or fast food. 5 stars

reviews.title: Quick Get Away
reviews.text: The staff are great people,The Price was Awesome, The Hotel is awesome and in a good position so you don't have to use your car. Mini Golf in the shade and they got a pool. Best Part: It's 113° outside BUT With the "AC" this place has IN MY ROOM ITS 65°!!!!!!! ITS SO COOL IN MY ROOM I HATE TO GO OUTSIDE... 😂  Will stay Here Again.....

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Nice place and helpful staff nice location and also great place to be in Vegas I loved it. And we'll come back and visit again. Thanks for the experience. Will recommend this place to family and friends

reviews.title: Hotel review
reviews.text: Clean and spacious rooms!!! My friends and I are on a road trip and decided to stay here for a fun time. Super close to fun night life and free parking and mini golf is a bonus. Excited for this trip.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Was a great place to stay. Only issue was the fan in our room was quite loud you could turn it off but it would get too hot to leave off. Other than that was very pleased with price, location, room was clean.

reviews.title: Get Away
reviews.text: This spot was perfect.  The staff here including Anthony was absolutely wonderful super kind people super helpful.You are just at the end of the Fremont experience I had thought about staying in one of the hotels that you literally walked out onto the Fremont Experience but realized once I walked into my room here it was just peaceful and quiet and actually a nice change from all that's going .My room was clean I had nice thick white clean bright towels and just the simpleness worked for me.  The pool was refreshing and clean and nice and relaxing I very much enjoyed my stay here and would come back again and again.

reviews.title: Good Vibes Downtowner
reviews.text: Room was very comfortable and bigger than I expected. Staff very friendly & professional. Had a very pleasant stay the bed in room omg Soo comfy. Everyone seemed to be smiles and friendly. Thank you Downtowner will be back!

reviews.title: Convenient, cool and cheap.
reviews.text: Nice and convenient to Fremont St. Can’t beat the price!  Free parking. Fun environment with mini golf and a pool. Small bar. Had a nice two queen room with golf course theme.  If you are needing a place to stay in Vegas stay here. Downtowner all the way!

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: Very good service exceptionally updated rooms you would swear this is a hotel i stayed for a week with my daughter and applied more days afterwards im here from chicago looking to start my life get an apartment and the downtowner helped with low rate weekly stays

reviews.title: Staff was on top of it!
reviews.text: We booked a couple weeks out from memorial weekend and for the price it was GREAT! Had a couple issues with billing due to booking but D at the front desk when I spoke over the phone was so helpful and quick to answer any questions I had. Once we got to the hotel, check in was easy and quick. Parking is across the street but we didn’t have any issues with that. There is a little away from Fremont experience but close enough for us to walk. 7 minutes top to the Grand hotel which is where our other friends and family were staying. The fan wasn’t working when we first arrive but Melissa was on top of it getting us a standing fan for the mean time while their engineer looked into it. And it started working within the hour. Check out was just as easy! Room was clean and everything was stocked. No fridge or microwave but we brought an ice chest and that was fine. Thanks to the staff! We had a great stay!

reviews.title: DTLVNV-USA
reviews.text: Downtowner Boutique is CLEAN, and the location is PRIMO.  If they had mini-fridges and microwaves...would be 10/10. Wrist bands are silly, but I was never given one and was never questioned...I booked on expedia and check in was delayed, but the staff was very helpful with this bump in road...The cleanliness alone and location make it 9/10

reviews.title: Downtowner around the corner
reviews.text: Updated rooms with platform beds with modern colors and fixtures.  The put put golf was interesting. Pool was clean and clear.  Check in was confusing.  The "front desk" was also a bar. Appeared to be understaffed.  Requested extra towels we never received.  Did like that they were able to extend our check out by an hour due an unexpected delay in town.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: It was a good experience but it was just a fridge and microwave missing but other that it was good. I enjoyed the swimming pool and golf & it’s close to some fun places which I didn’t have to drive. 😁

reviews.title: perfect downtown hotel
reviews.text: this location is so close to downtown my husband and I enjoyed walking to nearby fun spots. the hotel itself was very clean, accommodating, and costumer service was very communicative. Clean and great aesthetic.

reviews.title: I really enjoy my stay at the boutique the rooms are very clean and the staff are very nice..
reviews.text: I look forward to share my experiences with this place i really  like it...thank you it is a nice atmosphere  and I just was happy  staying there,I have been there three times  and each time seems to get better...

reviews.title: Family Fun
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay, we'll definitely stay here again when we return, the staff was nice and very accommodating, its located close to Freemont experience, so we didn't have to worry about parking, we was 2 minute walk away, I'll definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Very nice stay
reviews.text: Hi , we visited this hotel and the room was very neat , clean and comfortable. The person at the front desk was very helpful and friendly. We had a good time staying here and they just offered whatever we needed. They offered a complimentary coffee and it was pretty good . We highly recommend this place and we will next time for sure . It is very close to strip and restaurants.

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.text: This place is absolutely amazing. Dee and lesley were the best at treating us and very knowledgeable with the area! If you’re coming to vegas and want to stay off the strip to explore downtown area in all its glory, take my advice and get your room at the downtowner! You  won’t regret!

reviews.title: Love this place!!!
reviews.text: Tamara checked me  in and  was super nice and made me feel totally welcome as soon as I arrived  .. Word on the street is that Mellissa ( the bartender ) makes the best drinks in town as well. as the price was the best in town...  you can't beat this place!

reviews.title: A surprise downtown find
reviews.text: If you are looking for the Bellagio, this ain’t it. However, if you’re looking for a comfortable place to rest during your Vegas Adventure, this place is a great value. Near Fremont Street Experience, has a pool, 6 hole mini golf, fitness center (but with all the walking in Vegas who needs it!) and they have a bar at the registration seat. Coffee and tea every morning from 6-11. Beds are comfortable, and if you need something, they are very assistive. The staff, at least for me, make this stay more than worthwhile. They are always ready to help, either plan a fun activity, or help you find something fun to do. (Didn’t even mention the showers - walk in - and great water pressure!)

reviews.title: currently enjoying our stay at the Downtowner Boutique
reviews.text: The moment my wife and I walked inside we felt comfortable and was greeted with a smile from front desk young lady.  The Downtowner is a No frills Hotel.. you're not paying for things your not using.  It's a few blocks from Fremont Street, and all you're wanting to do is enjoy the art district scenery, and Fremont then why would you need any else but a comfortable bed in a clean room (covid clean), shower, toilet, TV and enough closet space for luggage. Just sleep, show and explore!  And if there's any types of problems/issues with anything just call (use your personal phone) or text the front desk and they will immediately handle the situation.Pet lovers - Unfortunately they're not allowed.  But that's okay, sometimes we pet parents need a break from them too.  lol.Hope y'all enjoy your stay here too...Mrs. & Mrs Howard-Martinez

reviews.title: Love Me Some Lama!
reviews.text: Great value, comfort and location! There is so much to do within walking distance. The amenities in the room are top quality and generous. The bed is like heaven! Definitely will stay again and recommend. I’m a Las Vegas local, in between homes.

reviews.title: So much to do!
reviews.text: They have mini golf, a pool, and a bar on site! For the price you can't beat that. The shower is a great size , and you can walk right out to Fremont. So if you like to party it's a great way to not drink and drive.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I was skeptical at first...But this place  did not disappoint!! I was walking distance from downtown and enjoyed it so much. My birthday  plans were exceeded by the downtownwer, and I will be coming back  to stay here!! Thanks soo much!!

reviews.title: Shockingly a Decent Vibe
reviews.text: You get what you pay for. It’s a good price, great location, and customer service is great.Cutesy little bar downstairs, putting green & a pool. Didn’t use the 2 latter but walked by and people were having a good time on a Sunday night.The only reason I give it a 4 star is bc of the AC. It’s one unit that controls the entire building and you can only control how hard the fan blows.It’s not even summer yet and I was SO hot last night....the other thing is you can open your window but it leads to the outside so safety wise you really can’t do that and sleep. I went for a specific purpose of trying to stay in a seedy motel for an experience to write about later.This motel was NOT it. If you want to stay cheap in Vegas and be close to everything this is your spot.Fingers crossed their AC gets fixed bc I would like to go back.I ended up getting a different kind of experience. Which I will happily repeat.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 days for men's softball tournament. Melissa at the front desk was super nice and friendly. The room was clean.  My wife and I felt pretty safe here since they do not let non guests in without checking in.  The price was more affordable compared to a casino hotel.  It was just down the street from the active Fremont street. The pillows were nice and thick but soft and the bed was soft and comfortable. One of the best thing that they do that no other place i have been does is they text me before arriving to say hello and let me that me know that they are expecting me to arrive. Then they texted me after arriving and settling in to see how my stay is going and if there is anything i need.

reviews.title: A night in Vegas at the best motel in downtown!
reviews.text: We chose the hotel because of their wonderful reviews. They are true. The motel is one of a kind in Fremont street. I like their color white motif. I like the tight security in the building. All adult guests are given bracelets for a pass that you must wear. The parking across the street is being monitored for safety. Rooms are very clean. My family love the premium pillows, the clean white bed sheets, and comfortable beds. I can also watch MLB on their 48 inches Samsung tv. There is a dining/kitchen table with 2 chairs, and a place for luggages and suitcases. Toiletries are provided. The room is spacious. And most especially, my kids enjoyed playing golf right in front of our room! My kids said they like this motel a lot. We will definitely come back!

reviews.title: Downtowner boutique hotel
reviews.text: This place was very friendly comfortable establishment good price can’t beat and near the Fremont street attractions great spot they have open gym and a nice pool across the street a great place to travel

reviews.title: Stay
reviews.text: Amazing stay amazing staff Melissa and Lesley are amazing this stay has been absolutely amazing Lesley is absolutely so funny I swear she had me and my husband dying for ten maybe twenty minutes I absolutely recommend this stay

reviews.title: Excellent staff, amazing location, 5*
reviews.text: The staff was super courteous and accommodating. Every single need I had they met and then some. If you are looking to stay near Fremont this is basically the best place to go! 24-hour bar, pool open most of the day and excellent mini golf!

reviews.title: Great accommodations very understanding
reviews.text: Very happy with our accommodations at the Downtowner. Clean secure feel safe kind of establishment we came across the issue when we first showed up and Melissa was very understanding and help us fix our issue I would recommend this place anytime to anyone

reviews.title: Amazing location! Cute hotel w bar!
reviews.text: Love this hotel! So clean & it’s decorated so fun! The staff is kind and accommodating. There is a bar at the front open 24 hours and it’s perfect. Our room was clean and spacious. The pool is clean and right across the street. Not a giant hotel like the touristy ones on the strip. Amazing location!!!!! I highly recommend the Downtowner!

reviews.title: First time
reviews.text: Never been to vegas found a hell of a deal and thought for the price that would be the best part and was pleasantly surprised to find a more then hospitable staff, a 5 star quality bed and pillows and the location was convenient for someone here for their first time looking to explore what the town has to offer. #SheIsSoCozy (see picture)

reviews.title: Amazing front desk and staff!
reviews.text: Everyone here was a joy to meet! I was moving from NJ to Las Vegas and stayed here until I found my apartment. From the first phone call, they've helped the process run so smoothly I was actually sad to leave after being there for 14 days lol! I will be returning to their 24 hour bar which is also a cool little feature! Another great thing is the front desk and security takes their job very seriously, nothing gets past them so you can really feel safe here even with the crazy Las Vegas crowds! Clean rooms, amazing staff, great price... What is there not to love! Now, they do not have temperature control thermostats, phones, microwaves, or a refrigerator in the rooms, but you get what you pay for and to be honest, I am quite pleased at where they decided to cut costs. You get the amazing staff and cleanliness of a 5 star but the rooms are more for sleeping and showering... No frills... But it being a block away from fremont, most likely you will only use the room for that anyway.  They also have a golf course but in my history, I have not been able to hit the ball straight so... I didn't try it 😂

reviews.title: Cool Retro Motel
reviews.text: Clean retro motel off Fremont Street. Staff was very friendly and hlepful. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. 5 minute walk to Fremont Experience and close to good food. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: nice place
reviews.text: Very clean and quiet and customer friendly  staff is great not ant undesirable people hanging out and they are very informative with information parking is great the location is right near Freemont street

reviews.title: Our time at Downtowner
reviews.text: Our stay was exceptionally pleasant!The girls in front where wonderful very attentive!Melissa and Ms D where very helpful very pleasant thank overall the best service we have had in a while.Thank to all the staff as well housekeepers very professional!

reviews.title: Mr. Q
reviews.text: You wouldn’t think that a place like this, would be such hidden gem. The renovation was way more than expected. Easy check in, great staff hospitality, and the bar is a nice touch to have. Thank u for the pleasant stay. Q

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: A very nice place to stay. Great location near fremont street experience and downtown container park. Very helpful staff, Leslie and Melissa were very friendly and informative. Will come back again. Mini golf is a nice. addition. Really like this place. Have been coming here for years.

reviews.title: Most family friendly place I’ve stayed in
reviews.text: My kids enjoyed the pool and golf course. My husband and I enjoyed being walking distance from downtown . Rooms are nice and clean . The only thing I would have liked was a mini fridge but I’ll most likely stay there again

reviews.title: Awesome Staff
reviews.text: I work in Las Vegas and commute from Anaheim every week. The Downtowner is the best choice around the Fremont Area. The management and staff are the raddest people you will ever meet. It’s not home, but the staff makes it feel that way. Thank you for everything!!! Downtowner FTW!

reviews.title: Mini Golf ⛳😎 and a bar 🍸
reviews.text: Our hotel reservation was canceled last minute and I found the Downtowner. If you looking for a quiet and clean room without breaking the bank. I've  traveled to Vegas alot and am definitely over the overpriced basic room that are on the strip. Dee and Melissa are the best!!!

reviews.title: Such a nice change
reviews.text: Do you get tired of chain hotels? If so, try something a bit different! Very friendly and affordable. Even astro turf instead of wallpaper. Clean room with very comfortable bed.Easy walk to Freemont Street and people watching.

reviews.title: TADOW❤️
reviews.text: The downtowner was perfect for our one night stay. My partner and I had stayed at the el Cortez a few years ago and it hasn’t changed; cigarette smoke, smoke and smoke. The downtowner is next door,smoke free, has quiet time in the late hours and the beds are comfy! I love the the atmosphere and hearing my favorite song tadow, upon entering their front door where you check in at the beautifully, clean and kickback bar, I would stay here every time I visit Vegas❤️Thank you to the staff who made our visit so easy🙏🏼

reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Value!
reviews.text: Incredibly comfortable bed and room is just the right size (huge closet!).  Samsung flat screen and central climate control is delightfully quiet (adjustable in-room).  Excellent staff, and the central courtyard with fireplace and mini golf course rocks!

reviews.title: Love!!!
reviews.text: Loved the front desk clerk she made my stay that much better.Loved the scenery and the room is clean and looks just like the pictures and with in walking distance to Fremont Street would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Since we got there last night we had a great experience everyone was really friendly and really helpful great service we feel right at home and this is the hotel that we can keep coming to every time we visit Vegas

reviews.title: Good hotel.
reviews.text: May not be a 5 star hotel, room wise however this is the only hotel I have ever found that was very friendly and welcoming. The staff was very friendly and went above an beyond during my stay here. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you need a quick place to rest for a couple nights. Would be better if everything wasn't still on pandemic restrictions. I wanted a tub in my room but was unavailable.. Other then that pretty good.

reviews.title: Very good place
reviews.text: Upon checking in I was suprised with some fees I originally was unaware of. Thanks to the lady Melissa that checked me in though I had no more issues and had clarification on everything... If not for such a wonderful lady I probably wouldnt have understood or checked in honestly. So yes awesome place . nice rooms good price and awesome employees... Thanks again Melissa

reviews.title: Bday visit
reviews.text: As a local this is my favorite hotel to stay in downtown. Rooms are always clean. Staff us super friendly. And uts right downtown in the heart of the arts district which is why we come and stay here. Love this place

reviews.title: Everything I needed.
reviews.text: I was traveling through and needed a good place to sleep. The staff was courteous and professional, the room and bed were clean, and the shower was hot. For what I needed it was perfect. I would recommend this hotel highly.

reviews.title: The place to stay while in Vegas
reviews.text: Like a home away from home  My Room Was Very clean and excellent condtion Price was reasonable great place to stay. I would recommend it to anyone who maybe tired of Corporate Vegas. Where you're not just a number.

reviews.title: Clean. Not expensive. Quiet.
reviews.text: Perfect location within walking distance to Fremont Street. Clean, affordable and a great staff. The area, although in the “downtown area” was very secure. Not like what I expected. My next travel will definitely be back at the Downtowner!

reviews.title: awesome little gem, great staff
reviews.text: amazing staff, great location, great price. the staff is where it’s at, all very awesome, helpful and kind. near the fremont street experience, but enough away from it that you don’t feel on top of it.

reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.text: I’ve stayed here twice it’s clean and safe the staff is are very helpful and explain everything you need to know regarding the property. The decor is cute, they have a golf course and bar... Thank you for everything Dee you are awesome.

reviews.title: My stay
