reviews.text: From the time we checked in the staff we're very friendly with nice smiles. The hotel and room is way nicer than we expected and staff even texted me to see how our stay was going 🤗 it's going Great Thank you all 😁

reviews.title: Best value per price
reviews.text: Originally planned to stay one night and then decide for the rest, ended up staying 4 nights with then. It was clean, well located and the cheapest option by far... I will recommend it if you are low budget

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: The Downtowner is a fun place to stay, play mini-golf, grab a beer, & sit by the fire. They make your stay relaxed & safe. The Staff is friendly, patient & easy to talk to: especially Charissa, the manager.

reviews.title: 5 star service
reviews.text: When I checked into this place, Charissa was great!  She addressed any concerns I had and made sure I felt comfortable and well taken care of.  Also, she was there to help me with any questions I had during my stay   I'd give Charissa 6 stars but 5 is the max.  Awesome!

reviews.title: Great escape in DTLV!
reviews.text: This place was the perfect escape with it’s mid century modern renovation making you feel like your in Palm Springs! The mini golf in their courtyard paired with an amazing outdoor fireplace makes this absolutely charming. Price can’t be beat for what you get. Staff was beyond friendly. Highly recommended and I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.title: Weeklong-Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for a whole week with no complaints whatsoever. Lesly at the front desk is great! Free parking. The place is clean and budget friendly and this is a great destination with a short walk to the Fremont.

reviews.title: Swedish sweet nothings in my ears
reviews.text: Leslie liberated me with libations. Leslie was a lioness linguist who gave me an experience that can only be considered as an equivalent lollapalooza. Loose lips sink ships, but Leslie’s linguistics leave you levitating.

reviews.title: Good Room, Good Price
reviews.text: Stayed here several times in the two other buildings, first time in the renovated Fairway. They did a great job, very cute, and I loved the courtyard with the fire pit. Bar was also nice. For the price and convenience of their location, it’s hard to beat.

reviews.title: Cute!
reviews.text: Me and my best friend are staying 4 nights in Vegas! We decided to stay at this little hotel off the beaten path of fremont street. The rooms are cute! Very clean! I love that it is not right next to downtown. It’s a super quiet area. Would definitely stay here again! Only thing I wish it had was a fridge!

reviews.title: NYE in Vegas!
reviews.text: Hidden gen in the heart of downtown Vegas. Walking distance from The Fremont experience. The Hotel has been completely remodeled recently (2019) and the rooms are very modern and clean. We stayed one of the Queen rooms for new years eve, the bed was very comfortable. And the Location was unbeatable. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: New Years
reviews.text: I visited this hotel for New Year Eve And New Years The Staff was pleasant and the includes of the VIP package was great and useful!! The rooms were very clean and the of your looking to takes lots of selfies while having fun... Book a room here !!!!

reviews.title: Family VayCay!!
reviews.text: Super friendly front desk lady Melissa!! She accommodated all my needs and even though there was a bit of an communication error in the beginning with another staff member she made me smile in the end.

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: Great location! Friendly staff! Great price! Definitely would book again! Dee is the best! She deserves a pay raise! I also felt safe here! Has mini golf and a fireplace in the center court. Lots of snacks and coffee available too.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Love the mini golf and bar area. Easy and smooth check in process. Clean place, amazing staff, wonderful location, very affordable and accommodating! Would definitely stay here again and I highly recommend it!!!

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service!
reviews.text: Booked here after talking to a friend who has stayed multiple times and am in no way disappointed. Dee at check-in was fast and funny and I found myself not wanting the interaction to end. My room was clean and comfy and the golf course looks interesting. Ill definitely be back.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This place is amazing. Very clean and friendly. All the staff our awesome and friendly as well. Everything here made our trip amazing. Keep up the amazing work!the golf course is also a huge plus for us

reviews.title: Amazing environment and friendly staff square deals on pricing also
reviews.text: I loved my stay here this will be my spot from here on out. The staff are very friendly as well as the guest. The rooms are clean. The layout of the hotel is very unique also. Drinks are good too. Golfing is fun too

reviews.title: solo trip
reviews.text: this was the best trip i’ve ever had to las vegas. i highly recommend staying here. friendly, courteous and prompt service. the wonderful environment they provide makes me want to come back as soon as possible.

reviews.title: Fun and clean
reviews.text: Really cute little spot. The property was kept very clean and the front desk staff was great - very helpful. The check in process is pretty long.... but a lot of that is due to their sanitation standards and ensuring a positive guest stay. Downtown is slowly getting better and better.

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: Over exceeded my expectations by far,see at the front desk was beyond helpfully...above and beyond is understatement...room was clean and had an amazing lobby with a mini golf course included, definitely recommend

reviews.title: Great prices and location
reviews.text: Being affordable is one thing but being in walking distance of freemont is a big WIN!! Highly recommend if staying briefly or need an affordable room. Room was clean staff is friendly and security is present at night.

reviews.title: BACK AGAIN
reviews.text: Quick and convenient check in short walk to Fremont street as well as a short drive to the stripMini golf and bar conveniently downstairs My sisters first time out in Vegas the staff was really friendly and attentive which made her enjoy her stay even more will be back again

reviews.title: Stay
reviews.text: Really gray customer service! Lesly and Steven provided some great customer service. Check was a breeze and hospitaltiy was great would definitely spend the weekend here again! It was an overall great experience

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The room was nice and clean, the staff was wonderful and very helpful , I definitely recommend this Hotel , I appreciate the Hospitality and the prices are very reasonable, Great stay! My next trip to Las Vegas I will be staying here again

reviews.title: Thanksgiving in Vegas
reviews.text: We really enjoy the hotel! Great little place. Nice clean rooms and the staff is outstanding! Stayed here Labor Day weekend this year and decided this is where we'd come back to in November. The price is great and the miniature golf is included and fun to grab a drink and play a couple rounds!

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Last minute I needed to find a hotel in the middle of the night due to domestic issues and this place was very affordable despite it being a weekend which was awesome they were quick to get into a room and despite it being a non-smoking Hotel the hotel staff had taken notice I was a smoker and gave me a room on the 1st floor around the outside of the building so i could be near the sidewalk without so I didn't have to walk through the entire hotel to get outside every time I wanted to smoke. Every morning housekeeping would wait to check on my needs until they saw me come out for my morning coffee and smoke rather than bothering me before I was awake. Everyone was so polite, thoughtful, seeming to genuinely care about how i was doing each day, all of the ladies here made me feel like family, i felt safe, protected, looked out for and comfortable immediately which is exactly what i needed in a time of crisis. I felt like i was home. Ive been here 12 days now and will be checking out in the morning and can honestly say i will miss being here. Downtowner is a home away from home!

reviews.title: Best place to stay to experience Downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: Spent the night here with friends and had a great time. The room was clean and beds were real comfortable. The noise level is surprisingly low considering it’s so close to Fremont Street Experience. The recent remodel also looks fantastic. We definitely will be coming here again.

reviews.title: Perfect location for Downtown!
reviews.text: I definitely enjoyed my stay at the Downtowner! Met some great people at the front desk bar and it’s only blocks away from all the excitement in downtown Vegas. Front desk staff are very friendly and answered any questions I had. I will be staying again in the future! I would suggest if you had any issues, don’t just write a bad review, call front desk and I’m sure they would be nothing but accommodating!

reviews.title: Laid-back Oasis in the Desert
reviews.text: Cheap drinks, mini golf, Instagram-worthy murals, llamas smiling at you here and there, and Astroturf everywhere. Close enough to walk to the fun of Fremont, but far enough to get away when you’re ready. This place is just the right amount of camp and kitsch.

reviews.title: Enjoyable staff and a nice little hotel just off Freemont Street
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and accommodating.  I ran into a few speed bumps along my way to Vegas and unexpectedly had to make a change of plans, which the Downtowner most definitely helped out with.  Decent location just east of the hustle and bustle of Freemont Street.  There is only one way in to the hotel, so I never felt unsafe for myself of belongings.  If you're looking for an inexpensive, yet great place to stay, I highly recommend the Downtowner Boutique Hotel.  Thanks for all you did.

reviews.title: Spectacular hotel and customer service
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend and my daughter came her for a staycation. When we checked in charissa the manager and ayela helped us figure everything out and were so polite, kind, and helpful. I haven’t experienced service like this in a very long time and will definitely be coming back here for more staycations. This place is in a very great location and is very clean. Everyone is polite, also, it’s very peaceful and quiet. They have really great features included as well. This is the perfect staycation spot!!!!

reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.text: Horrible place horrible people someone went in my room when I wasn’t there bad location bad check-in and the blinds didn’t even cover the whole window so people walking past were able to look inside my room

reviews.title: Honeymoon Stay
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed there for our honeymoon. Great cute little place, the staff was friendly and the room was clean. It's located close to Fremont street so it's close to everything around there. Can't wait to stay there again!

reviews.title: Renovation and Staff are Great
reviews.text: Stayed here before the renovation. The renovation definitely made it better. Easy to check-in. Rooms were clean, thanks Aleya. Melissa (I think thats her name, kinda blonde, curly hair) front desk agent was very accommodating when my reservation wasn't updated within their system. She offered me a seat and a drink and then manually put my info in so that I wouldn't have to wait for the reservation to come through on its own. This technically counts as two reviews for Melissa, she's been helpful both times. Had an online work meeting and assisted with a late check-out the second tine I stayed. -T (Colorado)

reviews.title: Shelly Prescott
reviews.text: Great place  , friendly staff. Lots of fun , very clean. Covenant to the strip.Ive met so many neat people.  This place really pulled me out of my covid depression. Really  cute mini golf course.  A fire pit to hangout  at night.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Loved my time here. Free putt-putt golf, parking, gym and Wifi. Staff is helpful, particularly Lesley, and are always at the bar ready to serve a drink, offer directions or help you with any issues in your room. They certainly don't deserve 3.5 stars when you consider how much you're paying for. Would definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Daycation
reviews.text: Helped us with anything we needed. They are very friendly and the rooms are amazing! When we got in we got two free drink passes. Started our weekend off great Charissa helped us and was kind to us. So excited for rest of the trip

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Lesley was awesome. had a wonderful time the bar was amazing they made great bloody Mary. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends. Hope to see the staff again on my next vacation. The best place in the world.

reviews.title: Front desk bartender is DEE best!
reviews.text: Dee gave us a fantastic suggestion for dinner. We went to The Container Park right around the corner. Had a delicious meal at The Vegan Cafe. It's a great spot for the whole family! We appreciated Dee's friendly attitude & professional demeanor in a relaxed setting.

reviews.title: My 1st trip to Las Vegas
reviews.text: Honestly I am having a very great experience specially with the downtown motel I had an  Amazing experience with the helper in the front desk Dee. So far so good and enjoying it with my family. Love it.

reviews.title: Very cute decor and very friendly workers
reviews.text: The front desk is also a bar which I found very cool and interesting. It’s super clean and the rooms are nice better than an expensive hotel. The golf course theme was awesome! I loved that you can come in and play if you wanted to for free if your a guest! The rooms are very cozy and the staff is helpful ! I would definitely recommend staying here and I would stay here again myself!

reviews.title: Room comfort
reviews.text: The room was very cold which made it difficult to sleep. No blankets and needed to use coverings on second bed with limited help.  There was no adjustment of the temperature other than turning the fan off and outside noise was then an issue.

reviews.title: ALWAYS right on time.
reviews.text: The Downtowner NEVER disappoints. From their unbeatable prices, friendly amazing staff and the overall vibe. You cant go wrong. They are wonderful. Always polite, helpful, and convenient. They are located downtown, just a hop, skip , and jump from Fremont street, container park and all the other downtown fun Las Vegas has to offer. I am a frequent visitor and the Downtowner is ALWAYS my first choice. Don't hesitate, they do sell out quick since they are everyone's favorite.

reviews.title: Charissa is the best
reviews.text: Thank you for making the best first impression!  The hotel is cute and perfect for a night downtown. My guy and I came for a getaway and Charissa made us drinks and checked us in. Lesley and Dee helped us at night. Drinks are great!

reviews.title: Delivers Where It Counts
reviews.text: I rate my experience an enthusiastic 10. What a great place! Stylish, clean and a helpful staff are what I appreciate and Downtowner delivers it. The location is great, close to everything and everywhere in downtown but far enough away to be quiet and free of major traffic. Nice job.

reviews.title: A
reviews.text: Dee and Leslie were so kind and helpful! Booked our room last minute and so glad we chose here. Rooms are great, customer service is fantastic and the shampoo smells sooo good! Definitely will be staying here again!

reviews.title: Found our new goto!
reviews.text: Great place for a shower and sleep. Clean minimalist rooms are perfect if you're on the go while in Vegas. The staff is the friendliest we've experienced. Dee was a highlight of the trip from the moment we walked through the door!!!

reviews.title: Love the downtowner!
reviews.text: Always stay here when we are in town! Incredible stay, very accommodating, friendly faces! Mini golf in the lobby. Bar in lobby, pool is accessible. Very affordable stay and close to everything that Fremont has to offer.

reviews.title: Went for work and play for ny  Birthday.
reviews.text: Great location and mini golf is a plus. Staff is great, fun and courteous. Pool is across street and perfect for a dip. Can walk to Fremont Experience in just a few minutes, and not too expensive to get a rideshare to the Strip. Not to mention the great price we got during covid.

reviews.title: Neat Place
reviews.text: Cool place, staff was helpful and the room was clean. Fast and efficient customer service. The color scheme really took me back and made me feel at home. Very contemporary yet had a unique old feel. 😆

reviews.title: Great place.
reviews.text: I always come back to the Downtowner always friendly bartenders the service is great they sanitize as it should be the drinks are always price worthy. I’ve been coming here for 1 year and I will keep coming here and I always recommend this place. Lesly has been more than welcoming every time I come in. I know all the bartenders here plus management my top number one!

reviews.title: Nice Upgrade
reviews.text: Amenties and customer service are great. The room decor is amazing. I was able to check in early for a small fee. Very safe, clean and quiet atmosphere.  The price is very reasonable and affordable & spacious.

reviews.title: Great staff and location
reviews.text: Dee and the rest of the staff are so friendly and accommodating. The rooms are clean and just 2 blocks from Freemont Street, you couldn't ask for a better location.  I like staying in this location better than the strip with so many economical dining options as well as a vendor that will pick up your laundry which is a bonus for a business traveler like me.  Thank you for your hospitality! 5 Stars!

reviews.title: Awesome property
reviews.text: The staff is friendly the rooms are clean the location is great, the price is affordable, I love this place.  I Love that I can walk to Freemont street within 5 minutes as well!  There are cool amenities too to make the stay great.

reviews.title: Quick getaway
reviews.text: A last minute travel plan to vegas. Quick check in and out. I didn't know they had mini golf in the motel was a happy surprise.close to fremont experience. Great customer service. Will definitely try this again.

reviews.title: Ms Mac
reviews.text: Clean friendly staff. Very helpful happy hour suggestion to flock and fowl was very much appreciated. Will stay again for sure! I love that the motel is walking distance to great food and fun! I love this place!

reviews.title: Miss young
reviews.text: I love this place first time staying here and everyone was very friendly and the place was clean. I would definitely come back. I love that The motel is convenient has a bar inside and food on the go.

reviews.title: SO MUCH YUMMY GOODNESS
reviews.text: This space is beautiful. Simple. The energy here is light, warm and welcoming. The put put golf is SO FUN ! The staff are so kind and generous. Utterly grateful for this space and those who cultivate such loving energy.

reviews.title: Denied due to in-state ID
reviews.text: I was out enjoying downtown, and didn't feel comfortable driving home, so I figured I'd try out this cool hotel I'd heard about. I pulled up an app and booked a room.I walked over to the hotel, looking forward to my stay. When I checked in, I handed him my Nevada ID, at which point I was told that I could not check in without an out of state id.I have never heard of such a bizarre requirement, and have no idea where that came from. Compounded was the fact that they couldn't give me a refund directly, and I had to spend time on the phone with the booking site to get a refund. No explanation was provided, no clarification on why the rule existed, just denied. I stay a lot downtown, sometimes just to enjoy something new or to get the head start on a morning meeting. I will not be staying at the Downtowner.

reviews.title: Great little find
reviews.text: Amazing front desk service from Tina at check in. Room was very clean and updated. Fun accommodations. Rate was reasonable. Parking is inconvenient but manageable. Would stay again and definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Hidden gem with great customer service
reviews.text: Easy check in and nice remodeled rooms and property.  Dee was amazing and very helpful. Never had anyone go out of their way to meet and exceed our expectations. Even extended our stay because of how comfortable we were.

reviews.title: Nothing nice to say
reviews.text: Reminiscent of Jim Crow but I couldn't find the Confederate Flag anywhere.I was disgusted and pretty damn frustrated with the Downtowner Boutique Hotel's discriminatory and illegal policies and practices.I made a reservation online with the Downtowner through Hotels.com (Expedia) thinking that it would be a decent place to lodge for the evening and interesting as I have not yet stayed there. I always appreciated it's colorful nature and what appears to be pretty nice interior design and renovation for a lesser-known to pretty much unheard of property in the Las Vegas downtown area.I arrived to the property shortly after making my reservation and approached front desk / bar area and was promptly met with verbal indifference and very obvious physical exasperation from the front desk employee (Adyen) who made me to feel as though I were without any importance and appeared to be considering possibly not giving me the time of day at all.Finally she had asked me for my I.D. to check in and immediately told me that I would not be allowed to stay there because I was a local Nevada resident. (In disregard of federal fair housing laws) and offered to book me at a different property (GoldSpike) ..I was a bit surprised at the situation and I certainly didnt want to stay somewhere I hadnt wanted to or already paid for in the first place. Then Adyen (I'm assuming is her name,  only thing I could find on the paperwork)  proceeded to tell me that this policy was listed on both their website and on hotels.com which is entirely false,  it was not on either. She refused to properly cancel the reservation and refund me in full which had forced me to deal with support at hotels.com and I had to wait nearly a week for the funds to be returned to my account on top of having to make a reservation elsewhere at the cost of nearly $100 .. Thank God I had it and was able too but on any other day that might not have been the case. In summation, I was lied to, discriminated against and did not receive the service which had paid for entirely defrauding me in the agreement that we had voluntarily entered upon with the third-party hotels.comI would never recommend staying at this property and each and every time I hear it mentioned I will tell this story as is and recommend avoiding The Downtowner with extreme prejudice.

reviews.title: Great stay!!!
reviews.text: We booked Downtowner Boutique last min after we decided to head into town a day early for our weekend trip. Leslie the bartender was so down to earth and welcoming, Amazing bartender try her long islands lol. Our room was really cute and chic. We didn’t get a chance to use the mini golf course since we got in so late and checked out early. We’ll definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Dee was amazing
reviews.text: My family and I just recently stayed at The Downtowner and let me tell you we had a blast. Everyone was very lively and conversational. Dee definitely goes out her way to ensure you feel welcomed. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: The Downtowner is awesome
reviews.text: My family and I recently stayed at the Downtowner for a trip. Everyone there was extremely friendly and conversational! Dee especially works hard to ensure everyone is having a good time and feels welcomed.

reviews.title: 10/10 hands down!!!
reviews.text: Amazing service and staff. They are very welcoming and friendly. Room was cozy and environment was overall wonderfully comfortable. The campfire at the center of the hotel is a beautiful and relaxing scene to gaze at in the night. The Pool was clean, also make sure to part take in the mini golf course.

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay!
reviews.text: This is the perfect hotel to stay at if you are wanting to experience downtown Las Vegas. The staff was amazing and super helpful. I loved everything about this hotel. The bar is exactly what is needed if you want to get away and have a nice relaxing drink while listening to music, playing mini golf, or go to the pool. The atmosphere that is created at the Downtowner is perfect if you want to get away from the crowds downtown for a little bit. The room was amazingly clean and perfect for what we wanted. Definitely recommend, we can't wait to go back!

reviews.title: Stayed at the hotel for a couple weeks
reviews.text: Dee was the best! Helped with everything and she made the best drinks!!! (Be sure to tip her she’s worth it) 👏🏾❤️❤️❤️❤️😇 really gonna miss her! Great rooms great ac, if u like to work out your in luck no one uses the gym so u basically will have it to yourself. All of the staff is cool and down to earth, and did I mention that the bar is open 24/7 😌

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: Leslie was such an outstanding person to get to know and appreciate all the service she provide for us most definitely i will be returning to this motel when i return to las Vegas such positive vibes to be around.

reviews.title: Such a good place
reviews.text: The bartender/host lesli was an amazing host and such a breath of fresh air. Totally recomend this place to everyone!and im deffinetley gunna be staying here every time i cum back to vegas #bestmotelinvegas

reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: Awesome little motel with a cool young vibe near Fremont st. Not necessarily a family stay spot but for you and friends this place can be a cool get away to experience Vegas.  Staff is friendly and there when you need it, specially Leslie.

reviews.title: So much unexpected FUN!
reviews.text: My fiancé and I originally planned to stay for one night. We ended up staying for FIVE NIGHTS!!The room was super comfortable. The hospitality was on point the whole time.They have a six hole mini golf course right in the middle of the hotel, as well as a full bar. In the morning there is even Free Coffee down at the bar. The Pool is just feet away and was kept clean the whole time.This hotel helped us realize that the Downtown area is definitely our favorite, and more our vibe. We will Absolutely Be Stayong Here Again!Viva Las Vegas!!

reviews.title: Loved our visit to the new Downtowner👍
reviews.text: All I’ve got to say is wow. Stayed here a couple years ago, and all I’ve got to say about the new and improved downtowner is WOW.Every single employee that we encountered was more then willing to help make our stay more comfortable in every way possible. From the front desk staff to the employees making up the rooms. Everyone seemed sincere about what they can do to make your stay better.And the new putt putt course is super fun as well 🤙Highly recommend to everyone, Thanks, downtowner. Hope to be back soon.My son and I thank you.

reviews.title: Good times!
reviews.text: My wife and I did a staycation for 3 nights to celebrate my 37th Birthday. Could not have asked for a more amazing experience - thank you to Downtowner Boutique! Our room was fantastic and clean - Your staff are so lovely and amazing. And of course - the highlight for me was the bloody mary crafted by Ayela the bartender, perfect!! Thank you team!

reviews.title: Great place to be
reviews.text: I stopped by the Downtowner again today for a few beers and I have to say that this is a very friendly atmosphere. The bartender on duty, Ayela, was awesome. She multitasked very well in serving me drinks along with the other customers, answering the phone, and doing check in work and all with patience and great customer service. Tamara the manager on duty came to check on me as well. They seem to pride themselves on making sure the guests needs are met without delay. I will definitely return to the Downtowner, it's a GREAT PLACE TO BE. See you all soon👍🏼😁💯

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: We had the absolute best experience here. The staff was so friendly and fun at the bar. The property was nice and quite with a great vibe. Out of all of our stays in Vegas. This was our new favorite spot

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Dee and Javier where very supportive and helpful for a great evening, showing use ways to Fremont and all the emminities at the hotel.  Soooo close to Fremont ave and the neon musium.  Great location access to all of the old and new Vegas.

reviews.title: The Staff
reviews.text: I have been wanting to stay at The Downtowner for a few years now. The front desk staff was very kind and knowledgeable which was great and when I needed to extend my stay Ms. Dee helped me so smoothly it couldn’t have been easier!

reviews.title: Best Bang For Your Buck By Far “ The Downtowner”
reviews.text: Hi to anyone that’s looking for a great deal , this is a great place to stay , everything about my experience here was awesome , the rooms where extremely clean and look just like what the pictures advertised. They are well stock with towels and furnished in a really nice contemporary way. The staff was excellent really helpful and chill. Tina when out of her way to accommodate all our needs, she was extremely helpful and took care of all our needs, they also have a private parking where your vehicles will be safe for the night or day .... overall this place is great , clean , safe, and support staff super helpful to make your experience awesome. Totally recommend to anyone that wants “ the best bang for your buck - JJ

reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: Great location. Very safe and clean. Hospitality was amazing. Their design is so photo friendly with the props and mini golf set up! Perfect for those IG and Snapchat posts. Great rates! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: The service was great would recommend you to come here  it is a very chill place to be a little off the strip very quiet and they have great little activities that you can enjoy the receptionist in the front are great as well .

reviews.title: Fantastic customer service
reviews.text: Thank you to Dee who checked us in and was very pleasant after driving across the country her hospitality was heart warming! The hotel has great Modern amenities and no inside hallways which is good for air circulation - yet the area is enclosed by a gate so it is still very safe! Close to the action but not too close! Plus there’s putt putt you can’t beat that!

reviews.title: Fashion Designer
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel...Clean...Great Staff...Excellent Location. Met some really interesting people with great business and creative minds .I really enjoyed the area, literally  located off of Freemont Street...

reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: Awesome place. Can’t wait to come back due to the amazing service. Front desk Dee and Leslie were great, love the mini golf course  and bar!  Everything about this place is amazing every time I visit Vegas I will stay here

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: Great value for dollars, all staff went above and beyond to make the stay great. Just a few blocks from Freemont Experience and many restaurants with in walking distance. Also take advantage of the pool and mini golf both will enhance your stay.

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience
reviews.text: Very, Nice atmosphere,  quiet,  respectful,  The Ladies were really nice an helpful, No Drama, No looking at you all crazy, and the house keeper girl was really sweet,  an did an awesome job, So I'm actually impressed, My Hunny Spoke highly of you all ..all the way to L.A.. lol so yes I would recommend an Return..Thank you (April Moore)

reviews.title: Visiting my brother
reviews.text: Had some very delicious drinks made by ayela. Felt very welcomed and the service was awesome. Highly recommend checking this place out. It is a very unique Las Vegas experience. But close enough to get the whole Las Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Quite Surprised!
reviews.text: Stayed with my 9 year old. Her choice so a little nervous!  Pleasantly surprised!  24 hour bar, free parking, mini golf, swimming all 1 block from the Container Park!  Would def stay again. Awesome staff too!

reviews.title: Good Stay
reviews.text: This is a nice place. Its is clean and you have various attractions closeby. Great location and comfortable stay. The staff are good people and they give you knowledge of what amentities are at your luxurey during your stay as well which was appreciated.

reviews.title: Had a BLAST!!!
reviews.text: This spot was amazing! We have been to Vegas and Downtown many times, but always stayed on the strip. We decided to be different and this place was perfect! The hotel has a super cute retro contemporary feel and is very clean and comfortable. The location, close to Fremont, gave us the opportunity to see so much of Downtown we have never seen before. The staff is super friendly and outgoing. Melissa checked us in, she was awesome! She was full of information, especially with all the local restrictions, and gave us plenty of suggestions on where to go! This was the best trip to Vegas we have had in a longtime and will be back again!

reviews.title: Clean spot
reviews.text: Just spending the night downtown before picking up a friend from the airport. Clean spot, lots of cool murals in the area. Simple room, nice bathroom but no refrigerator. Comfy bed & everything appears clean

reviews.title: 2nd Visit Will return
reviews.text: So I found this Gem last month and I had to come back when I was in Vegas. You get free mini golf, pool, parking, and fitness center, all included with your stay. O did I mention free good WiFi. Annnnd a cocktail bar that is open and serving during COVID. The staff is incredible and the rooms super clean. Love this place!

reviews.title: Great place right next to Fremont st
reviews.text: The employees were fantastic and the place was well kept and clean. Not the fanciest place for what I spent I was expecting a dump. 10/10 would recomend. Mini golf course inside the hotel! Bar in the lobby!

reviews.title: Downtowner is great
reviews.text: My daughter and I found this place yesterday and we think it's wonderful. Their staff is polite and friendly , rooms are clean , no bugs , nice mini golf area. We haven't made it to the pool yet. Guests are quiet and keep to their self.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: You wont find many better options price wise and location wise. Wonderful service from all staff. Front desk, maitnece and room service. Friendly faces. Didnt care to try the putt putt but the pool was nice. I would reccomend if you are looking to safe money in a comfortable way.

reviews.title: Great place!!
reviews.text: Such great friendly staff. Great location from Fremont st. Very nice clean rooms. There’s a fun mini golf inside. 24 hour bar with great drinks. Will definitely be back soon. Thank you to the staff at The Downtowner!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.text: The room was as advertised: clean, nice looking, friendly staff, and conveniently located. Add all that to the nice price and you have yourself a real winner. I especially liked the décor, as it is very different from most places.

reviews.title: The only way we could see our moms
reviews.text: The entire staff was so warm and friendly and all needs were met. Our room was so cute and funky just the way we like it. We had a blast playing on their mini putting greens. Also, it was clean and well taken care of. 10 out of 10 we will stay here again. Since we came to Las Vegas to see our moms it was nice to not have them worrying about where we would stay due to this state of our crazy world right now.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Loved everything about it!!  Great rates, great service, clean rooms and an awesome mini putting course On site!!!  Will stay here again and will tell my friends as well!!  Only thing I suggest is a mini fridge for each room

reviews.title: Friendly Staff!
reviews.text: Ayela, Alejandro, Melissa, Dee, Leslie, Norman and Aracely were friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable about the area. The motel is walking distance to Fremont Street, Ferguson Downtown and local bars and restaurants. I really love staying here and this will be my go to when traveling to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Everybody was great from the room to the staff. I had not one complaint the whole stay. The area was nice as well. Def gonna stay here again and recommend my friends and family traveling to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Favorite downtown spot
reviews.text: Downtowner is now my go-to for staying near Fremont St. The rooms are comfortable and trendy, there are plenty of restaurants, bars, casino and places of interest nearby and the staff is always friendly and helpful.The pool is never crowded and comfortable (though separated from the main building), there is plenty of parking, a bar in the lobby and who doesn’t love a little mini-golf by the lobby? It’s at the heart of the revitalized downtown and has a charming appeal as part of the Arts District. I’ll always opt for Downtowner over the higher-priced but less character-y options down there.

reviews.title: cheap and comfy
reviews.text: we spent 2 nights in the hotel, located conveniently several minutes from the city centre. ac makes you feel good after the day heat. its a quite place worth it's money. there is a mini shop at reception and the pool is open all day long

reviews.title: Darlene (Fresno)
reviews.text: Downtowner was great, from the location to the friendly and accommodating staff to a clean and comfy room. We had 2 peaceful nights sleep and felt very safe. Our granddaughter enjoyed the miniature gold and the misters that were on during the hot afternoons. Definitely worth the money and will stay there again

reviews.title: Denise B
reviews.text: Staff were amazing. Room excellent and very very clean. (Rarely do u see bathroom doors clean). The beds we're Hilton quality.  Since we were 4 adults and had only two keys we had to get staff to let us in several times daily and staff were always happy to help. We will definitely stay here for all future visits. There weren't any negatives.

reviews.title: Good but has a resort fee
reviews.text: Good place with a good location. It does not have a fridge but the size is good.I think it is ideal for a stay in downtown and the hotel may be a good option for those who want to be away from the noisy strip.

reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: An amazing location, right next to Fremont Street (the coolest part of Vegas, if you ask me). The motel was really cute, very clean and well-kept, with free parking (you heard it right), a pool across the street and -the best part- FREE MINI GOLF! We had so much fun in our one night stay and most definitely can't wait to return to the Downtowner for longer next time. Thanks, team!

reviews.title: No mini fridge.
reviews.text: It was a cute place, a 24 hour bar and mini mini golf course. But no noise after 11. It’s quiet time. I got me some cold coffee that I like to enjoy in the morning but no mini fridge so I went to Walgreens and got a mini cooler :(

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This was my first visit to Las Vegas and let me tell you that everything was perfect at Downtowner. The staff was very helpful and always available to assist you with anything you need. Definitely will stay at Downtowner again.

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: Very accommodating when our original hotel would not honor the package booked online. Found this place online, arrived in tears (we flew in for a memorial for my mother who had just passed away), and the front desk helped get everything re arranged. Will stay again.

reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.text: I watched the two ladies, Melissa and Lesley handle multiple guests check in, figure out a difficult situation for an upset individual, get water for someone dehydrated from 115 degree weather, explain the covid19 rules and all with smiles on their faces. These ladies were A game employees and I was truly impressed by their grace in dealing with so many scenarios. Bravo ladies! Also enjoyed the hip, upgraded rooms and mini golf for the kiddos. Felt quite clean too! This was so nice to pay half the price of nearly all other hotels and half the price of most hotels resort fees in Vegas. Humble and hip.

reviews.title: Blast From The Past
reviews.text: The Downtowner is a fun blast from the past. Spearheading the success of mid-century modern movement, it has embraced its history of Vegas years gone by. The room was clean, comfortable and reasonable. I loved that it is just a few blocks from The Fremont Street experience. It’s not the strip but that’s a good thing if you are looking for a more quiet getaway. Give ‘em a try!!

reviews.title: Avoid room 210
reviews.text: If your room is in the area surrounding the mini golf ask to switch immediately because you’ll probably not get any sleep. I stayed here during July 4th so it’s understandable to have loud people passing through however they let people scream in this area for over an hour around 5am. So frustrating.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: In the last few days I've fell in love with the downtowner. Not only do they have beautiful rooms at a reasonable price but they also have amazing customer service which nowadays is a rarity. The young lady Ayela at the front desk seems like she literally goes out of her way 2 try n make ur day.I would also like to send a big thank you to the gm Tamra who always made sure she asked how my day was even in the middle of doing her wrk. When i checc out it will definitely be bittersweet. Thank yall again c yall soon

reviews.title: Good stay gone worng
reviews.text: The pictures make this place look cute and fun, but fails to say there are gang members all around the property and on the property. The room had no air conditioner, the whole room experience was a lesson well learned,

reviews.title: My stay at Downtowner Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: My stay at Downtowner Boutique Hotel was excellent. My room was cleaned daily. Customer service was very helpful and respectful. I have no complaints. And I reccomend The Downtowner Boutique Hotel to all my family,friends,etc.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Ayela the customer service there she was good and nice she helped me a lot and was very happy Friendly person I appreciate and she guide me and she gave good advice and was help it Thank you and I will return here

reviews.title: Nice 👍
reviews.text: I checked in late , around 3am . The lady who was the only person there was the best front desk person I’ve ever met. Her professionalism/demeanor/sharp looks / friendliness was first class all the way. The room was really modern, and the bed was brand new and very comfortable. The climate control was right on. Very very nice and polite Staff. I would stay here anytime

reviews.title: Location to Fremont and Putting greens were awesome!
reviews.text: Good location as it's an easy to walk downtown to Fremont Street Experience, friendly and welcoming staff and the putting greens were so fun to play with my dad. 6 challenging holes (hole-in-one or 3 putt) but we were able to make hole-in-ones on 4 of 6 holes.

reviews.title: Cute place
reviews.text: The place was really cute, they were very friendly and I loved the fact that I could text with and questions, and they would respond. I loved the fire pit and the courtyard. I just wish the location was in a better place. We didn’t feel like we could just walk to anyplace nearby.

reviews.title: Wow! Happiness Delivered!
reviews.text: As guest who has stayed at this property multiple times and has stayed at most properties in Las Vegas, The Downtowner is in my opinion the only Downtown Las Vegas accommodation dedicated exclusively to delivering happiness. The Downtowner is a comprehensive property that features FREE parking, complimentary coffee, a pool, fitness center, putt putt golf, bar and more!The Downtowner is located Downtown Las Vegas, East of Fremont, the most popular LEGIT area of Vegas—the casinos, the restaurants, hotels, rental cars, shows, putt putt golf courses, activities, events, shopping, nightclubs and more al within footsteps of your amazing and clean room.The staff at The Downtowner is nothing short of WOW! Checking in is a breeze and they always greet me with a smile. I feel like Ive known them even though Ive usually never met them as I check in/out at different times. They handle everything about your stay with a giant smile and really make you feel welcome. My last stay I had to print some documents and they totes did it for FREE! I was blown away.The rooms are clean and decorated in faux mid century furniture. I hosted a business meeting during my last stay and the size of the room coupled with the in room desk was nothing short of spectacular. I see some reviews in which people complain about the other guests. YOU are in Vegas which is a 24 hour city so if YOU think people should be in bed by a time that YOU deem appropriate then YOU should bring earplugs or do whatever YOU need. Self empowerment!Ive been a returning guest and I will continue to patronize The Downtowner as I return to Vegas almost monthly. Hats off! Bravo! A big round of applause to The Downtowner Las Vegas and its caring staff. A+++

reviews.title: Great stay and a great event
reviews.text: I have nothing but possitive things to say. I had a few wrinkles not attrubuted to the hotel but the staff here made my transitions easy, affordable, tasteful, tactful and fully approachable. My room was as expected, as deecribed so no surprises, clean,decent affordable in a EXCELLENT location. I only stayed 2 days but after ch ed checking in 2 more would not have bothered me a bit. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for budget minded travelers. Unless I was an exception (and they dont know me from adam) this place is exceptional for the buck.

reviews.title: solo travel
reviews.text: That was very clean and organised place with safe and free parking in one of the best locations in Las Vegas. The staff were very approachable and helpful. They have Very friendly team with high communication skills. i recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: retro modern cozy warm clean beauty yes yes!
reviews.text: we keep extending. we keep coming back.the staff is like home. a beautiful crew of wonderful women who feel like fam.coffee every morning. cucumber water. putt putt golf. a gym. location in the center of the action. bar in the lobby, music, couches to werq.the remodeled rooms are adorable.hennie, for the money--you can't get it better. <3

reviews.title: if you planing on just getting drunk and not sleeping much this is good place for you...it was not for me.
reviews.text: if you planing on just getting drunk and not sleeping much this is good place for you...it was not for me.

reviews.title: Chill hotel
reviews.text: The rooms are great, put together. The tv has all the important channels. And best of all there's a bar on the ground level. So when youre done hanging out on Fremont you can come back and have a drink. The concierge will always be your best guide to the area.

reviews.title: Basic, but great!
reviews.text: Keep in mind, this is a place to lay your head after a day of adventuring. Its not frilly, but covers all your needs! Clean, comfortable. We stay every year for about 10 days, because while my partner fishes Lake Mead, i can easily walk to Fremont or catch bus to Vegas Strip.Nice people! Last 2 years has been under new owners/mgmt and they have really cleaned up the property, and are working on the building across the street.. at a later date.We love the downtowner, for our basic needs! Bed, shower, AC, clean linens, nice TV and strong wifi.

reviews.title: Stay at Downtowner
reviews.text: Cool vintage rooms, friendly staff, great value, cheapest drinks in Vegas at the bar, and free mini-golf! I first found this place by stumbling in one afternoon to have a drink at the bar. I fell in love and decided to make it my place to stay going forward.

reviews.title: Adorable but an Inferno
reviews.text: Adorable lil spot with nice, clean remodeled rooms, and a very friendly staff.  Free parking in a lot right next to the building.  Close to everything, walk everywhere.  However...  The room was hottttttt.  No AC, no ceiling fan. There was some sort of vent fan, but it only blew hot air.  We visited in mid February, so still 40's at night. We slept with the window wide open, but really no airflow. Sweat all night and didn't sleep.  Still giving 4 stars, because other than that, the place was a great time. We did not try to remedy the situation either. IT was late, we were tired, and just wanted to get some rest.

reviews.title: Misleading pictures and horrible experience
reviews.text: The pictures are so misleading of the website. It only reflects the remodeled rooms located in the main building. I had room 173 located in the 116 building. Upon walking in, place smelled like urine. My room smelled like urine. There were stains on the wall. I had been traveling for 12 hours and was exhausted. This made it all so much more worse. I left early the next morning as I was desperate to get out of there. Broken latches in the door. Stained bathroom walls. And horrible stain in the table. Thin walls with a barking dog

reviews.title: Had a blast!
reviews.text: The downtowner was such a fantastic experience!! The staff was incredibly helpful and just awesome! Will definitely stay here when I go to vegas again!! The area around the hotel is just as amazing so definitely give it a shot!!

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: We ask for a non smoking room, when we got there it smell a lot like cigarettes. We went to the front desk and they were rude they said they couldn't do anything because we reserved thru a third party. We parked in the hotel parking and we got a ticket.  Just really bad overall.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Easy parking.  Clean rooms. Fast checkin. Safe and convenient location. Beds are comfy  would definitely stay here again. 2 blocks to Fremont st   Lots of good eats close by and lots of parking

reviews.title: Caching Vegas
reviews.text: Downtowner is in a great location for the Fremont Experience.  The walking distance makes the ability to enjoy restaurants and bars easier.  Staff were great and check in and out were a breeze.  We also felt secure in the area and the motels seems to make that a priority.

reviews.title: Great rooms for a low price...
reviews.text: Rooms are well kept.  Fun little golf course within the downtowner.  Close to freemont street and various food to go dine out on.  Some loud music can be heard at night from around the city, though nothing that is negative to not want to stay at the hotel.Depending on what is going on in the area, almost all hotel prices can go up including this one on the weekends.  I thank you for the time to read what I have put up.God Bless.

reviews.title: Downtowner Motel
reviews.text: Nice place near the down. Worth the price. It's just a street away from Fremont street, golden nugget and there are good restaurants near by. The room was neat and clean. It's a safe place to spend your downtown time in Las vegas

reviews.title: Great stay at Downtowner for Valentines day
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed here for Valentine's day weekend and we absolutely loved it. Great and accommodating staff and the best location for Fremont street Experience and friends that we like to visit. Will come again soon.

reviews.title: Perfect spot
reviews.text: Our expectations were pretty low after paying such a cheap rate for our room, but we were pleasantly surprised when we arrived! Location was awesome—right off Fremont St. The room was perfectly clean, and minimal but efficient! The atmosphere was super cool, staff was incredibly friendly and helpful when we checked in, and we will definitely be staying here again on our next trip to Vegas.

reviews.title: The Downtowner
reviews.text: We have been here two nights and this hotel is a great place to stay, the staff is wonderful and the rooms are clean no frills but really nice, the beds are so comfortable and very reasonable I would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend it, plus it is in walking distance to casinos and Fremont Street that's why I give it five stars

reviews.title: Pure Friendly Downtown Stay
reviews.text: If you’re laid back and have an appreciation for a clean, comfortable no fuss stay then the Downtowner is the place. I’ve stayed here numerous times and must admit I know a lot of the staff.  That said, take the time to learn their names and share your life a bit and they might share a bit of theirs.  They are a fun interesting likable group to get to know. The golf coarse is a blast no matter how many times you’ve played it and I’ve played it a lot.... The bar is like Cheers for the modern day, grab a seat and soak it up. The pillows and beds are very comfortable. It can be a bit noisy at times but that’s Vegas pack your ear plugs just in case. Did I mention the wonderful staff?😂

reviews.title: "Not so downtowner"
reviews.text: Good hotel for a short stay.The rooms were clean but there is no way you can contact the reception in case of any need.The neighborhood is also lil bit unsafe regarding the place located in downtown itself.

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing!!
reviews.text: My stay at the Downtowner Motel was absolutely amazing!! The lobby/bar reception for check in is really chic and upbeat and the front desk staff is helpful and they are all super friendly!! The rooms are very clean and are definitely worth the money. And for the rates of the room you can’t beat it!! My family and I will surely be back and I’ve already told all of my friends about this place!!

reviews.title: GREAT BANG FOR YOUR BUCK!
reviews.text: I planned a quick inexpensive surprise birthday trip for my honey and the Downtowner was a great place to stay! Everyone I encountered at the front desk was nice and pleasant The room was clean The bed was COMFY!!! The Freemont Experience is literally at the corner, Not even a 5 min walk! I will defiantly be staying here again :)

reviews.title: It's cheap.
reviews.text: I booked this at 4am for the same day. I booked with a $5.00 per day "resort" fee. On check in at about 5am I was charged $21 per day "resort" fee. The clerk said she could not adjust the resort fee back to what I had reserved. I could not figure out the heating system and the room was 48 degrees when I checked. In the "morning" the manager asked for my booking receipt and changed my "resort" fee to the $5.00 per night that I had booked. BUT...I should not be the one to have to prove what I booked. This is predatory behavior. Still 3 stars for now and if they do it again to me it will be 2 stars.

reviews.title: Places like this ruin the potential of a great area and city.
reviews.text: Deceptive pricing (Resort fee). Loud at night. Unaccommodating front desk.They don't expect to see you again and because of that don't treat guests with decency. Common in touristy places. It's a great area. Management needs to train it's staff. To reiterate. Not helpful staff. Not a resort. Charging you a fee like it was. No laundry on site or even nearby. They can't even suggest a place. No food on site. Can't sleep at night because it's loud. Please stay somewhere else.

reviews.title: Cute and quaint
reviews.text: Great location, room was fresh n clean.  Check in counter doubles as bar, which is weird and awesome at the same time.  Kahla and Tina are great at a difficult task(negotiating both bar and check in), and they do it while being both friendly and helpful.  Couldn’t help but notice how the manager on duty at the time provided ZERO assistance during a very busy checkin period.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Great room, great location!  This was a fun place to stay. It was close to all the places we wanted to go to. The staff were nice and helpful. I will definitely stay here again. The bed was very comfortable.

reviews.title: Best kept secret on Fremont Secret
reviews.text: This little hotel has been recently remodeled and with the classic vibe of mid-century modern appeal; The hotel has a friendly watering hole nestled in hotel lobby that serves great crafted cocktails from a friendly staff. The rooms a fresh and clean with a Minimalistic appeal.

reviews.title: Well kept motel, for us the best place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The location is absolutely phantastic, just a block from container park, Downtown Las Vegas and Fremont Street. We enjoyed the yard of the motel as it allowed us to hang out and have a beer that we did not have to purchase at the bar. Altough the bar is really great and worth to have a drink too. All friendly people and surprisingly many locals go there. We slept very well on the second floor. Rooms are clean and spacious enough. All in all best value for money.

reviews.title: crappy rooms
reviews.text: dirty and not maintained.  burned out light bulbs reported to management and not replaced in the 3 days we were there. shower had mold and dirt in it. bathroom sink was dirty and had old spilled paint in it. toilet was not clean. old partial soda left in corner from previous guests. blinds wouldn't close all the way.

reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the way I was treated and accommodated. Very close by Fremont and a fun walk too. Best bang for your buck, without all the noise if you're trying to relax after a long day/night! I will return in the future!

reviews.title: Too expensive for the nuisance
reviews.text: I could not get enough sleep because of the loud repairing sounds (sounded like a jack hammer and a saw) right next door and it was almost 1am. I couldn't even use the bathroom because the toilet didn't flush properly and the sink was clogged too. I'm hoping that the pubic looking hair in the sink was from a mans beard!! I'm getting the chills and sick just thinking about it. There was some kind of dried up residue right outside of our door that looked like it was from the toilet. It's probably all backed up.

reviews.title: Vegas Holiday
reviews.text: Cute hotel! Very comfortable,  close to Fremont Street. Friendly staff! It needs a microwave and mini fridge otherwise it is a great place to chill and relax. Great bar service too! There is a miniature golf course on the inner court yard with a fireplace.

reviews.title: Highly recommended place in Las Vegas. It is also walking distance to Freemont and clubs.
reviews.text: Downtowner is a nice place to stay. Employees here are very welcoming and warm upon arrival. Downtowner maintain there room nice, clean, and tidy. Amedies are beyond expectation. Room is maintain warm and cozy during winter.

reviews.title: Girlfriend felt this place is the better choice if you don’t want to take a long walk through a casino full of people.
reviews.text: Girlfriend felt this place is the better choice if you don’t want to take a long walk through a casino full of people.

reviews.title: Great Location, Great rooms
reviews.text: Great place to stay if you are trying to have a night out of drinking and partying!!!!!! easy to locate whether you are on foot or driving. Only downfall is the parking, if its an event night it is a little harder to find parking.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We loved the amenities and the location very much. Very good for someone attending MJBizCon. The golf was very fun to have there to pass the time. Short walk to Fremont Street. Would recommend to a business person.

reviews.title: Nightmare hotel never go there
reviews.text: Very Dirty motel . The staff is struggling between reception of the hotel and bar services ... they make you pay 20 dollars extra fee for the parking despite free parking announced on booking . The parking is far away from the room in another street . The room is just un breathable due to a very bad smell in the hallway . The housekeeping is not done at all . The carpet is very very very dirty . No “curtains “ in the windows so everyone gets to see you from outside .

reviews.title: Would not stay here again
reviews.text: This hotel is cheap, staff was nice although seemed very disorganized. Room not clean at check in, door was open and it appeared as though somebody came in from the street and used the bathroom, pretty disturbing. If you stay here, make sure you are not in the rooms on the outside off the sidewalk; it was extremely loud at all hour with people partying loudly walking down the street. It’s probably worth paying a little more to stay somewhere else.

reviews.title: Great clean Quiet Rodney w
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Downtowner, The best Hotel in Las Vegas for the Price , iyella G best employeeThe other African female morning shift is also helpful and smart , All issues they have the knowledge and abilities to solve , Need more like them , I'll return each monthSo comfortable and quiet

reviews.title: The Wylde
reviews.text: I stayed in the building next to the Downtowner. The structure was older but revitalized with some character, a jungle theme. Large closet space, 1 roach included. The bathroom towels were rough but white. Good door lock. A basic room that served it's one night purpose.

reviews.title: Weekend
reviews.text: I was there with my friends for the weekend. It was my first experience in a motel! Well, I was very happy. There were 4 of us with two double beds. Nice and well furnished room, very comfortable beds and what we really liked was that there was minigolf in the inner cry! Great value for money. The motel is in a good position, close to Fremont street and not far from the center. We only used Uber to get around but you can also take the bus if you want. We had not included breakfast in the price but we could still have coffee or tea for free. I recommend it

reviews.title: Roach Motel
reviews.text: This place is horrible.  The lobby is the best thing this place has going for itself.  We checked in thinking this place was a great deal for downtown Vegas but when we walked in the hallway we knew it was going to be horrible.  The hallways are dark and had a smell to it.  Walked into our room and I knew we could not stay here.  Stains on the bed, hair in the tub, and blood stains on the floor.  I wouldn't stay here if this was the last place on earth.

reviews.title: Best off strip hotel ever!
reviews.text: Since remodeled this hotel is amazing! Throwback in time with the theme of Vintage Vegas. Walked to downtown in less than 5 minutes.Completed our night by the glass firepit. Super clean, quiet and cozy.

reviews.title: Diamond in a rough
reviews.text: Didn't have coffee as was stated on reservation, other than that the room was clean, hate that everything was at the main hotel such as ice machine, bar etc. Would definitely come back again. Close to downtown party destinations.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Awesome accommodation. Great service, cleanly, good value, great location near Freemont St. Old Las Vegas, sleep quality comparable to 5 stars, and good clean rooms. I was a convenient walking distance to Old Vegas and just an Uber/Lyft away from the Strip at a fair decent price!

reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: Hi.Made a booking, had to cancel and change rooms ect. But made a booking the same evening again. It said 7 days to cancel a booking free of charge. Got charged for the nights. I booked 2 rooms, but charged 4 times on my account.  Waited 7-8 days after calling them and they confirmed the money is being transferred back to my account. After waiting so long I informed booking.com.They called the manager and asked her what's going on. She then said they overlooked it and that she is transferring it back straight away.  Checked in and it went alright. I just think you should check people in first before helping other customers at the bar while guests are waiting. After booking out after 3 nights stay the lady did not even say thank you for your stay or anything of the sort. All she said was your all checked out and everything is payed. They are just going to check out the rooms, I politely asked should I wait while you check them out?. She just said no and then assisted the people at the bar while they were waiting to be served. Not even a goodbye nothing. I turned around and walked out.The service in the place needs attention.

reviews.title: I love this place 🤗
reviews.text: I’m from Palm Springs ca.! ...and I wanted to go to Las Vegas for my 30 birthday !!! I had a blast ! I loved this place !!! I love that it was kid friendly!! A reasonable price and walking distance from everything!!!!

reviews.title: A clean no frills Hotel
reviews.text: If you are looking for a clean, no frills Hotel, this is it. I highly recommend if you are tired of staying on the strip and want to try something new. Casino's around the corner, the bar is awesome. It literally is a very clean bed, (a fun putting course), and small rooms. It is a old hotel/monthly rental hotel that has been somewhat renovated. Do not have expectations you are staying at a Strip Hotel. The Wylde is the worst part of the hotel (dark, very little natural lighting hence the low cost to stay in that part of the hotel), and I would recommend paying a tad bit more and not staying at this part. If they tore it down and rebuilt something else, it would be great.First off, when you arrive, the front desk is also a bar. To be able to check-in to your hotel, being surrounded by happy people in a bar is funky and fun. Everyone that works here was attentive to what I needed ("is there anything else I can help you with?" was a constant refrain heard over and over during my stay) and I had the most interaction with Tina the front desk/bartender. Tina was a refreshing vibrant personality and after returning to the hotel after dealing business/drama with family for three days, it made they stay pleasant. She is that one employee that makes businesses receive great ratings. I would recommend this hotel if you are looking for a no frills environment and want to get away from the turmoil on the strip. DO NOT EXPECT A FIVE STAR STRIP RESORT/HOTEL AND YOU WILL BE HAPPY YOU STAYED HERE. EXPECTING A STRIP HOTEL AND AMENITIES, YOU WILL BE DISAPPOINTED AND LEAVE A CRAPPY REVIEW.

reviews.title: Great basic room
reviews.text: Great location. Close to freemont but enough distance to have a quiet night sleep.  Room does need curtains so you can sleep in a little.  Nice staff friendly and helpful when tv would not work  maintenance  guy fixed it right away.We had fun playing mini golf.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I've been in the hotel business for over 25 yrs I was very impressed on the remodeled rooms, the attention to detail and professional manner  of employee ayela.  She was very knowledgeable and nice. We will definitely stay again

reviews.title: Downtowner Motel
reviews.text: This motel jus went under recent renovation. My stay was for 10 days in the Wyle Motel it was a great choice. The staff was professional and friendly. I received 2 complimentary drinks. They are near container and the whole Fremont Experience literally a five minute walk. Close to city center. They also have breakfast vouchers and brochures for different activities in the downtown area.

reviews.title: the downtowner
reviews.text: This hotel is good for the money but my tv didn’t work and when I went to ask about it they scheduled a appointment to fix it but never happened the heat cutoff after the first night and it made a loud noise when it did come on but overall my stay was great

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: Loved the bar setting and how inexpensive the drinks were, Rooms were great as well! Really enjoyed the fact that the hotel was just minutes away and walking distance from downtown Las Vegas. Overall I had a great experience.

reviews.title: Funky cool hideout
reviews.text: This place is defintely ecclectic. Our AC did not work in our room so that would be my biggest complaint. The maintenance man came to check out the issue but said there wasn't anything he could do. So I felt like my issue was not resolved or important to the staff.

reviews.title: Great Hotel!!
reviews.text: Stayed for 4 nights. I was in LV for business and decided to stay there since it had much better reviews than another hotel in the area for the same price.It was absolutely worth it. This little boutique-style hotel is only 2 blocks from Freemont, a block from Container Park, near Art District. Area is clean and neat. As a woman traveling by myself, I felt safe walking by myself no matter the time.Customer service was outstanding and fast. I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a good price.

reviews.title: very happy
reviews.text: everything was what I expected. perfect. their was one tiny problem but it was fixed. right away. once again great staff. I wouldn't change a thing. I should be coming up again in the next month. see you then

reviews.title: TERRIBLE MANAGEMENT
reviews.text: Very poor management & Facilities  Staff is very passive aggressive and do not wish to accommodate for any of the visitors  my deposit was not refunded for poor judgement of an issue that was ongoing the minute I arrived  0 Stars from me NEVER staying here again  They will be hearing from my lawyer

reviews.title: Great Downtown Destination
reviews.text: The Downtowner was a nice surprise. My husband and I have visited but never stayed. The rooms were brand new and super clean. The beds were comfortable with enough linens and pillows. The mini golf is super hard but fun. The bar is open 24/7. And there is free quality coffee every morning. What else do you need for Vegas? Our friends who stayed at another "fancy" downtown hotel said they will consider staying here next trip. It is one block over from the Freemont (2min walk). It is also close to several restaurants.

reviews.title: Very cheap place
reviews.text: very plain room with no phone in the room  maid was rude and i was overcharged they did correct it but overall a bad experience  about as plain a room as you can get with a very small chair and bed that is it

reviews.title: Recently Renovated Motel Forgets the Basics
reviews.text: While I liked the look, the mid century modern design aesthetic, the furnishings were impractical. The globe lights with clear glass shine bright in your face. I had to cover one with a shirt to cut the glare. The nightstands had curved edges, so items rolled right off. There's no heat(!) & it got down to the 30s the night I stayed. Luckily I had a blanket I'd brought from home but I had to sleep with my hoodie on as my room was an icebox. Incredibly, unbelievably, they CUT OFF THE WATER from midnight to 6am. There was no notice so I called the desk in the middle of the night & they gave me this story that it was a city outage. I'm a former resident of Vegas. There's no such thing as a "water outage." It's an old building & clearly they were afraid the pipes would freeze. They could have just said this! So this meant no flushing of the toilet and rationing my drinking water. I have a disorder called dysautonomia (basically very low blood pressure) and have to drink fluids constantly to keep my blood pressure up. I drink several gallons a day. To suddenly have water unavailable to me was really frustrating. In all my travels the world over, I've never had a hotel deny me a basic necessity needed for survival! My room smelled strongly of cigarettes and I could hear the neighbors loud and clear. A vent in the ceiling was falling out and the tiles in the shower needed to be grouted. I could go on & on! It's a dump, plain and simple.

reviews.title: Great value close to downtown
reviews.text: Cute, clean rooms for a great price. Very comfortable beds. Quiet, yet an easy walk from all the attractions downtown. The fairway rooms are the nicest in my experience and worth the small price increase.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: No smoking and no playing golf after 10  people off the street should not be alluded into the hotel area unless booking in.  Desk clerk in morning was not friendly during check out.  Room did not have electrical outlet for hair dryer.

reviews.title: Vegas Freemont St Hotel
reviews.text: Was in Las Vegas on business and wanted to stay near Fremont street but didn't want to deal with all the hassles of the casinos on the main street. Found the Downtowner on line and took a chance. Very glad I did. It was close enough for a quick walk to all the action on Fremont st but just far enough away to be calmer at night. Plus parking was a breeze, easy in and out from two lots across the street. They also had a miniature golf set-up in the center of the main building. I didn't have the time to play but it was well maintained and looked like fun. Heather at the front desk/Bar was awesome. Would definitely recommend the place.

reviews.title: Vacation/travel
reviews.text: This place just a 5 min walk away from the Strip and all the NEW improvements to Fremont St. It is very easy access off the freeway for travelers. (We felt safe in the area as well )Our first room had a few issues, the TV didn’t work properly and the dead bolt was having issues, so the manager graciously upgraded us. We ended up on the ground floor with the indoor mini putt putt course just outside our door. What a treat!  Well done and very relaxing. The facility has been updated in a throw back to the sixties theme. The rooms are clean and the bed was very comfortable.  We slept in a queen. My husband and I usually need a king size. It was very nice.I give it a 4 star for the bit of slamming doors that disturbed us briefly and I personally would have liked a blanket for the bed. For $47 we thought we got a great value, location and exceptional customer service. We would stay again and ask for a blanket as well as a second floor room. Note: this motel has no elevators.

reviews.title: A taste of old Las Vegas
reviews.text: I knew I'd be happy when I drove up to see a big pink neon sign pointing toward my room. The front staff was kind and understanding, the room recently renovated. The amenities were fairly bare bones, but I didn't need bells and whistles during my stay. The public courtyard with a fireplace and lounge furniture was comfortable and the hotel's proximity to downtown and ease of commute to the strip was ideal. Will return without a doubt.

reviews.title: Decent but noisy
reviews.text: The place was nice enough for the price, location suited us fine, but the soundproofing was worse than nonexistant. humming machine noise in the walls was the first sign things weren't great, could hear neighbour's conversations through the walls easily and the street noise was as if it was happening inside the room. Vegas is a noisy town and there was no escape.

reviews.title: Perfect!!!
reviews.text: Fun, clean, Amazing staff. You can’t beat the location. Bar and mini golf to pass time and Fremont street at your fingertips. I would definitely look at staying here again. Really enjoyed my stay here.

reviews.title: Perfect for the price
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay here. The bed was comfy and we always had fresh towels. Loved the mini golf course and outdoor fireplace. Has a fifties vibe. Close to the Fremont experience. Definitely would recommend this place! We stayed close to the main lobby... also a bar. Morning coffee free in the lobby. We could walk to the pawn stars shop, took about 15 minutes. Took the Double deuce to the Strip. Although we preferred Fremont much more.

reviews.title: Great Hotel, great staff
reviews.text: The Downtowner is a very nicely kept up hotel, friendly staff, great amenities, within walking distance of The Fremont Street Experience and various restraints/ Night clubs. I would definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family. Thank you to Staff Heather, Angie, Tina and the whole Downtowner staff.

reviews.title: Fremont Vegas fun
reviews.text: There are no frills with this location.It's musty inside THE WYLDE area where we stayed @ The Downtowner which has worn out green astro turf for carpet in the hallway to the room. The interior room floors are laminated wood in good shape.There's obviously an airflow issue with the place because the musty wet smell continues into the room.The small sliding window in the room helped aid natural airflow into the room which was a plus but having an actual screen on that window would have been much nicer for peace of mind sake from the outside elements & critters.You get a bed that is comfortable, functioning old school airconditioning on the wall & one small round bar of soap for any and all bathroom needs. The Showerhead height in the tub/shower is extremely low but, the head itself is updated & will swivel & rotate.It's definitely a budget, old, old, old structure. However, having a super short walking distance for easy access right onto Eastside Fremont Street Experience is what makes this old dinosaur bones place a low-budget winner.

reviews.title: What a nice surprise........
reviews.text: I was taking a staycation at my favorite spot in all Las Vegas, Downtown Freemont st.There was a lack of available rooms, but i manged to find one at The Downtowner....I've never stayed here but I figured why not, it's cheap and only one night...Well, I checked in and met Angie who was super sweet and accommodating. I stayed in room 259 and the bed was amazing!!!  I was shocked....They have a mini-golf course on the property and a fun little bar area....I totally recommend staying here...When you check-in, say hello to Angie and grab a cold beer.....Enjoy!!!!

reviews.title: Short walk to the Fremont Experience
reviews.text: Arrived on a Saturday night and this place was hopping! Stay here for the great location at a fair price. It's pretty basic, but there is a bar right at check-in -- actually, the check-in counter WAS the bar -- which sets a party tone. And did I say short walk to the downtown attractions?  Will recommend this place!

reviews.title: Even mini-golf!
reviews.text: Cute and cozy, 60's-fantastic! If you need a quiet night, this is not the place for you. If you're out enjoying Fremont Street and want a clean bed and friendly staff, this place has it all. Even mini golf!

reviews.title: Couldn’t sleep a wink!
reviews.text: This place is meant for those who wish to party hard and never sleep. Better for a budget conscious younger crowd.We were kept awake all night by drunk guests yelling, stomping up hallways, banging on doors, and vomiting... This is an updated older building, so you can hear and feel everything! When the occupants of the room next door stumbled out of bed to vomit for 2hrs straight it literally shook our bed. It’s also worth mentioning that this motel shares its back alley with an out door music venue/club that plays very loud music. We didn’t sleep at all. Parking was also a little sketchy.
