There is a small lot that is closer to the motel that fills up quickly. The overflow lot is a bit more of a walk and the area is kind of rough, so it wasn’t my favorite walk. I suggest parking and leaving it in the close lot and Uber if you go anywhere in the evening. On the upside, the room was very clean. This place just needs a bit more work (or high quality work- some of the renos are sloppy), and perhaps more staffing/security at night to manage the behavior of the guests...

reviews.title: Very happy with my stay
reviews.text: Very kind and professional staff.  Check-in and check-out was very fast.  Just had two issues:We were unable to cold the water in the sink nor the shower. Also, the TV turned on/off but did not display any channels.  However, these issues will not stop me to stay in this hotel in the future.

reviews.title: October Weekend
reviews.text: Location very good, but the room was dirty and very old. It was not modern or clean. Bathroom was very bad, but the service was good. Always fresh towels and beddings. If you only sleep there, the Hotel is good for you

reviews.title: Great for price
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had an amazing experience at this place. The staff was friendly and the bar was great and inexpensive! We were able to walk to downtown and weren't that far from the strip. The rooms were nice and cleaned well.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: Close the the freemont experience  but without being in the thick if things.  Has nice pool that's not crowded. Awesome mini golf on site along with on site bar and friendly staff. Beds and pillows super comfy. Great TV. Wish there was a mini fridge esp bc the ice machine was empty a lot.

reviews.title: Get what you pay for
reviews.text: Close to Freemont street. You get what you pay for. The room was clean and the bed was comfy. The non smoking feels secluded from the rest of the complex. All in all it was alright to stay at. Parking was a little weird but once they explained, it was smooth.

reviews.title: Bikefest
reviews.text: There are improve alot since I was there last year, I like it, nice customer service all the team are nice and friendly ready to help in anything. Also they have a free coffee every morning for customers.

reviews.title: Coudln't be worse
reviews.text: nothing positive to say, couldn't be worse. Prices we paid for on Booking.com were not enough as we had to pay deposite of 23$ which we didn't receive back.It was last night of my holidays so I didn't have enough money on my credit card for the 2 x 100$ guarantee. I had cash which they didn't accept, and I could pay with my Maestro which they didn't accept either. They didn"t care if I would sleep on the street or not. They were not customer orientated at all. rest of the hotels during my stay were perfect, this one couldn't be worse !

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Nice place to stay , for last minute trip. Very clean , friendly staff. The pool is peaceful. I wasn’t sure about the area but it turned out great. The lady even let us park a day before check in. I’m very happy and will recommend for single ladies, very safe girl trip

reviews.title: Not a 5 star
reviews.text: Service was good overall when arrival and check out. Rooms should be fix more and less smelling and linen for bed need more work because it felt itchy and felt like things were crawling and toliet didnt flush

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This place is almost everything we wanted in the perfect stay.  Great location within walking distant to local art, local eats, museums, and Fremont Street.  Also, they have free parking across the street.  Only wish was an in room refrigerator.

reviews.title: Vegas for the weekend
reviews.text: This place was super cute. The staff was friendly. We were able to walk to the Fremont District which had awesome bars, entertainment and food! But my favorite thing about this motel was the 1950's themed mini golf in the lobby. you could play for free with you stay!

reviews.title: I would rate this motel for young people who want to party
reviews.text: There was no handicap rooms therefore we had to pack my brother in and out of the restroom. We were continual approached by intoxicated people. If you there to party and be drunk and obnoxious this is the hotel to stay.

reviews.title: The Downtowner Las Vegas
reviews.text: A very Nostalgic place to stay. The accommodations are very limited. However the era comes alive once you experience the feel of Freemont street experience.This is not an extended stay hotel/motel. Our one night during our trip was less than we had hoped for and dragging luggage upstairs to the 2nd level was much less than desired. (No elevators and no bell hop assistance) .

reviews.title: be carrefull when chose rooms.
reviews.text: i pay more for Wylde room (Wylder room its separate from the Motel), but i stay on Standard room in the simple motel for 05 nights. Thats its the only problem i have. The space its very clear, the bed is good and localization its very good.

reviews.title: Short visit at Las Vegas - Poor Experience at the motel
reviews.text: The room that was assigned to me was a small room. The closet in the room didn't have any hangers at all to hang the  clothes. The only tiny little window in the room had a blind, however, it was stuck open, couldn't close the blind. I had trouble sleeping with lights from outside getting through the tiny window. They charge additional over $22 per night as so called resort fee, however, I was not able to figure out why they charge this amount of resort fee at a motel similar to a Motel 6. Only thing I was able to use is the Wi-fi for less than an hour during my one night stay, but that shouldn't cost over $22. Checkout guest service agent had an attitude problem.

reviews.title: DO NOT COME HERE IF YOU ARE IN A WHEELCHAIR
reviews.text: There are no ramps to get in to check in. After seeing my father waiting outside in his motorized scooter we were still put in the second building that had no ramp. Without a ramp we had to stay in our room most of the stay. When checking out we complained about the amenities fee because without the most basic amenity of a ramp we could not enjoy any amenities. The manager or owner was there when we were checking out and was very rude when we were asking the checkout lady to waive the fees and said everyone pays no exceptions. I am sorry but

reviews.title: Watch out for additional fees
reviews.text: The room was clean and recently redone.  The air conditioner sounded like an airplane so I will have to turn it off to sleep.  If I had signed up today rather than a week ago, the price would have been quite a bit less.  There is $100 security deposit, and a $23 "amenities fee."

reviews.title: What a find!!!!!
reviews.text: What a find, I found myself in Vegas for a work trip and was looking for a nice small place to stay on line.  I came upon the Downtowner and it looked kind of cool so I booked a room.  Getting to the motel might make you a little leery but as you get closer things begin to change.  The area is going through a rebirth and has a lot of energy.  The staff was immediately inviting as you check in.  Checking in can be confusing  and is also a different experience because the lobby is styled a bit like an old time diner but with a bit of a 70’s vibe.  Tera leads the welcoming All-star team of Jay, Tina, Heather (Bubbles), Ayela, Monique.  These folks really know how to make people feel at home.  Whether looking for a place to eat, see cool stuff or just hang the staff is your best resource for information.  The staff also doubles as the bartenders since the lobby is also a 24hr bar.  Needless to say, great conversation takes place with the staff, other guests and a cast of local characters that help to make the time pass enjoyably. I’d also like to mention that security is well staffed in the area.Now, just to reinforce my positive review, I can say that since my first visit have had the pleasure of returning multiple times to only have my experience enhanced and now it feels like home.

reviews.title: i was shocked
reviews.text: they need to remodel that building , everything was dirty, there was no decor just all white walls. The shower water stayed hot i couldn't make it colder . Tv only stayed on if the light was on? Carpet was so dirty i never took my socks or shoes off.

reviews.title: Best Motel Ever
reviews.text: Super Clean, Great Service and Rates, Love The MINI Golf Course, Hands Down Would Recommend The Downtowner For Families And or Whoever. The Cleaning Staff Are Super Friendly and Hard Good Workers As Well As The Lobby Staff.

reviews.title: Heather is amazing
reviews.text: The first impression wasn't very good, but then Heather made everything completely smooth! Wonderful woman!!!Rooms in white building across the street from the office need some work.. Housekeepers should clean bath tubs better, there were pieces of hair from shaving in bath tubs (in two rooms!). And the wifi doesn't work in that white building across the street.

reviews.title: Very horrible experience
reviews.text: We started our trip as a family going to Vegas to see the sights unfortunately or hotel experience Was  Horrible scary My son 10 years old has autism Was just terrified  The entire way home It all started our 2nd evening when my wife and I asked the front desk lady why there was a  Sewage smell just in the lobby she take a big offense and started to cuss us out We did the same back and went up to our Room Where a security guard came up asked us what was going on and then just left The next day me and my family stayed away from the hotel for over 16 hours when we went back we woke up in the morning and the front desk lady and her  Boyfriend Followed me and my wife out to or car where he spit on me and try to grab me out of my car I had to call the police and have them escort me and my kids out of the hotel checking out almost 2 days early on our vacation I know there's not much you're going to do about this But as a personal business owner myself management and staff that deal with the customers directly should always be in self control of themselves The lady told me she was the supervisor I don't know we checked out and  Thank the police officer And drove 12 hours home I would only request that I talk to somebody other than the staff at the hotel.

reviews.title: Very clean and in the heart of downtown las vegas
reviews.text: Very clean Comfortable bedQuite neighborhoodFriendly staffQuality serviceClose to freemont and las vegas strip and all bus depot. Affordable Free parking Beautiful breeze all the timeSuper friendly staff and onsite management

reviews.title: Pretty cool place to rest
reviews.text: Pretty clean, great place to get a quiet nights rest. I heard no noise the entire two nights I was there! My service dog Brownie and I needed a few nights rest and a break from being outside for 14 days 24/7. So needless to say a bed and a big TV was all we needed. Check in staff was a little curt...kinda like they were looking down on my dog and me but the check out girl made up for their attitudes. I don't like people that have that sense of entitlement. So bravo to the young lady who worked the front office last Saturday September 6th at 10:30-11am and checked me out. You're part of the reason I'm planning on staying there next time I need a room for a few nights!!

reviews.title: Amazing place!
reviews.text: One of the coolest downtown hotels.   I stayed in the remodeled side and was very impressed with the decor and the shower was huge!!  The single room left tons of room for activities!!  The front desk is super cute, and the bar is really welcoming.  The front desk staff are the bartenders, and sometimes it seems like they are stretched too thin trying to do both. Despite that they are ALL rockstars and they treat every guest well, even the ones that are screaming at them, they are masters of dealing with the conflict that comes with working a hotel and bar in Vegas. Specifically Jay, Heather, Tina, Ayela, Monique. These people turned a good trip into an exceptional one.   Tell them I sent you, and I am pretty sure you might get a chuckle!      LOVE THIS PLACE!

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text: They didn't clean our room. I asked 2 times until they finally did. Then when they finally did they took all the towels, didn't sweep or throw out the trash. The water pressure in the shower was so low it took me forever to wash my hair! Then, the water wouldn't go down the drain! I'll give them credit for fixing it almost right away. They only have 1 ice machine. I was there 5 days and the machine only worked 2 of those days. I had to go to the front desk to ask for ice. Also, the front lobby/bar/diner smelled really really really bad. Unfortunately we had to walk through there every time we went out. I seriously had to hold my breath.

reviews.title: Hot water
reviews.text: The room I was in 161 had no cold water only hot was unable to take a shower or brush my teeth the water was so hot this could also be a danger to older folks and children as far as the room it was just a normal $29 a night motel room that is overpriced

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text: I walked in reception area around 6am and asked if there was a vacancy. Woman at the counter said no been booked for days now, no units available. I left and went online. Was able to book a room with many different options within 5 mins of leaving. Check out line was out the door. Finally after about 20 min wait, I got my key and was told it’s the building across the street when the hotel I saw online and booked for was completely different. Get to the room, immediately hit with the strong stench of wet dog. The blankets had stains. There were booger’s on the wall, no iron, no water pressure, the toilet lever fell apart after flushing and I had to repair it, the carpets were stained and looked like they had never been vacuumed and not to mention the building reeked of flatulence. Parking lot for cars was packed had to find parking elsewhere. 10/10 will never recommend nor do I ever plan to stay here again. For the amount of money I paid I could’ve gotten a way better hotel and service.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good quality/ price...Great location for freemont but far from the strip. Among the cleanest hotels.The golf area is really beautiful and I found it really interesting that the structure was on two opposite sides of the road.

reviews.title: Comfortable Stay
reviews.text: Everyone was very friendly to us and we felt right at home. Bed was very comfortable and we also enjoyed the bar located right in front where you check in. We’ll definitely be coming back if need to..

reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: Never again would i stay here. The room had hair from previous guests on the bathroom floor and in the shower.  Did not receive daily housekeeping.  Had to go the the front desk and request it the 2 times I did receive it (stayed 7 nights).  No light that can be turned on or off by the bed.  No phone in the room.  No way to control the a/c. Gap under the door.

reviews.title: 10 Stars
reviews.text: The location is in an amazing place. Right at downtown . You can walk to freemont in less than 3 minutes. The staff is amazing as well. The actual place is a golf court. I wanted to take pictures everywhere. 10 stars I'm telling you.

reviews.title: My experience at the Downtowner!
reviews.text: The room could have been much cleaner in my opinion. I had to speak with the front desk about cleaning the room. Of course they correct it. The customer service is good. The neighborhood is shady but the price was good.

reviews.title: The bad hotel
reviews.text: Read it.... I already said how bad was it... Air condition did not work and no one was not available.this hotel sucks and find any hotel beside this. so I do not know what else to say and the stupid website asking me to write at least 200 words... LOL... what a stupid rule.....

reviews.title: Good location but room?
reviews.text: Location wise, it was near the famous street experience. Its quiet and away from all the party noise and smoke. However, the room we were situated was very old. Needs serious refurbishment. Cable TV freeze a lot and WIFI signal was poor. No trash can in bathroom and carpet has lot of stains.

reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here
reviews.text: Horrible smell in room. Toilet was filthy. Room wreaked of musty odor and cigarettes. They are charging a amenities fee with no amenities not even a trash can. Too expensive for that rundown old place. Bathroom ceiling had water stains and cracks. Bed linen had stains. Had to open the window to try and get the nasty smell out.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: The motel is very nice and clean.  If you are looking for an affordable quick nights stay this is the place.  Staff was awesome.  Room was spacious and clean.  Check in effortless.  The putting green, swimming pool, free parking and lobby bar are perfect amenities.

reviews.title: Recommend it.
reviews.text: Freindly staff.She said it was going to be $67 for another night, but then she found out I had paid $55 the first night, so she honored the price that booking.com had given. Free coffee at the front desk!Free mini golf!Mist-sprayers over golf area!!!Close to a giant disemboweled robot, and a giagantic flame-throwing, praying mantis!!!!However, no mini fridge... boo-hoo :(

reviews.title: my vegas trip
reviews.text: generally happy with the hotel, clean room, pool was clean, tv did not work, hot water in both faucets in the bathroom. good value for the money over all and conveniently located to downtown Vegas, container park, Fremont street and the Mob museum (had a coupon for the Museum from the front desk)

reviews.title: Cheap, clean and convenient!
reviews.text: The hotel is recently renovated and my room was very clean! The staff was friendly and helpful. The location just off of Fremont Street is awesome, close, but far enough away from the hustle and bustle and very close to good restaurants!

reviews.title: It's nice
reviews.text: A nice, safe place to sleep and leave your things. This isn't the Ritz Carlton by any means, but you can't beat the price. The lobby is also a bar!Important to note: The hotel is two buildings across the street from each other. One building (adjacent to check in) is very nice and refreshed. The place across the street, not so much.

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Not bad at all, Staff friendly and helpfull.  Good place to stop on a road trip. Children welcome, free coffee is good. There was just a problem wit air conditionning, but overall it's a good place to stay

reviews.title: Horrible.
reviews.text: When I arrived late, the motel had oversold their rooms and were frantically trying to find accommodations for the displaced travelers. The poor girl at the front desk was in tears trying to get ahold of her manager with no success. A group of 8 who had paid for two double rooms were split into 4 single rooms in a completely different building. I was the last one they were able to check in, the rest were counted as no-shows a few minutes after midnight and advised to find a room elsewhere. Horrible planning by management, and to leave the staff there with no options is inexcusable. The room was decent in the remodeled building, the mini golf area was nice and relaxing, but one of the bartenders made the absolute worst old fashioned I have ever tasted. I will never ever ever return, I can spend my money elsewhere.

reviews.title: Pretty good for the price
reviews.text: Went for my first time to Vegas, wasn’t trying to spend too much money so I came here. Only a 5-10 minute walk from the old strip. Plus it has a mini golf course and a pool which was great because the heat in August was absolutely killer

reviews.title: First room had a dead Roach...
reviews.text: It smelled like raid and had stained sheets. Fortunately, they upgraded is to a room that wasn't so bad. Most of the staff was pleasant and did what they could to make things better, but the motel needs a major makeover instead of just a new coat of paint. The mini golf was really the only "amenity" and it wasn't worth an extra $22 a night. It's time for them to spend some real money on upgrades, otherwise, I'd rather stay at a motel 6.

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text: Although cheap, you get exactly what you pay for. The room was nice however, I’m very allergic to dust and cats. So unless the previous guests had cats in the room, I’m sure those AC vents could get some proper cleaning. I was non stop sneezing the moment we got in.

reviews.title: overall review
reviews.text: Very good value for money. General cleanliness was good. Front staff was very helpful. Highly recommended. If the resort fee can be waved for people not using the resort facilities, it would be even better.

reviews.title: My stay
reviews.text: Night shift receptionist was very nice and accommodating. Loved that they included parking right across the street. Close to Freemont street was able to walk and enjoy the entertainment. Room was clean and tidy.

reviews.title: Motel Room
reviews.text: My stay at the Downtowner Motel in Las Vegas, NV  was somewhat satisfactory, the air conditioner was disappointing as well as the bed that was slipping and all together like my regular bed at home.I had to turn off the air conditioner and then turn it on because I could not control the temperature room to my liking.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: The location and cost of this hotel is really good. Right around the corner from the Fremont experience and other bars/restaurants makes the experience even better. The rooms are nice and comfortable with an awesome air conditioning system

reviews.title: Great Hotel, even greater staff
reviews.text: I booked my reservation with Booking.com Fast and easy process, I stayed in 1 Fairway Double Queen Room. Room was very clean and the beds were cozy. Parking for hotel is just across the street by the "Empty Club", just ask for a parking  permit when checking in. $50 deposit required, free wifi, cable and if traveling with kids there is a cute golf course for the family to enjoy, and a bar for the adults! Very quiet and the staff was amazing!

reviews.title: Cute place for all your needs.
reviews.text: Second time staying here, came back because of the location and the remainder of the motel has been upgraded. The place is just what you need when you're out all day and night anyways. Will come back for a third stay next year!

reviews.title: Last minute decision
reviews.text: Not the best part of town but it’s 1 block away from the action so you can’t really blame the hotel. It’s just a bit grimey on that side of town. The hotel was ok. The air conditioning unit was super loud. I’ve stayed in rooms with loud air conditioners but this was uncomfortably loud and was not that cool either. The reception area doubles as a bar which is unique and kinda cool. I didn’t partake in a beer at checkin as I had an ice chest full of them. The patio area in the middle of the hotel had a few tables and seats and about 5 putting greens. They also had a bunch of water misters out in the patio which was awesome on the hot 110 degree weather. The pool across the street and is locked. It’s not much of a walk at all but was clean. The pool area had umbrellas as well. Definitely has a lot of potential.

reviews.title: Great find!
reviews.text: This was a great find at such an affordable price.  close to shopping, rooms clean, service great.  If you want a lower priced place in a decent neighborhood- this is your place.  Check in reception went above & beyond to get us in the room early- beds very comfortable

reviews.title: Not too bad of a place to stay
reviews.text: It's almost like a motel 6 style hotel/motel the staff is very friendly the rooms has a slightly musty smell to them but over all it was a very clean place and not too far from Freemont. I would give it an 8 out of 10 rating overall

reviews.title: With their new "resort fee" they are no longer a bargain
reviews.text: I have stayed here a few times, but I will no longer give them my business. You can pretty much stay almost anywhere on Fremont (other than gold nugget) for just about the same price, now that they have implemented a 22.60 per night resort fee. Much better off being closer to all the action with a much nicer room.

reviews.title: Great location and fun atmosphere
reviews.text: Recommend for backpackers or travelers just looking for the basics with some fun extras. Great price and amazing location. Staff was friendly and helpful. Pool was nice and well kept, too. Would def stay again.

reviews.title: Cheap Price But Cheap Hotel
reviews.text: Cheap price, but also a cheap hotel.  Good location, a block or so away from Freemont St.  I think there are two properties.  I stayed in the building across the street from the lobby.  Old, outdated, basic room.  Front desk staff were very friendly.  The parking lot was a little sketchy with a few homeless people wandering around.  I would not recommend unless this is a last resort.

reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.text: Rooms were hot, dirty & staff was rude and has zero concern to fix anything! We did not stay in the room because it was so smelly and hot. Found a different hotel @ 11:45 pm & no offer to fix the issues.

reviews.title: Moms trip down town las vegas
reviews.text: My mother wanted to stay at the downtown an dc she enjoyed the stay for 1 week everything was close by so she could go out and see some of old vegas  mom said thanks guys it was awesome and very convenient

reviews.title: ****LIARS / THEIFS****
reviews.text: The website says that it's pet friendly and when you call they tell you they are pet friendly then They wait till they get your money after you check in to tell you that you can't stay there with your dog's

reviews.title: clean and good value
reviews.text: This was my first stay at this hotel. I needed a place to stay while attending a conference and this was a good value. The only concern I had was on Friday and Saturday nights I had to park a block away and walk along the street which was deserted at night and I was by myself. I recommend this hotel if you are looking for a basic hotel.

reviews.title: You can get more bang for your buck elsewhere
reviews.text: I arrived a few hours early to see about the possibility of early check in, walked in and the girl greated mewith a smile. As soon as i asked if it was possible to check in she said quickly check in isnt until 3pm and directed her attention away from me. Was trying to ask where to park when coming back and before i finished my question and said check in isnt until 3pm. When i came back at 3 pm a different girl informed me about the $23 fee. I had to run to a bank and transfer funds. Upon coming back to the hotel, she said my card was declined and the charger was the 22 PLUS a $50 deposit fee... They say they have FREE parking FREE wifi and a FREE pool but then also say that those are included in the amenity fee. 🤔 anyway, room looked okay, dont expect to cool off as the air conditioning isnt great. Also a copper pipe under the bathroom sink that leaks randomly onto the floor..

reviews.title: Not quite as expected
reviews.text: The reason why we are giving this place a 3 is due to the cigarette smell that surrounded the environment and our room. It may so be that it doesn’t bug others, but to us it was somewhat uncanny. And there were 2 nights in which we couldn’t have a proper nights rest due to the loud environment, but apart from that the building and rooms themselves were clean & the price was quite comfortable for outback reach

reviews.title: Our stay at the downtowner
reviews.text: Over all the location in a great spot to get to everything in downtown Las Vegas the rooms look great with all that was done myself and my mother really enjoyed our stay there and the grand kids had a blast in the pool

reviews.title: Perfect for a mini getaway
reviews.text: This hotel is literally walking distance from downtown Fremont. I was looking for a perfect mini getaway and that's exactly what I got. Super cute and comfy. Room was fresh the whole time. Will be booking here more often!

reviews.title: Quick stop on road trip
reviews.text: Great location, easy check-in, parking was across the street, and solid value for a quick overnight stop. The location is great too - a few blocks away from the Fremont night life. My only complaint was that the room smelled like cleaner and was slightly off-putting. But hey, it means the room was clean!

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Didn’t particularly like other guests smoking in front of the entrance considering that is the only way in and out of the ‘clubhouse’.Besides that, room was clean, service was good. Overall experience was acceptable.

reviews.title: Clean place, friendly staff
reviews.text: The rooms were clean the Staff were very friendly and accommodating. Its in an older part of town but the place has a secure entrance and is gated around I felt comfortable in this place. It was reasonably price for what you get

reviews.title: July 2019
reviews.text: The place is nice but the internet was slow. In the room I got I could hear The Container Park about 8/9 pm it makes loud noises. I was also located right next to a club/bar and one night they had a party outdoors and it was loud. Other than that I had a great stay.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay. The staff is very friendly, the property is clean, and the location is great. It is walking distance from every thing you want from restaurants to shopping, to downtown Vegas entertainment.

reviews.title: Wade rocks. Love this place
reviews.text: Great place, Wade is the best, mini golf is an added bonus. Met a bunch of cool people. Pool is perfect temperature and just across the street from our room. My man and I are feeling like high rollers;)

reviews.title: Interesting stay
reviews.text: Well while we had a good experience, we also had some bad. When we arrived there was a situation going on with another guest where they’re clothes had been taken from their room and the host was yelling at them and then at her. She was very distracted and should’ve focused on helping the line of guests at 11pm. Once we got checked in we went to the rooms and were surprised by how cute they were and then we went to shower...and noticed there was blood all over the shower and bathroom...a little worrisome but I also carry cleaner and so we cleaned the bathroom. I also noticed there weren’t any outlets in the bathroom. We also were awaken the next morning by someone trying  to enter our room violently but thankfully the door was locked and dead bolted. I called the front on my cell to ask if there was a way to not have our room cleans because we were terrified of what happened to the other guests and they said there was plenty of do not disturb cards at the front. When I went to the front there was zero and your kind engineers or maintenance men offered to grab me one whole ypur front desk guy just stared at me like I was a moron and then continued to ask me 2 more times and your maintenance men had to remind him. Frankly, they were kinder than your front reception staffing. LASTLY, when we went to return to our room on the night of the 4th our room key did not work and had to wait behind several other guests having the same issue at 1 am. And when we entered our room housekeeping had been inside even after I had asked the front desk to put something down and I put a do not disturb card on our door. Honestly, you need a customer service revamp and better strategies for communication among your staff and guests. We won’t be returning to this location but if you’re only looking for a place to rest your head this is decent. No ac in the LV summer was hard we slept with no clothes on but we didn’t stay in the room other than the sleep.

reviews.title: Gives DTLV a bad name
reviews.text: I stayed across the street from the main property. Nothing on the website upon booking indicated I would be in a very run down and decrepit annex. The building had a coat of new paint but you can’t put lipstick on a hog and pretend it’s a swan. Carpet was stained throughout the room. Flip flops for sure. Absolutely no counter space in the bathroom. I appreciate retro bathroom fixtures, but some contemporary creature comforts would be nice. Plus side: crisp clean white sheets, and generous supply of fluffy towels. The branded bathroom soaps and lotions were an attempt at being hip and millennial. Overall the place was a big miss.

reviews.title: The room was beautiful and clean. Wade at the ftont desk is amazing! He took care of our rvery need!
reviews.text: This was a great hotel! The room was awesome. They have a bar, pool, and miniature golf course. Wade at the front desk is amazing and accommodated our every single need. He is kind, compassionate, and we had a great rate. This place was perfection.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: Worst experience everNever recommende to anyone Never had such experience beforeBoil in more than 100 degrees all night,.Guest having party in golf area all night, drinking and very noisy.Not a place for relaxing

reviews.title: quick trip
reviews.text: what a cute clean well run motel!!!   recent upgrades definitely show! the staff is top notch friendly folk! SO helpful!   location is key! Fremont right around the corner! Being able to park here with ease also a key factor! - I shall return!

reviews.title: Very close to Freemont experience
reviews.text: We spent one night in this motel, which is really close to the freemont street and which is very clean. The mini golf and cocktails are nice too ! Maybe a little bit noisy. I recommend if you don't have many time in Las Vegas

reviews.title: great price nice room good location to fremont street
reviews.text: This hotel is clean and cheap and only a block or two from Fremont street so for the price it is a good deal. We stayed in the building across from the main building and pool and did not use the pool while we were there but convenient location

reviews.title: Renovated rooms
reviews.text: Stayed in the renovated part of the Downtowner, it was nice. it was quiet and the beds were comfortable. it was good for the price and the receptionist answered all my questions. I will stay again. it is located just a couple blocks from Fremont.

reviews.title: Great find
reviews.text: I was surprised that this was a nice, fun place to stay, right near downtown. There are some small things they could do to make it great, i.e. refrigerator, better locations for outlets, but nothing critical.And where else can you get a drink while waiting to check in. Tina, who checked us in was great.

reviews.title: Downtowner, a great place to stay
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised. Beautiful rooms, very friendly staff. And a 5 hole mini put put in the courtyard. Very clean and quiet. Really cool retro decor. Walking distance to Fremont Street. Nice bar in the lobby. Cant wait to stay again!

reviews.title: My review
reviews.text: It is a Good location. Right next to downtown. Very convenient. Friendly staff. My only issue with this place is that the cleanliness is in desperate need of improvement. Other than that, it was a good stay.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: The pool is off site two blocks away from rooms and the neighborhood surrounding is dangerous. My family did not feel safe, leaving immediately and The Downtowner does not care. All they care is hooking you in and even leaving right away they will not refund.

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: Tina was awesome! She was so nice and helpful. She made me feel right at home the moment I walked in. Renovated rooms were nice and the bar area was cool. Would definitely recommend to friends and family.

reviews.title: Room 156
reviews.text: Room had multiple big stains on carpet, tub in bathroom was horrible!! Door was cut so at bottom to be what the call level with there messed up fake food floor. Door had easily 3 inch gap at the floor

reviews.title: A pleasant stay: great location and great value for money
reviews.text: Great location and great value for money. The place has been recently done up and I received a room upgrade. It's stylish and was a pleasant place to stay. Indeed I liked it so much I extended my stay by a day and am looking forward to returning. Pleasant and helpful desk staff as well.

reviews.title: False Advertisement
reviews.text: I know I booked a cheap room, bur I at least expect it to be the same room I book in a picture. I was in a building next door and it was so rundown and loud and smelled badly of cigarette smoke (I asked to switch rooms because of this and didn't work, the whole building is like this). The AC was too loud to use and I was uncomfortable with how dirty things were. I am not high maintenance, I spent the seven days previous in a tent camping in California and wish I just stayed in the tent instead of paying for this room. The front desk staff was nice.

reviews.title: Horrible stay!!!
reviews.text: Don’t waste your money or time. Had to move me 3 time. Tv didn’t work, air conditioner didn’t work. Not happy with the beds. Hard as a rock, woke up with a backache. Not happy with this stay. Will never stay at this hotel again.

reviews.title: Visit Las Vegas and stay at Downtowner for convenience of location and value for money.
reviews.text: Have you ever heard of "Fremont District" in Las Vegas? If not, you have missed something in Las Vegaus. Downtowner is within walking distance of the "Fremont District", something more traddtional about than Las Vegas than the Strip, and close to the Strip and local highways if you have a rental car.

reviews.title: good service
reviews.text: the staff is nice. safe place, quiet to sleep even during days. this is the second time we stay here during edc weekend. I recommended to a loth of my friends. compare to strip hotels this place is small but very convenience

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: A solid motel with good affordable prices. nice walking distance from downtown. Walls are a little thin can hear people talking outside the room. Toilet clogged up but wasn't much of an issue. Overall recommended experience.

reviews.title: Find anywhere else
reviews.text: I will start by saying that the rooms were clean. BUT they want to charge an additional amenities fee and we had no towels no trash cans no TV remote no do not disturb sign and the a/c was not working. For the price we should have at least had a refrigerator in the room.

reviews.title: Won’t be returning
reviews.text: I have stayed in vegas a lot, this place was aweful. The building across from main building was ghetto, outlets didn’t work, WiFi didn’t work, shower pressure almost took off my nipples and my moms room nothing worked. Luckily they moved her to the main building which clearly they have put more money in. But still won’t ever be returning.

reviews.title: BEYOND WORD'S ☀️💚👽
reviews.text: Every time 𓂀 stay here it's beyond PEACEFUL and clean never had a problem with the staff WADE and HEATHER are positive and humble the booking has never been a problem and the environment is retro which gives you a calming EFFECT

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: People at checkin are rude and they do not clean rooms daily...they tell u ur deposit is released the day u check out and it's been almost a week and I still have not received my deposit back...no phones in the rooms either

reviews.title: Resort Fee Not Disclosed
reviews.text: I booked a room here on June 12 through KAYAK.  There was no mention of any resort fee (which is required by law). I scoured the KAYAK booking to ensure there was no resort fee.  The KAYAK (and Get-A-Room) rates were higher so I assumed they included the Resort fee.  When I arrived I found that a resort fee of $22 was due ON TOP of the room rate and additional fee that KAYAK (and get-a-room) charged me.  I am accustomed to paying a resort fee WHEN IT IS DISCLOSED.  Get your s*** together Downtowner and KAYAK and stop blaming each other.  It is unprofessional, dishonest and amateur hour.  Horrible booking experience. Both admitted that they had failed to mention the resort fee in the booking path.  Get it together and follow the law.

reviews.title: nice hotel, bad service
reviews.text: upon check In there was a dirty needle found in the bed in my room. staff basically did nothing about this. Also, I was unable to simply change dates of reservation after I made a mistake on the booking dates..I was forced to pay for these dates plus the additional night even though there was a needle inside of the room. was hoping for atleast a refund for that night.

reviews.title: Up charged at check in
reviews.text: Online price is not accurate. Deceptive business practices since additional $90 was extorted from me at check in; late at night after 12 hours of traveling. Place is okay, but better deals up the road. I will not go back.

reviews.title: Downtowner
reviews.text: Not every clean at all, was close to Fremont experience which was a plus but i won’t stay there again, only stayed because it was an emergency. Next time I’ll just spend the money for a nice hotel. The check in process was longer than should have been and the guy checking us in was new and he ended up charging my card twice but wasn’t aware of that until we was checking out that SAME day we checked in and she noticed what he  did.

reviews.title: Affordable, safe, artsy stay
reviews.text: I really liked the affordability, location, safety, cleanliness and decor during my stay at The Downtowner. Perfect for budget travelers like me haha! I literally walked a block and was already on Fremont Street enjoying the experience.

reviews.title: VEGAS
reviews.text: Bed was one of the worst I ever sleep on, Shower drain was broken water going down to slow  carpet way to dirty, and many more stuff the i do not want to talk about, I will never consider staying at this place

reviews.title: False advertising. is there forte
reviews.text: Girl at check out and check in was awesome  but there refund policy  is no refund  even though  they didnt hold uo there end on what was advertised  and theres parking 2 blocks away if theres none  in the closest lot to them they dont have easy access  parking.  My father is ill  And  Cant walk that far nor. Can i leave him to go get the car due to Alzheimer's & a ton more other medical  issues that. Prevent hi. From walking too much.    Then to get in and see roaches hookers and no ac  the parking was iceing on the cake and now they refuse to refund even though  we checked in. And theu knew we walked in and walked right back out i will use all media outlets to  Express  that. This is the worse experience  we had on out road trip  To my father reunion  for Expedia  and from this establishment

reviews.title: Overall experience
reviews.text: My overall experience was ok the only issue i have is the resort fee it is a little to much i booked this motel not knowing that the fees would be so high the staff was great and the room was ok just the resort fee could come down some

reviews.title: Not the worst but not the best for the value
reviews.text: The toilet seat was broken and the sink faucet issue only very hot water. There was no cold water from the sink but the shower was alright. Even though the price was great for the location and time of year, I wouldn't stay in that particular building again. I would be rather pay more to stay in one of the two other buildings offered at the Downtowner.

reviews.title: Clean !!!
reviews.text: Overall I was pretty impressed with what the motel had to offer: perfect location if you want to visit the Fremont street, cleanliness & price. For the loud neighbors & not enough cold air not that much.

reviews.title: Basic but comfortable
reviews.text: The room was pretty rundown but it was clean and the bed was really comfortable.  There was quite a stale smell about the place and our AC unit was very noisy so had to turn it off but it was a cool night so didn't bother us too much. It was ok to stay in for the night as a base but could not have stayed for a longer trip. The location was great for us and staff were friendly and welcoming. Nice seating area outside too and a very nice cup of coffee in the morning.

reviews.title: Downtowner for Punk Rock Bowling
reviews.text: We stayed at The Downtowner during Punk Rock Bowling weekend 2019. The motel was a short walk to all of the festival venues and it was about $30 cheaper a night than any of the other options available when we booked. I would definitely consider staying there again next year. The building doesn’t look like much from the outside, but the bar, courtyard, and motel rooms have all been recently renovated. The service was fine and everyone I talked to was friendly and accommodating. Having a full bar attached to the courtyard was convenient and our room was nice and clean. Plus, the beds were SUPER comfy. I slept great all weekend! The one amenity I wish they had was a swimming pool. If it was my motel, I would rip out the mildly amusing, but mostly useless, novelty putt-putt course taking up the entire courtyard and replace it with a big swimming pool and patio area. That would truly make The Downtowner a vintage downtown gem. In the meantime, it’s still a comfortable, affordable place to stay if you’re looking for a hotel room with a little retro charm that’s close to everything Fremont Street and downtown Las Vegas has to offer.

reviews.title: Boutique Hotel? More like Motel 6
reviews.text: Two sheets is not a blanket. No amenities to speak of, not even a mini fridge or linen change for a 5 day stay. Plane leaves late? Too bad, no place to check your luggage, but you can leave it in the corner of the lobby. Generally clueless staff. Someone shoved a pen cap into the bathroom door for a hook, but I had to pay a deposit for the room? Want location? You’ve got it down. Want anything else? StY elsewhere.

reviews.title: Good choice
reviews.text: This was a cool hotel for sure! It was super close to Fremont street. The workers were friendly. There is a bar right downstairs. The shower was a bit dirty but whatev. I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Jason Z
reviews.text: I stayed there for 10 days.  the cleanness and the location are fine.  I have some problems with the below:1. The entrance of the building I stayed has bad smell. I think it was due the web and old carpet floor.2. Almost every night, I heard people talking and arguing very loudly at the mid night and around 2am.3. I booked the hotel through Hotel.com.  Per my reservation, the total price for the 10 days was $570.66.  However, Downtowner charged me $796.25.  Please help me to get the refund for the $225.59 asap. thank you!

reviews.title: Fun and enjoyable weekend. Best ones of my life.
reviews.text: Amazingly fun place.. it was more communal to stay here.. the staff never forgot you and enjoyed your company at the bar.. I met so many people just staying here that I dont think I want to stay anywhere else.

reviews.title: motel around the corner from everything in Vegas
reviews.text: This is my favorite little secret place! It’s quiet and you never know who you’re going to meet. Reservations are Dries to make it’s always affordable and it’s right around the corner from the entire Vegas experience. You  can get a nice quiet rest and your 2 feet away from a party

reviews.title: It was the best turn of events ever
reviews.text: So we arrived on a Sunday before Memorial Day. We first checked in to a room. The AC was broken and the remote was not working. We didn’t care during the first night as we were out drinking and just crashed after but the second day we can feel the heat and exhaustion as we were hiking all day at Zion National Park. I called the front desk and I spoke to Jenn the jack of all trades and she should also be promoted to a mediator. She prevented us from moving by moving us to another room which was waaaay comfy with a working ac and comfy bed. When I spoke to her on the phone. She gave me a sense that we will be taken care off. When I finally met her in person she was sooooo cool. She’s like your local home girl. Very caring and very accommodating and I love her attitude that keeping it real. Which we need now a days. I am writing this review. To let both customers and staff how to treat each other. No yelling no shouting but just be decent with one another. Jenn thank you for making Matt and I feel at home. Though we had a long day. You definitely made us feel great. With your hospitality and down home attitude. We will definitely stay here again. And if everyone see this review. Remember to asked for Jenn. Thank you Downtowner. It’s a very cute hotel swak in the middle of freemont, easy access to major roads, old strip, public transportation and an amazing staff. Thank you thank you thank you The Donovans

reviews.title: Smelly and in disrepair
reviews.text: On the good side, there is free parking and the bed was clean and comfortable. The staff also seemed nice. This hotel looks nothing like the photos. We paid a lot of money ($300 for a 2-night stay which included a surprise resort fee not mentioned on their hotels.com page) to stay at this noisy, poorly maintained & run down hotel. The fee was charged for amenities that we couldn't access from our tiny room in The Wyld without leaving the building. The room had a strong musty smell that permeated our clothes and luggage. The AC unit made that smell even stronger and if you switch to heat it smelled like burning plastic. The walls and ceiling had holes and there was also water damage which I'm sure contributed to the musty smell. When I spoke to a staff person about these issues she informed me they were fully booked and unable to move me. The hallway in "The Wyld" had the dirtiest carpet and smelled of cigarettes and weed. I would strongly urge you to stay elsewhere. It is not hyperbole to say this is the worst hotel I have ever stayed at.

reviews.title: not worth it
reviews.text: I went with injured back and when went to sit in there chair it came out from underneath me and landed on the ground i emailed the front to have a manager come up and make a report it was never done i was told my stay would be taken care of nope that didnt  not happen ask for a report again still nothing i feel like i was taken for a joke and yes injuries are worse now from hitting that hard ground.

reviews.title: My review
reviews.text: It was a good and comfortable stay at ther downtowner. Quite even though in the downtown area and the staff is friendly, helpful and super good a pouring a bulleit and red bull. Honestly the staff were superb and just the people to you hope for.

reviews.title: Retro
reviews.text: The complete design of the place is amazing and gives you an old school VEGAS vibe which is refreshing compared to all of the other more expensive hotels in my city , the first time 𓂀 stayed was for fun this time was even better ♥️

reviews.title: I love it
reviews.text: Everything was ok, the location, the WiFi works perfect and they have a very good hospitality, for the price is perfect, stores, casinos and downtown really close to it, I really recommended, as well they work 24 hours so is perfect to people to love night life,

reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.text: There was blood on the comforter and I didn't find it until after I slept in it. Didn't change the sheets and I stayed four nights. Paid a resort fee and no pool to use! The front staff is really nice.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: No amenities but was charged, gross room, whole hotel smells of mildew and mold, tv doesn't work, room keys have to be updated every single day and got locked out every day. I will not be staying here again.

reviews.title: Over priced for what you get.
reviews.text: The service from the staff were really good, but the accommodation wasn’t great. (We stayed in a seperate building, not the rooms attached to the check in desk). We knew the location wasn’t near the strip and we booked it specifically for a different reason so for that the location for us was good. The bed was comfortable, the tv and air con worked well, the things I would fault would be the smell of the building is not nice and the shower didn’t work properly (the tap was broken). The walls were super thin so you can basically hear everything going on around you. Also we weren’t informed about a $22USD charge on top of the rate each night, which made it even more expensive than what we thought it would be.

reviews.title: Could’ve been better
reviews.text: Got there and room was dirty, got a different room floors were dirty. Towels so old that you could hear it rip when tugged on.. shower floor look scary, I had to use shower shoes. Smokers would sit by the room door, smelling the entire room for hrs.

reviews.title: Really fun and whimsical design, cool place to stay!
reviews.text: I wanted to stay at a kitschy, cool retro styled motel in the Fremont District and The Downtowner was awesome from the moment I walked in until I left. Very cool experience and I'd love to stay here again when I come back to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Value for MONEY!
reviews.text: Great location- right on Fremont street where the action is. The staff at the desk were super friendly and helpful- including the Team Leader John. The room attendants did a superb job with the cleanliness of the room. And my stay was extremely pleasant.

reviews.title: Do not stay
reviews.text: Was moved twice from rooms. First room I was in stunk funky . Called front desk to let them be aware and took them forever to actually have someone else smell the room . Second room the AC broke . Feel like I was over charged

reviews.title: First time in vegas
reviews.text: I have to say that I have never been so pleased and staying such a pleasant wonderful clean Motel as I did when I stayed at the Downtowner in Las Vegas as it was my first time in Las Vegas I really enjoyed staying at the Downtowner John and his managers were just wonderful his whole staff greeted me every morning and every evening when I came in they were so helpful and helping me get ready to leave and come back to Oregon I was so sad to have to leave I had such an enjoyable time I didn't get to see much of Vegas but my time spent at the downtown or made it all worthwhile I recommend this Hotel very highly the rates were great the room was always clean always kept up with the amenities and the staff and management was above and beyond what I would have ever thought I look forward to coming back and every time I do I will definitely be a regular at the Downtowner Motel thank you so much John and your staff

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Very safe place parking open and safe no walking through dark parking towers Staff is friendly and helpful even saw them carrying heavy luggage for a disabled man Great value next to Fremont street but away from las Vegas mayhem

reviews.title: Solo stay was affordable.
reviews.text: NOT A RESORT EXPERIENCE, but good location and a place to sleep. Limited room amenities in the wylde building but mini golf seemed to keep people entertained. For new guests!  Its okay to park across the street, they give u a window tag so u don't have to pay.

reviews.title: Good location nice bar, dirty rooms with broken amenities received a parking ticket in hotel directed parking.
reviews.text: Good location nice bar, dirty rooms with broken amenities received a parking ticket in hotel directed parking.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Nice place to stay. New platform comfy beds and quiet A great place away from hustle and bustle of the strip Quick check in and reasonably priced Friendly atmosphere and helpful employees Would reccomend to anyone

reviews.title: Contemporary Cheap Sleeps
reviews.text: There are 3 bldgs on the property The Fairway is the mid priced bldg of the 3. You check in at the bar in the lobby which is a different touch. There is a putting green court in the courtyard & little metal tables & chairs lined up in the walkway outside some of the rooms which adds a different flair. The room was clean the bed was comfy. There were no little soaps or plastic cups but there was an ice chest but the ice is at the bar in the lobby. The parking is free but the lot is across the street if u don't mind walking. The walls aren't painted perfect if u can overlook flaws. It is convenient at Fremont Street which is the strip of downtown.

reviews.title: Bang for the buck !
reviews.text: Perfect location and great service. I have made this my STACATION location. I'm a local. I really was impressed with the bed comfort. I enjoyed the golf courtyard scenery.It was very relaxing. The front desk staff was very polite and timely about checking in and check out.

reviews.title: This is the worst Hotel/Motel that I have ever stayed in.
reviews.text: Total trash.  False advertisingDirty Rude StaffHorrible valueOnce I let staff know about room and conditions they could care lessNever ever ever ever stay here..Ever!!! Shows new hotel on website, get there and it's a old flop house. Smelled like piss and winos. No vending machines.  Noisy. Bathroom is very old and needs updating.

reviews.title: Location
reviews.text: Can’t beat the price and the location me and my husband stayed for our anniversary the ladies at the front desk were very nice and friendly the room was very clean and the bed was comfortable we will definitely be coming back again

reviews.title: Great location for Las Vegas Downtown
reviews.text: If you like to be close to Fremont Experience, this motel are situated  on a perfect location. Very clean, comfortable rooms with great beds, just a few minutes walk from downtown action, but still at a location which give you silence during the time you need a good rest. There is coffee for free in the morning in the lobby, but no full breakfast. If you need a cooked breakfast, there are a few places just a short walk from motel. They have a "Goodies" desk in the lobby, but prices are very high to be in a motel. If you just need something simple to eat or drink, there is a convenient store just one block away where you get things for a normal price and can avoid the minibar kind of prices in the lobby. During my stay there were lack of toiletries in the room, but after I commented this in the lobby, I got plenty of missing things placed in my room  during the day. The staff at this motel  take comments from guests with hjgh priority. I would like to stay here again and recommend Downtowner!

reviews.title: Visit ruined by excessive added fee..
reviews.text: I booked this location purposely to avoid the astronomical resort fee rubbish that infests Las Vegas..   upon booking the resort fee here was quite small and I was prepared for it on this occasion..  No available pool area..  mmm...  But upon arrival these sneaky characters had hiked it up three fold, taking $250 off me upon check in..  Rooms weren’t bad, a bit noisy and I knew the area before I came..  I’d have recommended this place in many ways, but robbery at the front desk..  no..  there are better places for this price..  a shame..

reviews.title: Had an enjoyable trip
reviews.text: Was a nice trip rooms were clean location for the most part was very nice, close to other casinos. Was able ro walk to casinos and enjoy the games and the food . Also was able to enjoy  the free concerts.

reviews.title: fun Design and great service- but location, upkeep, and clientele isn’t the best
reviews.text: Service was super friendly and helpful.  The buildings and decor are fun retro.  Location is conveniently downtown (near civic buildings,etc, NOT near the Strip).  However, downtown is a bit rundown and there are several homeless people and drunks nearby, sirens and loud cars were a regular occurrence throughout the evening, some of the other guests were . . . probably there to do drugs and perhaps spend time with paid companions, and the rooms are a little bit run down, though it is obvious that they have been repainted and new composite wood floors have been put in.  I think it is fine if you just need a crash pad for a short trip and it isn’t critical to have a great night’s sleep, or if you just need a place to hang out party with some friends.  Would not recommend for families.

reviews.title: Good value in shady area
reviews.text: Been coming here for years under different managements. Much cleaner than how it use to be, Also since the container park opened across the street, there are more people around & much safer than before

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: Convenient. Best part was the friendly staff!  Unusual check in, the check in desk is also a bar. Not bad, maybe suggest a little signage to let guest know that this is were you check in. Just so they don’t feel stupid. The wylder building I wasn’t fond of, but you can tell they are making improvements.We stayed for 2 tonight’s.  Again the staff was great!

reviews.title: Dirty, disappointing, false advertising
reviews.text: This motel was not at all as advertised-the photos on their website are of the main building, but upon check-in you are assigned to an unmarked,dirty building off the actual motel site. Overall it was very loud, smelled of smoke, mould, and cannabis, and the first room we were assigned still had the previous occupant's personal items. The room itself was filthy, with dust and hair on the floors, stains and smears on the concrete wall, the bathroom vanity was chipped and cracked, and the shower could not keep temperature.The pool was a literal hole in the ground. The rate overall was $135.00, which was unacceptable given the conditions of the motel which we chose based on the quality of the advertised photos and not wishing to stay at a casino. For comparison, we stayed the following week at the Hard Rock Casino on a Thursday and paid $109.00. I cannot stress enough how literally nothing was as advertised. Our impression was that the owners were basically calling your bluff on whether or not you would risk booking another place to stay after a long day of travel.  The site we were 'Booking' with deleted my review, and despite selecting all negative scores still tallied a 2.5 review--just to caution other travellers from out-of-country who rely on what is advertised.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable and the block we were put in had recently been refurbished and were lovely.  We looked out to the outside area with the crazy golf and that was really cute!Really enjoyed our stay and the staff were all full of smiles and incredible helpful and nice.

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.text: This is right by the old downtown strip but far enough off to make for a quite night sleep. When we were there they were renovating to a retro hotel, although our room was very quaint, it was a good price, and I can't wait to stay again when it's completely renovated.

reviews.title: quiet and comfortable
reviews.text: great location, you can walk to the fremont experience.friendly staff, convenient parkingresort fee was minimal but still very annoying. How can you stay in vegas when the rate for every hotel is not true , as the resort fee is hidden?

reviews.title: Amenity Fee Jump
reviews.text: $22.60 plus tax Amenity Fee. You get bad internet, parking in a open and a bit seemly parking area. Not the bargain anymore in the Downtown area. There sister property The Gold Spike at least has a casino charges that, but not a basic motel like the Downtowner.

reviews.title: Amenity Price Increase from $6 to $23
reviews.text: This place used to be the low price leader in the business. Not anymore. On Jan. 1 they raised their amenity fee from $6 to $23. They lost my business. I was a loyal customer for almost 5 years. I will never book with them again.

reviews.title: Dirty, smelly and only scalding hot water
reviews.text: Terrible place. We stayed in the building across the street. When you walk in, you are greeted by an awful smell, something like urine/sewer. We walk into the room and there is a wadded up dirty t shirt on the floor, dirty towels left hanging in the bathroom, and the pillow cases and sheets were dirty. They were also stained  brown. There  was garbage sitting on the nightstand from the people prior. Go to take a shower, there's only scalding hot water. No cold water in the faucet or the shower. The bed is on a slant so we had to sleep on it backwards. We went to the front desk and asked to be moved to another room and explained all of these issues. They promised to move us and call us that day as soon as housekeeping was done cleaning. Of course, they never called to move us.I have stayed in terrible hotels in very sketchy places, I can handle that. But this was by far the worst one I've ever stayed in and the smell was pretty unbearable for a couple days. I hope I can spare everyone else from dealing with this disgusting place.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Hotel was under renovations,  room did not have an Iron and it said it did no blow dryer no coffee pot and I found some roaches in the bathroom. Location was fine for what we went there for. Just a dirty area.

reviews.title: Bad hotel
reviews.text: When the taxi bring us because it did NT find hotel because in renovation, very cheaper but very bad odor and there wasn't cold water that s mean if you wanted cold.water you got hot water !! Awful ! We find another hotel

reviews.title: Economical
reviews.text: It was Clean and inexpensive, basic no frills accommodations. Bring your own coffee pot. Comfortable bed. Thanks It was Clean and inexpensive, basic no frills accommodations. Bring your own coffee pot.

reviews.title: I recommend
reviews.text: Great stay at the Downtowner motel, the location is amazing, near Fremont St, The room are nice!!! I recommend this hotel for Friends or family!!! The only problem was when we arrived, the main building was closed and I had a little difficulty to find the front desk!!!

reviews.title: ROACH MOTEL!!!
reviews.text: ROACH MOTEL!!! They would not compensate me in any way when I notified them that my room was infested with roaches. Concrete walls and cheap laminated floors. Extremely seedy neighborhood with shady characters loitering about.

reviews.title: Cheap and good option to enjoy las vegas
reviews.text: Good Location, good facilities, clean room. The employees were friendly and polite. I was able to receive mail on the hotel, they keep it for me until my arrival. Great location near Fremont street, 15 minutes away from the Strip, near the Gold and Silver Pawn shop. 1 block away, you can take a free shuttle to downtown, and the North premium outlets, good option to get cheap clothes and stuff.

reviews.title: Always love this place
reviews.text: Always friendly always welcoming great value always accommodating communication is great before arrival during and after I would highly recommend staying here for business or pleasure.  Everything is close by and they're in the process of a reminder to make the place even better

reviews.title: Great Location with promise (reno)
reviews.text: Arrival at the hotel was actually a little scary.  The exterior was nothing like originally pictured and almost looked like it was closed.  Good thing we went in anyway.  The hotel is under renovation and looks like it's on the bad side of construction however the room was actually spacious and clean.There renovations are fairly low grade so think Motel 6 meets a hostel.  Queen bed, old A/C, old tub/shower and the shower is at shoulder level and only 2 pillows BUT you get what you pay for and we got a great deal.  There are no frills here.Best part about hotel is the location.  If you're interested in staying in the Freemont area this is a great location with only a small resort fee compared to other hotels.Bottom line - if I got the same great rate/discount I'd stay again.

reviews.title: Close to Fremont St
reviews.text: Very close to Fremont Street. The neighborhood and hotel itself seemed safe and secure. There is an Indian restaurant very close to this motel which was a plus for me. Don't expect a lot from the room but was enough for me to spend the night and have the awesome Fremont Street experience.

reviews.title: Inexpensive, Old and No Frills
reviews.text: Main motel under remodel. Given room at adjacent motel. Pros: location, easy check in, staff friendly, electronic card for entry to building and room, bed was clean and comfortable, inexpensive room, $6 "resort fee", window AC unit worked well. Cons: TV remote did not work, operated TV manually but sound did not work,  no iron or iron board, shower not clean, room is very basic.

reviews.title: Disgusting, hotel is closed and has been for a long time! Luckily I was travelling alone.
reviews.text: I am utterly disappointed and disgusted at the same time, this place is closed and has been for a long time! Fortunately I was travelling alone and not with friends or family  Still, turning up outside at 0100 in the morning to find it closed was a bit daunting and a bit scary! Definitely should not have happened!!

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text: If you're looking for something where you just need a nap a shower and a place to lay your clothes while you enjoy The Nightlife of Fremont Street this is your place. Inexpensive and convenient. No Frills. It's like a dorm room with your own bathroom. Walking distance to the entire Fremont Street Experience.

reviews.title: You get what you paid
reviews.text: Can’t complain.I got a very good deal. The room was renovated, clean. My only complaint is the absence of cold water in the bathroom.Staff very friendly. They accept my early check in. You get what you paid for, this isn’t a resort

reviews.title: Cheap stay was good
reviews.text: The ice machine does not work and needs repair. The bed comforter is not sufficient for the winter weather so make sure you take your own. The motel has more of an Airbnb, but it is very comfortable if you are just going to go party and then come back to sleep. The shower head will be a challenge to anyone that is over 5'5". The breakfast coupons are great and the food is delicious as well.

reviews.title: downtowning in vegas
reviews.text: This is a cheap motel. Cleanness needs worked on but very quiet place.  If your looking to have a cheap place to stay this works...front desk was great. if they work on cleaning they will be great. might check them out next time.

reviews.title: Great Prices
reviews.text: I was only in Las Vegas for a short stay this time and wanted to be near Freemont Street. The short 5 minute walk was nice and close to all the action. The rooms were clean and the staff were very helpful.I will be recommending this for anyone who wants to be close to the old Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Location and value
reviews.text: The hotel is 3 blocks from Fremont St experience.  Don't expect frills, like in-room coffee maker, but the TV and bed were both excellent.  Staff were very accommodating so I could have a first floor room.All staff were very friendly.

reviews.title: Clean,comfy,affordable
reviews.text: Stayed 11/3-11/9 room was clean and comfy. Room had all basic needs and everything worked properly. Bathroom was simple yet clean(water pressure was awesome). Too cold to swim, but still got to soak up some sun in the pools lounge chairs. Will be booking again in a few months.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: The Downtowner Motel is a no-frills motel set just a couple blocks from The Fremont Street Experience.  The room was very clean and the bed was extremely comfortable.  I slept like a baby.  There are two buildings that comprise this motel.  The main building is currently being renovated.  The desk clerk said that the renovations will be completed by the end of 2018 and will boast an Art Deco theme.  There will be a bar and some slot machines located on-site.  There will even be a small Putt Putt type golf experience in the center courtyard. The staff at The Downtowner are very friendly and helpful.  I was very comfortable at the motel and I'm looking forward to staying here again.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Not so cheap, quite good location, close to bus, you can walk from Fremont Street to Mandalay Bay if you have good fitness. I did and my 17 year old daughter. The most affordable bus ticket is the one for 24 hours it cost 8 dollars.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Hotel was near Fremont St. It had a comfortable bed. Fluffy towels. Staff were nice. However, it was dated, many repairs needed. TV didn't work right. Ice machine down. Biggest issue was window A/C unit was so loud we could not sleep.

reviews.title: Good good fine average average okay fine good
reviews.text: It was average.  No place to put your suitcase.  It did not have a phone or clock.  Ran out of ice on a very very hot  hot day. Nothing else to write but I still have 38 characters left.   No clocks or phone.

reviews.title: Friendly staff, simple rooms, kind of smelly, very close to Fremont Street
reviews.text: When we got there we weren't sure if we were in the right place...the office was located in a run down and torn apart motel. We later learned that they were remodeling and our room was located in the building next door. The staff was very friendly and gave us good recommendations on where to go. We were 2 minutes walking to Fremont Street, which was great!Our room was clean and simple, but the whole place stunk of sewage. Our toilet wouldn't stop running, even though I eventually fixed it. I figured we got what we paid for, which was barely anything.The ice machine broke on the 3rd day, thank goodness we were checking out. No coffee pot or fridge in the room. Overall, it was just fine for the 2 night stay. We didn't spend any time in the room except to sleep. I'd reccomend it to someone on a budget who wants easy access to Fremont Street and the Duece Bus.

reviews.title: Las Vegas visit
reviews.text: Great price. Lowest resort fee available. Clean room though basic. Great location for downtown. Close to the free loop route bus. El Cortez nearby for reasonable dining. Parking included with room which is not the case elsewhere.

reviews.title: A Good, Basic Hotel with LOTS of construction; Crappy Area
reviews.text: Our experience at the Downtowner Motel was overall good. The room was to our expectation, very basic with little amenities which we were more than okay with (The booking page did let us know that many of the normal amenities such as fridge, hair blow dryer, etc would NOT be included which me and my boyfriend were okay with!). Since we had our weekend jam packed with plans, we really weren't going to use the room much other than to sleep at the end of the day. The room was clean with the exception of some unusual stains on the carpet (Darn guests who ruin hotel rooms!). One of the biggest and only problems we ran into was Check In. Though the attendants who helped us were kind, we got there 10 minutes early and they informed us our room wasn't going to be ready for another 30 minutes, which would have been 20 minutes after the check in time. We were a bit bummed but accepted it seeing as we had plans to meet family practically immediately after we checked in and put our bags in our room, so that had to be pushed back. We waited the 30 minutes and returned only to see a jammed packed lobby (Which by the way was empty as they were renovating the motel and in the process of moving lobbies as I was told).  We had to wait an additional 15-20 minutes for the small issues and check ins the others guests had before us before we were finally given our room. At this point, we were already very late to our meeting with family which went on without us so we were a little frustrated about that. Other than that, the Check out was ridiculously fast and efficient with the same inviting front desk clerks! The hotel was to our standards and was clean, but I would not stay again not because of the hotel but its surrounding area which is a few blocks from Fremont Street and was constantly littered with people passed out and drunk on what felt like every corner. We did not feel comfortable parking and even walking to our hotel room at night. But, if you are a bit braver and wouldn't mind dealing with the surrounding neighborhood and are looking for a motel with a great price range that really are fine with little to no basic amenities, I would definitely recommend the Downtowner Motel!

reviews.title: Aircon too loud, power outlets not working/no 3-prong outlets; no floor towels; door did not lock
reviews.text: floor towel was not available for 3 of 4 nights; aircon too loud, disrupted my sleep; power outlets not working and come only in two prongs resulted to not being able to charge my PC; door did not lock two time coming out of the room

reviews.title: DONT STAY HERE!!
reviews.text: Stayed there for a 3 days, no one at the door to help with check in had to call for someone.Roach infested! Nasty nasty DONT BOOK HERE! Pay the extra money to stay in a clean room and no roaches!!!!!!

reviews.title: Not the best...
reviews.text: The Linens in the room were clean and fresh however the room itself was dirty. The table was still sticky. The floors were so dirty they turned my feet black and scrubbing them with a washcloth did not get the dirt off! however if you want to be conveniently located to Fremont Street, this is your place.

reviews.title: Inexpensive motel close to everything
reviews.text: This motel is close to everything you need in Vegas. Rooms are basic but good for a budget. Staff are great...they need to put glasses in the rooms. I felt safe the whole time...no issues. Shower was also great! Good pressure!

reviews.title: They have cockroaches!!!!
reviews.text: When we arrived they said we had 4 bookings and we had to talk to the for 30 minutes just to get down to the one we booked. The building with the rooms inside is all run down. Instead of fixing the wall holes in the main room and bathroom they have just slapped blobs of bog on them and left them. The carpets were covered in stains. The walls in the bathroom had Brown splotches and boogies all over them. The bathroom ceiling was covered in yellow slim. They have a 5 dollar utility fee but the pool is falling apart and the AC when turned on pumps in an bad mustard smell. We went out for food and came back to see cockroaches crawling on the floor. I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.title: Relatively Quiet Area close to the Strip
reviews.text: Friendly staff, clean room in a relatively quiet area.  I didn't spend much time at the hotel only for sleep, which wasn't a problem.  I did try the wifi and it worked just fine.  Low cost not far from restaurants and bars also bus stops nearby.

reviews.title: basic but clean
reviews.text: room was sufficient for an overnight stay with the essentials- bed, tv, wifi, and desk. clean. like that older buildings are saved and renovated with it's unique decor character. enjoyed my stay......

reviews.title: Best Bare Bones Hotel in Vegas
