reviews.text: reasonable rate, clean rooms, odor free, essentials only. best bed in vegas slept like a baby. no frills but courteous staff and maintenance. willing to do anything to make your stay more enjoyable. Remember this is a no frills hotel. Keep that in mind and you will enjoy your stay there.CLEAN CLEAN CLEAN FACILITY.

reviews.title: Stay anywhere else if you have the option
reviews.text: If you have any other option, stay there. This was OK for one night, but it won’t happen again. The building across the street from the lobby is not acceptable. Front desk staff was kind enough to move us into a room in the wild side building. The rooms give off the appearance of a recent remodel, but the bathrooms are still old and dirty. The smells in the hall way and in the rooms are covered with fabreeze but still waft through on occasion. If we hadn’t prepaid we would have went elsewhere. Thankfully the bed seemed clean enough and was surprisingly comfortable.

reviews.title: Very good location and value
reviews.text: Great location. 5 mins to Freemont. Room smelt a bit like ciggies. Walls needed a bit of a clean. But for the price is was good value on weekdays. Prices went up on weekend though. Swimming pool was decent. Always quiet so felt private although next to a main road.

reviews.title: dont do it
reviews.text: terrible, smells bad, pipes in room extractor fan not working so it you number 2 it smells in the entire room, place is dirty, you can hear the other people in the next rooms. i regretted renting a room here

reviews.title: Good choice
reviews.text: I booked a Groupon which was nice because it included breakfast.  Check in and check out staff that I had were very nice.  The cleaning staff were also very nice.  The location was great. Pool is actres the street.

reviews.title: Stay at your own risk.
reviews.text: Walking distance to Fremont strip. If you need a bed and shower. Distinctive smell in hall way and when room a.c. is off. Pending $250 fee because "our room smell like smoke" we are non-smokers. Reached out twice to get a hold of John the manager. He Wil look into it and reach out in a few days. Unacceptable, the worst part of our vacation.

reviews.title: I've stood there twice in the last two months... Ill be back very soon and will probably stay there again
reviews.text: I've stood there twice in the last two months... Ill be back very soon and will probably stay there again

reviews.title: Won't stay in the future
reviews.text: Stayed on a Monday night. Hotel check in/ check out is across a street and approximately 1/2 a block away from the motel. No phone in room to call front desk. Ice bucket in room, however, no ice or vending machines in building nor a sign indicating where these items are located. Used my cell phone to call front desk and inquire about ice. Informed it was near the check in desk - across a street.Upon awaking following morning, while packing items to leave, a roach came crawling near the bed.When checking out, no one was at the front desk. Waited for 5 minutes, no one available.  Left a note I was leaving and information about the roach in my note with the deceased bug in a baggie.Hotel area of town is on a quiet street, however, appears creepy because nothing is open close by and a lot of dark areas near the motel.

reviews.title: Yes, it's cheap, but... there's a reason for that.
reviews.text: It's hard to complain, because this place is so inexpensive. Usually, when you see a bad review, it's due to issues with staff.  Not here. I think the staff was wonderful and professional.  This hotel is kind of a dump/not dump.  I stayed on the "Wylde Side".  I was glad I was not traveling solo, because the hallway leading to my downstairs room looked sketchy and a little dirty.  Entering my room showed a recently remodeled room with clean white walls and new flooring. Plenty of closet space, including an iron and ironing board.  The bedding was clean and new looking.  The towels felt thick and soft.  However, what I first noticed was the smell.  Although a nonsmoking room, you could tell someone had smoked in it. The smell of urine wafted into the room via the air-conditioning unit.  As we were staying less than 12 hours, I felt I could make it thru a night.  Another good thing about this hotel is the location - it's somewhat transitional looking a neighborhood.  It seems a little 'edgy' at night, but I loved being able to walk two blocks to EAT for breakfast and the Donut Bar.  The Container Park is also close by and there are plenty of other interesting-looking places to eat.  But decision made: if this hotel stays the same, I can pay the extra $20-$30 dollars a night to stay at a nicer hotel

reviews.title: nobody uses the pool?
reviews.text: there was a pool I seen on my way out, but I don't believe the front desk clerk told me anything about.Also a little confusing to why there was an Ice bucket container in the room, but no where to find ice, maybe if the front desk would have informed me that it was only there for decoration, I wouldn't have expected cooling my warm water bottles down.

reviews.title: Road Warrior
reviews.text: Great place for short business trips and/or leisure.Great location, very clean comfortable room, with a very comfortable bed.The position of TV is awesome for watching in bed.Ample closet space. Room had iron and board,  plus blow dryer<>all good.

reviews.title: Basic amd accesible.
reviews.text: Friendly staff.  It's a basic room right near Container Park.  No issues.  Reviews that talk about bad part of town may want to rethink the fact they are in Vegas.  Good value and the building was secure and quiet.

reviews.title: Crash Pad after a long day outside.
reviews.text: Perfect  if you just need to sleep in a quiet atmosphere.  No need to spend extra cash on a place to crash.  Keep the ac running and you're good to go.  It's Vegas..sleep during the days heatwave, then come out at night when it's cooler. It's a 24 hour town, so you won't miss out on the festivities.

reviews.title: Worst visit ever
reviews.text: We stayed just one night in this hotel and it was the worst night that could be...The parking lot it was not available and we had to park in another hotel, far away for the hotel. In our room there is no phone to call the reception. The room smells cigarettes even we asking a non smoking room. At least, the bathroom, bed and sheets looked like very clean. The night we stayed, it happened a fight next our room, a lots of noises, screaming and no one from the desk went there... after a lot of time someone came and stopped it. This hotel is placed near a bad neighborhood in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: worse stay in the history of hotels
reviews.text: stay away at all cost.  someone was put in my room, couldn't sleep from night club, they switched hotels, maid tried to force me out after getting late check out, parking was a night mare    ruined by trip

reviews.title: Close to attractions
reviews.text: Very good location, close to Fremont street. Room was clean and quiet, but the air conditioner was quite loud. Check the parking space - when we were there the parking was under construction.parking was under construction.Overall - nice place for one night in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great no frills lodging walking distance to Fremont St. This  is 2nd time I have stayed there. Very close to Fremont St but not in great part of town. I would stay there again. Not a resort atmosphere but that is what Fremont St is.

reviews.title: 2nd time
reviews.text: This was a horrible stay. I stayed last year and really liked it. There was no phone to call front desk, the room smelled liked sewage,  ice machine was in next building over and my 2nd night I had to park in a garage which was a 8 minute walk. Parking to unloadc&load car with my luggage was not available and I had none 2 help with my 2 suitcases. It was not a good stay.

reviews.title: bad experience in a bad neighborhood
reviews.text: not the place to walk alone at night.  the hotel looks worn down although the room seemed to be renovated and was very clean.  the staff is not very helpful.  beds are ok and there is free parking nearby

reviews.title: Pay the extra money and stay somewhere else!
reviews.text: As normal people, we wanted to stay closer to Fremont Street. When I saw the Downtowner online, it looked like a perfect fit. The reviews were really hit and miss so we figured we would give it a try. We should have not. The pictures on the website look great, and our room looked similar to the picture. There were cobwebs at the top of the room on the walls but the bedding and towels were all clean. The hot water in the shower worked great! At least, after you figured out how to get it to the hot water. If you book a normal room you are in a building across the street and have to walk over to the main building to get ice as there is not an ice machine in any other location on the grounds. If you want to swim, you have to go over to the reception and leave your ID card, they will exchange it for a key to get into the swimming pool. It's not in a good part of town, but we did find a small grocery store around the corner that's sold stuff pretty reasonably priced. If you are a late-night gambler, have fun walking back to your hotel! You have to walk by all the nightclubs and then step over sleeping homeless people on the sidewalks. If you smoke cigarettes, there is literally no where to smoke unless you sit on the curb by the homeless people. There is a smoking area in the pool section, but you would have to walk across the street to turn in your ID, get a key, and then return it when you were done. I would recommend paying the extra few bucks a night to stay somewhere else. Also, no matter how we adjusted the blinds in our room on ground level, people could see into the room. There are no curtains just Venetian blinds. Great for someone who is into voyeurism....

reviews.title: Best motel for price and location
reviews.text: If you want a good hotel, cheap and best location this motel would suit your needs as this place is like five minutes away from downtown freemont experience and which is way better than the strip as at night it is the party zone and the entire downtown area is really lively!

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: location is good ( Fremont street is right afrter the corner) , service is good. But floor in the room were dirty, my light socks became black! And it smells bad in the room, windows do not open. But for staying two days it is not bad.

reviews.title: Wild.
reviews.text: Cockroaches, cigarettes smoke and dirty floors is what awaited us when we checked into our room. I was fooled with the photographs of the renovated “The Wylde.”  It was very disappointing and we will never return again.

reviews.title: Comments
reviews.text: Plumbing problems and door would not close properly. Other than that enjoyed the stay. Wish there was a small refrigerator in the room that would be convenient. That way food would not spoil and drinks would stay cold.

reviews.title: No Frills
reviews.text: I'm not overly picky when it comes to my room as long as it is clean and things function as they should. I have stayed here a handful of times and have not had any issues. This last trip there were a couple of simple issues (tv remote didn't work and screw fell out of shower handle) and these were handled within minutes of my bringing them to their attention. Friendly staff and I've not had any issues with the location, with it being on the "fringe" of Fremont East, some people will say it's an unsafe area, but it's just around the corner from Container Park which has lots of foot traffic so it's not isolated. The Downtowner certainly won't be everyone's cup of tea, but if you are budget minded and want a clean room and a TV with lots of channel choices (lol) then this place just may work for you  ;)

reviews.title: Could have been way better.
reviews.text: I didn't get the room I'd actually booked for and there was some miscommunication before I'd even arrived so didn't want to push further at the desk when things weren't right. Area is excellent though, right near fremont but far enough that you get a great night's sleep.

reviews.title: Very basic motel.
reviews.text: The Downtowner is definitely a no frills motel.  No hair dryer, clock, telephone, coffee maker, etc.  It has a 32 inch TV, one queen bed, desk and one chair.  The room was quiet. Management and staff were attentive and courteous.  If you are looking for a fancy motel look elsewhere, but if you just want a quiet and basic place to sleep The Downtowner is worth considering.

reviews.title: Very good for the price.
reviews.text: So I'm a very budget oriented traveler and for this trip this motel come up as suggested. Let me just start with I have pretty low standards, as long as something is pretty clean, works and is what I expect I am happy. I was put in the building over the road, right opposite the and I was happy with the room. It could have been dusted a bit better but meh, done me no harm. Two main down points for me though were 1) The air con in my room was super loud, so loud for the first few days I had it turned off because I was worried it was disturbing others but obviously being a Welshman I needed my air con haha. 2) There was no cold water! I'd run the taps but only hot water was coming out. Pretty sure that's isn't standard in Vegas.Honestly though, I pretty quickly got over these issues.The building felt safe and secure. You need to use your room to to get into the building and then use it again to get into your room so two layers of security.The pool was great. I used it a few times and it worked great for me. Not really sure what to say about it. It did sometimes get quite busy!The best thing about this motel is it's location. This motel is located about 10 minute walk away from the amazing Fremont Street and everything that has to offer.The Motel is also located 10 minutes away from a RTC bus stop that will take you to the strip and everywhere else (Bus Pass costs 2 hour/$6, 24 hour pass $8, 3 day pass $20, 15 day pass $34). The bus runs 24/7 every 15 minutes or so  and takes you to the strip and back again!The room also had no safe and not much storage for clothing but again, you can work around this, if I can you can too! Basically, it's a motel, if you want something fancy then this isn't for you but if you want no thrills, well priced then this will work! Plus you're in vegas, how often will you be in your room?!Oh there are a few homeless people on the streets around the motel be seriously they were no bother to me, I was there two weeks and not once had an issue. I'd certainly stay again!

reviews.title: Inexpensive and GOOD
reviews.text: Stayed there for work and Fremont.  Rooms are brand new.  Great price and location, right by Container Park.  Quiet area and friendly professional staff.  Great deal for the gambler. Bathrooms are a little tight because of the age of the hotel but they've been renovated.

reviews.title: OUR TOWNTOWNER MOTEL PERSONAL EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The quality & price for the Lion's Den, room 102, exceeded our expectations! Everything was walking distance (entertainment, mini-mart, & landmarks); Helpful front desk staff & cleaning crew. Gracias!

reviews.title: Bad motel
reviews.text: Wont ever stay here again. Bad motel. No phone in room.. plumming was bad and never was fixed. If you had an emervency you wouldnt get the help. If you needed something you had to walk across the street.

reviews.title: Get what you pay for
reviews.text: Definitely what you pay for. No refrigerators, no cold water, actually staying in old apt bldg across the st. Shady activity and people. Clean and a good distance to Fremont, super nice staff though..

reviews.title: Downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: I have stayed at this property before. It is very simple, plain and convenient to downtown and to public bus.  There is remodeling going on. I only stayed in buildings that have rooms with one queen bed. I am not familiar with other buildings/rooms.  The price is very good for couples and singles.

reviews.title: Great, but..
reviews.text: Our stay was wonderful close to freemont street yet far enough away we didn't deal with all the noise. The room could have used a deeper clean from the housekeepers, the walls and light bulbs were very dusty and ceiling in the bathroom had grime on it due to lack of ventilation. Overy all it was a cute room and great location. Would stay again if price was right.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: If you're just looking for a clean room and don't care about amenities, The Downtowner is the place for you.  The location is walking distance to Fremont Street and the Container Mall, but not so close that you hear the commotion.

reviews.title: Lion's Den
reviews.text: We stayed in the Lions Den room was spacious clean and having 2 a/c units was awesome considering it was considered the hottest week in Vegas. There was stores nearby for easy access instead of always having to eat fast food which was awesome. The 24hour family market has the Best sub's!!!!!

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: Check in time 3 pm. That means you can only stay 19 hours.That with the downtown location gives it that sex for sale feel. Definitely not a family destination or respected persons accommodation. Reminds me of the 3 hour rate of the torn down Del mar motel well within walking distance.

reviews.title: Opinión del Hotel
reviews.text: Actually the room is suitable to get to rest.It is clean but it does not have a good smell, nothing that can not be fixed with a good deodorant. We buy it and problem solved.It is very good to have your own parking at no extra cost and you can get in and out easily.It has a very good location. Since you can walk to famous fremont street.The cost of the room is congruent to the type of hotel.

reviews.title: Not for me, but probably good for college kids that are looking for a cheap place to stay
reviews.text: I will say the employees were very friendly. Hotel is very close to Fremont, but it is in a sketchy area. There is a strange sewage smell outside the building. The room was very hot and had a strong musty smell and the hallway smelled like marijuana. The bedding looked clean, but the towels had stains. I was supposed to stay 3 nights, but left after 1 because I have allergies and the musty smell was really getting to me. If you need a dark room to go to sleep, this is not the place for you. They have blind, but a lot of light comes in the rooms. This is probably one of the cheapest places to stay in Vegas, but it just wasn't for me.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: I loved staying at this hotel.  It is an older hotel but very clean.  The location is wonderful.  You can walk to Freemont Street and close to catching the bus to to the new strip. It was very quiet even so it is so close to the Freemont Street Experience

reviews.title: Stayed over 2 weeks
reviews.text: Adequate motel near downtown LV.  Did not have a phone in the room which, for me, could be an issue since I don't have a cellphone.  Has a pool.  I inquired about renting a fridge but it was not an option.  Wish it had a fridge and microwave .

reviews.title: Very good value for money
reviews.text: We stayed here for the first time and we definitely will come again. Firstly we rather prefer to stay in Fremont than on the Strip, and secondly, the price is by far lower than anywhere else. If you are not looking for luxury, but just to spend there few nights (we spend there 4 nights) in reasonable conditions, then it fits very good.

reviews.title: CONVENIENT SPOT IN DOWNTOWN WITH POOL
reviews.text: nicely priced motel ,location is super, clean and fresh , friendly helpful staff, quiet and clean poolside, so it has everything a good motel needs to thrive, good choice to stay there for couples, friends and relatives.

reviews.title: Downtowner Motel Works for Me
reviews.text: Downtowner staff is always friendly and helpful. Check-in is a breeze. Check-out even breezier. Rooms are clean and stylish. Price is more than reasonable for a cool place to stay on Fremont. Whenever I'm staying anywhere near Downtown Vegas the Downtowner Motel is where I stay

reviews.title: Needs improvements.
reviews.text: Room and hallways were dirty. Only two thin pillows were provided. No ice machine within the entire building, even though I was in the remodeled section. Only two thin pillows we're provided and no extra blanket.

reviews.title: Great stay at an affordable Vegas motel
reviews.text: Since my last visit The Downtowner has really stepped up their overall staying experience. The Downtowner isn't a 5 star on the strip Hotel, but where it lacks in Luxury it makes up for in value and an overall cute feel to the property. The location is within walking distance to the Freemont strip where there is a LOT to do in entertainment and eating. Rooms were clean and the staff was amazing. Check in and check out was simple and easy. Parking was free included in the $5 Dollar resort fee.

reviews.title: Very unhappy dissatisfied customer
reviews.text: MGNT team rude. Room dirty smelly. Maid never cleaned, so why charge a deposit and Resort fee. Roaches, ice machine out of order, the whole time I've been there. The hotel doed looked like the ones on the website.

reviews.title: Not what I was expecting at all.
reviews.text: Very dissatisfied, disappointed, as well as disgusted with this place, was lied to giving the run around also rude customer services as well as lack of communication between staff. No iron board or mini refrigerator like most places have, room was very hot even with the air conditioner and the place smelt very bad.

reviews.title: CALL ME MISERABLE
reviews.text: Worst trip ever,  horrible customer service,  disgusting rooms one of the hottest days of the year and no air conditioner coming out cold had to switch rooms thank goodness somebody cancelled or we would not have gotten it horrible horrible horrible that's all I can say

reviews.title: Dirty, Rundown, Infested, and a Terrible Rude Staff
reviews.text: Cock Roaches, stinks, and the staff is the worst I’ve ever dealt with. We didn’t even stay we went into the room turned and walked out. They refused to move us out or the infested tower, would not give us a refund, we had to walk around luggage in tow to find another hotel room. Don’t stay here.

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: Thank you for room opportunity.  Unfortunately I was not pleased with $50 deposit required. Most hotels do not have that.  200 characters are crazy. I know most people would not do that. Too much words. I am sorry for negative response.

reviews.title: Budget friendly
reviews.text: Hall carpet needed cleaning or replacing. I had to hold down the toilet handle in order to flush the water completely. The faucet on the sink was lose. It was an excellent location for me. The bed was extremely comfortable.

reviews.title: One Night Stay
reviews.text: Get what you pay for. The only downside was the cleanliness of the place. Saw a couple cockroaches in the hallways. Bathroom door was hard to close. Otherwise, had a great experience for the one night we stayed.

reviews.title: Cheap. close to Fremont
reviews.text: Rooms are clean and affordable. Staff is friendly enough. Housekeeping are hard workers. Cons:No refriegeratorIce machine is across the street in another building, and sometimes is out of order.While I was there, the fire alarm went off at 2:30ameveryone went outside..for about 40 minutes cooling our heels.no communication as to what was going on. had to rely on other guests' info.get back to our rooms, and awoke by the fire alarm yet again at 5:30amno apology, no explanation, no hey, tonight's on us. so sorry.i would expect something....

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Very good  the location, especially near to the we need to see . The room need to updates a little bit.  And the restroom too and the lavatory . And also the parking lot should secure and free for the guests

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The fire alarm went off at 5am we had to go across the street to get the staff to come and turn it off. They first offered a new room that smelled of pee and was very hot which We declined and they took the battery out of the detector. Then when it rained our room leaked in our room.

reviews.title: Great Location and Price.
reviews.text: Solid, clean room  for an unbelievable price.  Area is well lite and patrolled.  Fremont Street experience is less than 4 minutes walking away.  Note:  Vegas does seem to have a vagrant problem that is everywhere there are tourists.  Did feel safe at this establishment.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay and good price.
reviews.text: Would highly recommend this place to friends and relatives. Good price and well kept and secure rooms. Easy access to Freemont street. Only a short distance to get to the strip as well. Overall not a bad stay
